                                                                                  Fiscal Policy & Revenue · part 4 of 5

                                                                                  40 facts · 48 questions · 10 Must know

                                                                                  Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                  • Which one of the following taxes is the largest source of revenue in India?Income Tax

                                                                                  Largest tax revenue source now → Income Tax (then GST, Corporation Tax); in 2004-05 and 2005-06 Union excise duties were largest. Must know

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which of the following taxes yielded maximum revenue to the Centre during 2007-08?Corporation Tax

                                                                                  Maximum tax revenue to Centre in 2007-08 → Corporation Tax; now Income Tax 19%, GST 18%, Corporation Tax 17% of receipts.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • In the Union Budget 2005-06 the largest source of revenue was-Corporation Tax

                                                                                  Largest revenue source in Union Budget 2005-06 (book) → Corporation Tax.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • In India, the tax proceeds of which one of the following as a percentage of gross tax revenue has significantly declined in the last five years?Excise duty

                                                                                  Union excise share of gross tax revenue fell sharply: 30.4% (2005-06) → 16.5% (2009-10); now about 8.32%.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which of the following is not a tax/duty levied by the Government of India?Road Tax

                                                                                  Road tax → levied by State governments, not the Union; service tax, education cess and customs duty are Union levies. Must know

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which of the following Tax is levied by Union and collected and appropriated by States?Stamp Duties

                                                                                  Stamp duties (in Union List) → levied by Union, collected and appropriated by States.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which one of the following group of taxes collected by the Central Government are shared with the States?—

                                                                                  After the Eightieth Amendment (2000), net proceeds of all Union taxes (minus cess, surcharge, collection cost) form the divisible pool shared with States.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which one of the following statements regarding the levying, collecting and distribution of Income Tax is correct?The Union levies, collects and distributes the proceeds of income tax between itself and the States

                                                                                  Income tax → levied and collected by the Union; net proceeds shared between Union and States as per Finance Commission.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which one of the following sets of sources of revenue belongs to the Union Government alone?Customs duties, Corporation tax

                                                                                  Union-only sources (Union List) → customs duties and corporation tax (proceeds now shared via Finance Commission); sales tax, land revenue, holding tax are State sources.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which of the following is not a direct tax in India?Sales tax

                                                                                  Not a direct tax → sales tax (burden can be shifted); income tax, wealth tax and estate duty are direct (impact and incidence on same person).

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which one of the following is correctly matched?—

                                                                                  At question time (2004-06) Union excise was Centre's highest tax source (option c); now Income Tax, GST, Corporation Tax; income tax is direct, customs indirect.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Match the list-I with the list-II and select the correct answer from the code given below the lists:4 2 3 1

                                                                                  Capital Gain Tax → sale of property; Central Excise Duty → factory produce; Customs Duty → imports; Corporate tax → company income. Must know

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Corporation tax:is levied by the Union and shared by the Union and the States

                                                                                  Corporation tax → levied and collected by the Union and now shared with States via Finance Commission; at question time it belonged to the Union exclusively.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • The MinimumAlternate Tax (MAT) was introduced in the Budget of the Government of India for the year:1996-97

                                                                                  Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT) → first in Budget 1987-88, withdrawn 1990, reintroduced in Budget 1996-97 (from 1 April 1997) to tax 'zero tax companies'.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • MODVAT is related to:Excise duty

                                                                                  MODVAT (Modified Value Added Tax, 1986) → excise duty, to reduce tax cascading; CENVAT also relates to Union excise duties. Must know

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which one of the following is not a feature of'Value Added Tax'?It is basically a subject of the Central Government and the State Governments are only a facilitator for its successful implementation.

                                                                                  VAT features: tax on value added at each stage, multi-point destination based, borne by final consumer; it is not mainly a Central subject. Must know

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which of the following state have not introduced VAT system? Select the correct answer from the code given below:2 and 4

                                                                                  VAT → introduced April 01, 2005 (L.K. Jha Committee, 1978); Haryana first (April 2003); Uttar Pradesh last (2008); Chhattisgarh and UP initially stayed out. Must know

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                  • In which States/Union territories Sales tax is not levied?Andaman & Nicobar and Lakshadweep

                                                                                  Sales tax not levied (question period) → Andaman & Nicobar and Lakshadweep; GST applies across India since 1 July 2017.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • When was the Wealth tax first introduced in India?1957

                                                                                  Wealth tax → Wealth Tax Act 1957; abolished in Budget 2015-16, replaced by a surcharge on high-income individuals, HUFs and companies.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Service tax was introduced in India on the recommendation of:Raja J. Chelliah Committee

                                                                                  Service tax → introduced 1 July 1994 on the recommendation of Raja J. Chelliah Committee on Tax Reforms.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Consider the following statements regarding Service tax.Only 2 and 3 are correct

                                                                                  Service tax → indirect tax, introduced 1994-95 (Chelliah Committee); replaced by GST from 1 July 2017. Must know

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                  • The Union Budget 2006-07 has increased the Service tax from 10% to:12%

                                                                                  Service tax: 10% → 12% (Budget 2006-07) → 14% (Budget 2015-16); plus 0.5% clean India and 0.5% agriculture welfare cess in 2016-17.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • What is the current rate of Service Tax in India?—

                                                                                  Service tax rate at question time (2006) → 12% (option b); later raised to 14%.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • The number of services subject to Service Tax in 2009- 10 was:110

                                                                                  Services under service tax in 2009-10 → 109 (nearest option 110); 117 in 2010-11, 119 in 2011-12; negative list from 2012-13. Must know

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Income tax in India was introduced by:James Wilson

                                                                                  Income tax introduced in India → James Wilson, 1860 (first Income Tax Act; income in four schedules).

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which of the following taxes does not directly increase the price of a commodity to buyers:Income tax

                                                                                  Income tax does not directly raise commodity prices; trade tax, import duty and excise duty do (they are indirect taxes).

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • The tax on import and export is known as:Custom duty

                                                                                  Tax on imports and exports → customs duty (levied by the Union). Must know

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which of the following is direct tax?Income Tax

                                                                                  Direct tax → income tax (burden cannot be shifted); excise duty, octroi and sales tax are indirect.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • What is Excise duty?Indirect tax

                                                                                  Excise duty → indirect tax levied on production, sale or licence of certain goods.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which of the following is a direct tax?Wealth Tax

                                                                                  Direct taxes (cannot be shifted): income, corporation, wealth, property, gift tax; indirect (shifted): customs, excise, service tax, sales tax, GST, VAT. Must know

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Consider the following:1, 2 and 3

                                                                                  Fringe Benefit Tax (2005, abolished 2009), Interest Tax (1974 Act) and Securities Transaction Tax (1 October 2004) → all taken as direct taxes.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • The Sales tax you pay while purchasing a toothpaste is aTax imposed and collected by the State Government

                                                                                  Sales tax on toothpaste (pre-GST) → imposed and collected by the State Government; Central Sales Tax applied to inter-state sales.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which one of the following is not related with income from corporate sector in India?Capital Gains Tax

                                                                                  Capital Gains Tax → on profit from sale of capital assets, not corporate income; FBT, MAT and tax on company profit relate to corporate income.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which of the following taxes is not levied by the Union Government?Entertainment Tax

                                                                                  Entertainment tax → State List (List-II, Seventh Schedule), not levied by the Union; gift tax, personal income tax and corporation tax are Union taxes.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which of the following taxes is not levied by the State Governments?Corporation Tax

                                                                                  Corporation tax → levied by the Union, not States; entertainment tax, State excise duty and agricultural income tax are State taxes.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which one of the following does not mainly form a part of Tax Revenue of State Governments in India?Customs Duty

                                                                                  Customs duty → Central tax on imports and exports, not State tax revenue; land revenue, registration fee and commercial tax are State taxes.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Excise Duty on liquor is imposed by:State Governments

                                                                                  Excise duty on liquor → imposed by State Governments (State List, Seventh Schedule).

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • In which budget, the Commodity Transaction Tax (CTT) was introduced in the Budget of India?2013-14

                                                                                  Commodity Transaction Tax → introduced in Union Budget 2013-14; 0.01% on non-agricultural commodity futures.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • Which of the following comes/come under the definition of Adjusted Gross Revenue (AGR)?1, 2 and 3 all

                                                                                  Telecom Adjusted Gross Revenue (DoT view, upheld by SC October 2019) includes interest, dividend and forex gains; non-telecom revenue excluded from 15 September 2021.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                  • By which department was the 'e-Sahyog' Project launched in October 2015?Income Tax

                                                                                  E-Sahyog → Income Tax Department, launched 27 October 2015 to resolve return mismatches online.

                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                        • What is the maximum limit of the payment of Gratuity as per the Payment of Gratuity Act 1972?—

                                                                                        Gratuity ceiling (Payment of Gratuity Act 1972, 10 or more employees) → Rs. 10 lakh at question time (option c); Rs. 25 lakh from 1 January 2024.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • The Voluntary Disclosure of Income Scheme, 1997 was launched by the Finance Ministry with effect from:1 July, 1997

                                                                                        Voluntary Disclosure of Income Scheme 1997 → ran from 1 July 1997 to 31 December 1997.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • The Union Finance Minister Arun Jaitley announced in October, 2016 that under the Income Declaration Scheme (IDS), 2016 the amount of declared black money till September 30, 2016 is about:Rs. 65,250 crore

                                                                                        Income Declaration Scheme 2016 → about Rs. 65,250 crore black money declared till September 30, 2016 (announced by Arun Jaitley, October 1, 2016).

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Generally after every five years, Finance Commission is appointed in India to:determine the share of States in the Central grants and revenue of the Union

                                                                                        Finance Commission (Article 280, every fifth year) → recommends sharing of Union tax proceeds and grants between Union and States. Must know

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                        • The non-plan grants to the States by the Central Government are made on the recommendations of:Finance Commission

                                                                                        Non-plan grants to States → on Finance Commission recommendations (Article 280(3)(b): principles of grants-in-aid from Consolidated Fund).

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Consider the following statements with regard to the Planning Commission (PC) and Finance Commission (FC) and state which of these statements is not correct.Recommendations given by both are binding on the Government

                                                                                        Wrong: 'recommendations of Planning and Finance Commissions are binding'; both are recommendatory. FC → non-plan resources; PC → plan resources.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Which among the following taxes is not shared by the Central Government with U.P. Government under the Finance Commission award:Agriculture Income Tax

                                                                                        Agricultural income tax → State tax, not shared under Finance Commission award; all Union taxes are shareable after the Eightieth Amendment (2000).

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Who among the following is not a member of the 15th Finance Commission?Sudipto Mundle

                                                                                        15th Finance Commission (27 November 2017): Chairman N.K. Singh; members Ajay Narayan Jha, Anoop Singh, Ashok Lahiri, Ramesh Chand (part-time); Sudipto Mundle not a member.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Which one of the following statements about Fifteenth Finance Commission is NOT correct?The recommendations of the commission will cover the five year period 2020-25.

                                                                                        15th FC (N.K. Singh, November 27, 2017): first report for 2020-21 (December 5, 2019); final report for 2021-26 (November 9, 2020), not 2020-25.

                                                                                        Don't confuse 16th FC: Arvind Panagariya, constituted 31 December 2023; award period from 1 April 2026.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • What is the share of Bihar in the divisible pool of Central Taxes on the recommendation of the 15th Finance Commission?10.06%

                                                                                        Bihar's share in divisible pool (15th FC) → 10.061% (2020-21), 10.058% (2021-26), second after UP (17.931%); was 9.67% under 14th FC.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Consider the following:Only three

                                                                                        15th FC horizontal devolution: population 15.0%, area 15.0%, income distance 45.0%, forest and ecology 10.0%, demographic performance 12.5%, tax and fiscal effort 2.5%.

                                                                                        Don't confuse Governance reforms and stable government are not criteria.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • The recommendation of the 14th Finance Commission for increase the share of net proceeds of union taxes between Centre to States has been fixed at:42 percent

                                                                                        14th Finance Commission raised States' share of Union taxes from 32% to 42%; 15th FC → 41% (1% for new UTs of J&K and Ladakh).

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • With reference to the Fourteenth Finance Commission, which of the following statements is/are correct?1 only

                                                                                        14th Finance Commission (Dr. Y.V. Reddy, appointed 2 January 2013) → States' share raised from 32% to 42%; no sector-specific grants. Must know

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Who has been appointed as the Chairman of the 13th Finance Commission on 14 November, 2007?Dr. Vijay L. Kelkar

                                                                                        13th Finance Commission → Dr. Vijay L. Kelkar (November 2007); award period 2010-15, from 1 April 2010. Must know

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                        • States in Indian Union will receive at last what part of the following percentage of Central Tax under 13th Finance Commission recommendations?32.0 percent

                                                                                        13th Finance Commission → States' share 32% of net proceeds of Central taxes (12th FC: 30.5%).

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Thirteenth Finance Commission has proposed that the combined debt-GDPratio of the Centre and the States by year 2014-15 should be:68 percent

                                                                                        Thirteenth Finance Commission → combined Centre and States debt-GDP target 68% by 2014-15; also a road map for fiscal and revenue deficits. Must know

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Which one of the following has been assigned the highest weightage by the Thirteenth Finance Commission of India while recommending devolution of Union taxes amongst States?Fiscal Capacity Distance

                                                                                        13th FC devolution: highest weight → fiscal capacity distance 47.5% (population 1971 25.0%, fiscal discipline 17.5%, area 10.0%).

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Which of the following is/are among the noticeable features of the recommendations of the Thirteenth Finance Commission:1 and 3 only

                                                                                        13th FC: GST design with a compensation package tied to adherence; specified share of central taxes to local bodies as grants; no job-creation design.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Who is the Chairman of the 10th Finance Commission?K.C. Pant

                                                                                        Finance Commission chairmen: 1st K.C. Neogy (1951); 9th N.K.P. Salve; 10th K.C. Pant; 11th A.M. Khusro; 12th C. Rangarajan; Thirteenth Kelkar; Fourteenth Y.V. Reddy; 15th N.K. Singh. Must know

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 8 paper(s)

                                                                                        • The extent of money transfer to the States out ofsharable pool of tax collection according to the 12th Finance Commission has been fixed at:30.5 percent

                                                                                        12th Finance Commission (Dr. C. Rangarajan, 1st November 2002) → States' share 30.5% of net Union taxes (11th FC: 29.5%). Must know

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                        • As per the recommendations of the Twelfth Finance Commission, the revenue deficit of the Centre and States by the year 2009-10 should be:zero %

                                                                                        Twelfth Finance Commission → revenue deficit of Centre and States to be zero by 2009-10 (not achieved: 0.7% of GDP in 2009-10 RE).

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • 11th Finance Commission has recommended that in the tax revenue collected by the Union, the shareable part of States will be:29.5%

                                                                                        11th Finance Commission → States' share 29.5% of shareable Central taxes (28% for States levying sales tax on sugar, tobacco, man-made textiles).

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • According to the Tenth Finance Commission the share of resources to be transferred to States from the divisible pool will be:29%

                                                                                        Tenth Finance Commission → single divisible pool; States' share 29% of all shareable central taxes (15th FC: 41%).

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Match List I with List II and select the correct answer.4 2 1 3

                                                                                        Committees: Disinvestment → C. Rangarajan (1992); Industrial sickness → Onkar Goswami (1993); Tax reforms → Raja Chelliah (1991); Insurance reforms → R.N. Malhotra (1993).

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Recommendations of the Kelkar Task Force relate to:Taxes

                                                                                        Kelkar Task Forces (September 2002, Dr. Vijay L. Kelkar) → tax reform: simplify and rationalise direct and indirect taxes.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • The Committee which has recommended abolition of Tax Rebates under Section 88 of Income Tax Act of India, is:Kelkar Committee

                                                                                        Kelkar Task Force on Direct Taxes → recommended removing tax rebate under Section 88 (also 80L and Section 10 interest income); final report December 2002. Must know

                                                                                        Don't confuse Kelkar (direct-tax task force, 2002) with Chelliah, Shome or Rangarajan committees.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                        • The latest committee to submit its report on tax reforms is known as:Kelkar Committee

                                                                                        Latest tax reform committee → Kelkar Task Force (December 2002); Chelliah Committee 1991 (tax); Narasimhan 1991, 1998 (banking); Vaghul 1987 (call money market).

                                                                                        Don't confuse Narasimhan and Vaghul committees are banking and money market, not tax.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Consider the following statements:Neither 1 nor 2

                                                                                        Global Trust Bank → taken over by Oriental Bank of Commerce (2004), not PNB; Kelkar's second report dropped its original call to abolish housing-loan interest exemption, offering two options instead.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Recent tax reforms in India have been undertaken on the recommendations of the committee headed by:R. J. Chelliah

                                                                                        1990s tax reforms → Tax Reforms Committee under Raja J. Chelliah (1991), covering direct and indirect taxes; made direct taxes the major tax revenue component. Must know

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Which one of the following is different from the others from the point of view of tax reliefto individuals:Indira Vikas Patra

                                                                                        No income tax relief → Indira Vikas Patra; NSC, PPF and National Savings Scheme gave income tax rebate.

                                                                                        Memory aid 'Vikas Patra' (Indira or Kisan) → no tax benefit.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Which of the following is not eligible for any income tax rebate?Kisan Vikas Patra

                                                                                        No income tax rebate → Kisan Vikas Patra; NSC, PPF and ULIP give investment plus tax deduction.

                                                                                        Memory aid 'Vikas Patra' (Kisan or Indira) → no tax benefit.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • A PAN has initially a five-alphabet series like AFZPK 7190K. Here P stands for:Individual

                                                                                        PAN: 10-character alphanumeric ID; first five letters, next four numbers, last a letter; fourth character 'P' → Person (Individual).

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • PAN card issued by the Income Tax Department cannot be used for which of the following purpose?Proof of address

                                                                                        PAN card is not proof of address (address not printed); it shows name, father's name, date of birth and PAN.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • In the year 2001, the Prime Minister announced a five year excise duty holiday for industries in:earthquake ravaged Kutch district

                                                                                        2001 → PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee announced five-year excise duty holiday for industries in earthquake-hit Kutch district, Gujarat.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • The Union Budget 2000 awarded a Tax Holiday for the North-Eastern Region to promote industrialisation for:10 years

                                                                                        Union Budget 1999-2000 (FM Yashwant Sinha) → 10-year tax holiday for industries in the North-Eastern Region.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Consider the following sources of Revenue of the Panchyats:1, 2, 3 and 5

                                                                                        Panchayat finance sources → Finance Commission grant, central cooperative bank help, Centrally Sponsored Scheme allocations, State Finance Commission; NABARD not counted.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Which of the following taxes is levied by the Gram Panchayats?Tax on Local Fairs

                                                                                        Gram Panchayat levies tax on local fairs; sales tax and land revenue are not Gram Panchayat taxes.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • Consider the following actions by the government:1 and 2 only

                                                                                        Fiscal stimulus in recession → cut tax rates and raise government spending; abolishing subsidies is not part of it.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                        • The main source of fund for the National Highway Authority of India is:Cess

                                                                                        NHAI (NHAI Act, 1988) → main fund source is cess; also capital base support, additional budgetary support, capital grant.

                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              34 facts · 56 questions · 11 Must know

                                                                                              Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                              • Under the Constitution of India, Economic Planning is a subject:In the Concurrent List

                                                                                              Economic and Social Planning → Concurrent List (List-3), Seventh Schedule; both Union and States can legislate. Must know

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                              • The Development, Monitoring and Evaluation Office, which monitors the progress of long term policies in an attached office under:NITI Aayog

                                                                                              DMEO → attached office of NITI Aayog, set up 18 September 2015 by merging PEO and IEO; monitors and evaluates government programmes. Must know

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Consider the following statements:2 and 3 only

                                                                                              NDC (1952) was parallel to, not an organ of, Planning Commission; Economic and Social Planning → Concurrent List; Constitution asks Panchayats to plan for economic development and social justice.

                                                                                              Don't confuse NDC is not a part of the Planning Commission; NITI Aayog's Governing Council now does NDC's role.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Which one of the following statements is correct?The scope of the Finance Commission is limited to a review of the revenue segment of the budget, while the Planning Commission takes an overall review embracing both capital and revenue requirements of the States.

                                                                                              Finance Commission (constitutional) → reviews revenue segment of budget; Planning Commission (non-constitutional) → reviewed both capital and revenue needs of States.

                                                                                              Don't confuse Finance Commission is constitutional; Planning Commission was not.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Which of the following was called as Economic Cabinet of India by Ashok Chandra?Planning Commission

                                                                                              Ashok Chandra called the Planning Commission the 'Economic Cabinet of India' (undefined position, wide terms of reference).

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • National Development Council:Reviews the National Plans

                                                                                              National Development Council (6 August 1952), chaired by Prime Minister → reviewed and approved Five Year Plans drafted by Planning Commission. Must know

                                                                                              Don't confuse Planning Commission drafted the Plan; NDC approved it.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 11 paper(s)

                                                                                              • In which year was the 'Planning Commission' set up in India?1950

                                                                                              Planning Commission → set up March 1950 by Cabinet Resolution; advisory, non-constitutional body (also called quasi-political). Must know

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Which one of the following is not correct about NITI Aayog?It has a full-time Chairman.

                                                                                              Wrong: NITI Aayog has a full-time Chairman → PM is ex-officio Chairperson, with full-time Vice Chairman; set up 1 January 2015 replacing Planning Commission; cooperative federalism.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • NITI Aayog came into existence on:1st January, 2015

                                                                                              NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) → 1 January 2015, by Cabinet Resolution, replacing Planning Commission; a public policy think tank. Must know

                                                                                              Memory aid NITI Aayog was born on New Year's Day 2015.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Which of the following is a Nodal Institution for implementation of Sustainable Development Goals in India?NITI Aayog

                                                                                              Nodal institution for Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in India → NITI Aayog.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Who was the first Vice-Chairman of the NITI Aayog?Arvind Panagariya

                                                                                              First Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog → Arvind Panagariya (January 2015 to August 2017); Suman Bery since 1 May 2022. Must know

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Who among the following is the CEO of the NITI Aayog?Amitabh Kant

                                                                                              NITI Aayog CEOs → Sindhushree Khullar, then Amitabh Kant (second, from 17 February 2016), now B.V.R. Subrahmanyam (from 25 February 2023).

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • According to NITI Aayog which of the following States is at the top in the India Innovation Index 2019?Karnataka

                                                                                              India Innovation Index 2019 (NITI Aayog, October 17, 2019) → Karnataka top among major States; kept top spot in 2020 and 2021 editions.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • As per the latest report of the NITI Aayog, which of the following States has emerged as the fastest growing economy in India in 2014-15?Bihar

                                                                                              NITI Aayog report → Bihar fastest growing State economy in 2014-15; MoSPI: Manipur highest GSDP growth (13.51%) in 2021-22.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • In NITIAayog's Health Index 2019, Bihar scored:32.11

                                                                                              NITI Aayog State Health Index 2019 (second edition, June 2019) → Bihar scored 32.11; Kerala topped fourth edition (2019-20) at 82.20.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Which one of the following statements is correct regarding the Planning Commission of India?All of the above

                                                                                              Planning Commission → not mentioned in Constitution; no fixed tenure for Deputy Chairman and members; no fixed qualification for members.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Who among the following has not been the Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission in India?P. Chidambaram

                                                                                              Planning Commission Deputy Chairmen → Manmohan Singh (1985–1987), Pranab Mukherjee (1991–1996), Montek Singh Ahluwalia (2004–2014); P. Chidambaram never held it.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Who among the following is Chairman of the Planning Commission of India?None of the above

                                                                                              Prime Minister → ex-officio Chairman of Planning Commission; A.M. Khusro, N.K.P. Salve, M.S. Ahluwalia never Chairman (Ahluwalia was Deputy Chairman 2004–2014).

                                                                                              Don't confuse Chairman (PM, ex-officio) with Deputy Chairman (nominated, e.g. Montek Singh Ahluwalia).

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Which of the following are associated with 'Planning' in India?2 and 5 only

                                                                                              Linked to Planning → National Development Council (approved Plans) and Parliament (Plan presented after NDC approval); not Finance Commission or Ministries.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • ‘India Vision 2020’ is prepared by:S.P. Gupta Committee

                                                                                              'India Vision 2020' → committee under Dr. S.P. Gupta, Planning Commission member, set up June 2000; stressed employment and education.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Planning was considered Prerequisite:All the four

                                                                                              Planning needed for → balanced socio-economic development, even spread of benefits, removing regional disparities, maximum use of resources (all four). Must know

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                              • The basic difference between imperative and indicative planning is that:in the case of the imperative planning the market mechanism is entirely replaced by a command hierarchy, while in the case of indicative planning, it is looked upon as a way to improve the functioning of market system.

                                                                                              Imperative planning → market replaced by central command; indicative planning → state indicates direction and supports the market.

                                                                                              Memory aid Imperative = orders (command); Indicative = indicates (guides the market).

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • At present, where from the maximum resources are mobilised for India's public expenditure under plans?From borrowings

                                                                                              Largest source for India's plan public expenditure → borrowings (G-Secs, treasury bills, external assistance, small savings securities).

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Under Gadgil-Mukherjee Formula, the higher weightage is given to:Population

                                                                                              Gadgil-Mukherjee Formula (Central Plan Assistance from 8th Plan, 1992-97) → population (1971) 60 percent; per capita income 25; special problems 7.5.

                                                                                              Memory aid 60-25-7.5-7.5: population, per capita income, performance, special problems.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • 'National Planning Committee' was set up by:Subhash Chandra Bose

                                                                                              National Planning Committee → set up October 1938 by Congress President Subhash Chandra Bose; Jawaharlal Nehru was its Chairman.

                                                                                              Don't confuse Set up by Bose, chaired by Nehru; don't pick Nehru as founder.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • What is true for Planning in India?All are true

                                                                                              Wardha, August 1937 → Congress Working Committee resolution on national reconstruction and social planning; Bose's Haripura speech backed a planning commission scheme.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • The Gandhian Plan was expounded in 1944 by:Shriman Narayan Agarwal

                                                                                              Gandhian Plan (1944) → Shriman Narayan Agarwal; small-unit production, agriculture, decentralisation, self-contained villages, cottage industries. Must know

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Who opposed Planned Development in India?Mahatma Gandhi

                                                                                              Mahatma Gandhi opposed planned development; he favoured simple living, self-sufficiency, local resources and local labour for local needs.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Who amongst the following drafted the 'Sarvodaya Plan'?Jayaprakash Narayan

                                                                                              Sarvodaya Plan (1950) → Jayaprakash Narayan, on Gandhian ideals; from 1954 he devoted himself to the Sarvodaya Movement.

                                                                                              Don't confuse Sarvodaya Plan (Jayaprakash Narayan) with Gandhian Plan (Shriman Narayan Agarwal).

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Consider the following about the 'Rolling Plan': I. A plan for the current year which includes the annual budget II. A plan for a fixed number of years, say 3, 4 or 5 III. It is revised every year as per requirements of the economy IV. A perspective plan for 10, 15 or 20 years Which of the above are correct?I, II, III and IV

                                                                                              Rolling Plan (Gunnar Myrdal) → three plans: current-year plan with budget; plan of 3-5 years revised every year; perspective plan of 10-20 years. Must know

                                                                                              Memory aid A Rolling Plan 'rolls forward' one year at a time.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                              • The 'Rolling Plan' concept in National Planning was introduced by:The Janata Government

                                                                                              Rolling Plan in India → Janata Party Government, 1978-79, after rejecting Fifth Five Year Plan; flexible, revised yearly. Must know

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                              • The major objective of Indian Five Year Plans is:Self-reliance and reduction of dependence on foreign aid

                                                                                              Major objective of Five Year Plans → self-reliance and less dependence on foreign aid; also higher living standards and employment.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • Which of the following were goals of the Five Year Plans?None of the above

                                                                                              Five Year Plan goals → growth, modernisation, self-reliance; 'literature' was never a goal, so answer is 'None of the above'.

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                              • The period of the 12th Five-Year Plan is:2012-2017

                                                                                              12th Five Year Plan → 2012-2017; theme 'Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth'; 2016-17 was its last year. Must know

                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                    Hour 18 →
