                                                                                                    Planning + Planning

                                                                                                    79 facts · 101 questions · 18 Must know

                                                                                                    Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                    • Which of the following is not a vision of 12th Five Year Plan:—

                                                                                                    12th Plan targets → real GDP growth 8.0%, agriculture 4.0%, manufacturing 10.0%, poverty head-count cut by 10 percentage points; 50 million non-farm jobs.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • During the 12th Five Year Plan, the growth rate of agriculture, forestry and fish farming has been estimated to be:4.0%

                                                                                                    12th Plan target growth for agriculture, forestry and fisheries → 4.0 percent a year. Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • What is the expected target of development in the ‘vision paper’of the 12th Five Year Plan (2012-2017) as accepted by the National Development Council?9%

                                                                                                    12th Plan vision paper → 9 percent GDP growth target; NDC fixed it at 8 percent (December 2012) when approving the Plan.

                                                                                                    Don't confuse 9% (vision paper) with 8% (final NDC target).

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • In the 12th Five Year Plan, which among the following has largest allocation of funds?Social Services

                                                                                                    12th Plan largest allocation → Social Services (2664843 crore, about 34.7 percent of outlay); Energy 18.8 percent. Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • According to the government estimates during 12th Five Year Plan, the infrastructure sector will require an investment of:1000 billion

                                                                                                    12th Plan infrastructure investment need → Rs. 55.7 lakh crore (about US $1000 billion).

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • In India, which of the following Five Year Plans was launched with a focus on sustainable growth?12th

                                                                                                    12th Plan (2012-17) → 'Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth'; 11th Plan (2007-12) → 'Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth'. Must know

                                                                                                    Memory aid 12th Plan adds 'Sustainable' to the 11th Plan's theme.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Eleventh Five Year Plan emphasized on:Faster and more inclusive growth

                                                                                                    11th Five Year Plan (2007-12) → 'Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth'. Must know

                                                                                                    Don't confuse With 12th Plan's 'Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth'.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • According to the Approach Paper of the 11th Five Year Plan, with the achievement of targeted growth rate and population growing at 1.5 percent per annum, the real income of the average Indian would double in:10 years

                                                                                                    11th Plan Approach Paper → with target growth and 1.5 percent population growth, average Indian's real income doubles in ten years.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The largest increase of employment opportunities during the Eleventh Five Year Plan has been expected in:Construction

                                                                                                    11th Plan → biggest expected job growth in construction (8.27%); transport and communication 7.6%; manufacturing and agriculture 4% each.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • What is the size of the Eleventh Five Year Plan of India?Rs. 36,44,718 crore

                                                                                                    Eleventh Plan total outlay → Rs. 36,44,718 crore; 12th Plan outlay → Rs. 76,69,807 crore.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • In the Eleventh Five Year Plan highest allocation has been made for:Energy sector

                                                                                                    11th Plan highest allocation → social services, then energy sector; among the options, energy. Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • In the 11th Five Year Plan, which of the following sectors accounts for maximum combined Central, State and U.T. expenditure?Social sector

                                                                                                    11th Plan → social sector had maximum combined Central, State and UT expenditure.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The rate fixed for industrial development in the Eleventh Plan is:10.5 percent

                                                                                                    11th Plan targets → GDP 9%; agriculture 4% (double the 10th Plan's 2%); industry 10.5 percent (10% to 11%, up from 9.2%). Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Target for annual growth rate of Gross Domestic Product during the Eleventh Five Year Plan is:9.0 percent

                                                                                                    11th Plan GDP growth target → 9.0 percent a year; achieved 8.0 percent.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Inclusive growth as enunciated in the Eleventh Five Year Plan does not include one of the following:Strengthening of capital market

                                                                                                    Eleventh Plan inclusive growth → reduce poverty, expand employment, reduce gender inequality; strengthening capital market not included.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • What is the theme of the Eleventh Five Year Plan for education sector?Compulsory elementary education

                                                                                                    11th Plan education theme → compulsory elementary education; aim to cut elementary drop-out rate from 52.2% (2003-2004) to 20% by 2011-12.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • How many IITs (Indian Institute of Technology) will be set up in the Eleventh Five Year Plan?8

                                                                                                    11th Plan (2007 to 2012), endorsed by NDC → eight new IITs to be set up.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The annual growth rate of the economy as envisaged in the mid-term appraisal of the 10th plan is:7.0 percent

                                                                                                    10th Plan (2002-07) → growth target 8 percent; cut to 7 percent in mid-term appraisal; actual 7.6 percent. Must know

                                                                                                    Don't confuse Original target (8%) with mid-term appraisal figure (7%).

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The Tenth Five Year Plan will end in year:2007

                                                                                                    10th Five Year Plan → 1 April 2002 to 31 March 2007; ended in 2007.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Which of the following statements are true about the 10th Five Year Plan?1 and 2

                                                                                                    10th Plan targets → 8% GDP growth; poverty ratio down 5 points to about 20% by 2007; literacy 75% (not 73%).

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Which one of the following sectors was allocated the highest percentage in the Tenth Plan Outlay?Energy

                                                                                                    Tenth Plan outlay → Energy highest (26.47%); Social services 22.79%; Transport 14.31%; Communication 6.43%.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The Tenth Five Year Plan targets the highest growth rate in:Communication

                                                                                                    Tenth Plan highest target growth → communication (15%); financial services 11.69%; manufacturing 9.82%; trade 9.44%; agriculture 3.97%. Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • During Tenth Five Year Plan, growth rate was highest in:Pulses and oilseeds

                                                                                                    Tenth Plan crop growth → pulses and oilseeds highest (4.29%); other crops 3.58%; fruits and vegetables 2.97%; cereals 1.28%.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • In the Tenth Five Year Plan investment rate was:higher than savings rate

                                                                                                    Tenth Plan → investment rate (32.10% of GDP) was higher than domestic savings rate (26.84%).

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The growth in GDP in years 2000-02, compared with the Tenth Plan target has been:About half of what expected

                                                                                                    GDP growth in 2000-02 → only about half of the Tenth Plan target.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Which one of the following Five Years PlanofIndia focused on the Growth with Social Justice and Equaity?9th

                                                                                                    9th Plan (1997-2002), United Front Government → 'Growth with Social Justice and Equity'.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The growth rate percentage for the 9th Five Year Plan has been targeted:6.5%

                                                                                                    9th Plan → growth target 6.5 percent; actual 5.4 percent; theme 'Growth with Social Justice and Equity'. Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • What percentage of education budget under 9th Five Year Plan has been allocated to primary education?58%

                                                                                                    9th Plan → 57.1 percent of education budget for primary education (nearest option 58%).

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • In which of the following Five Year Plans the Women's Component Plan was introduced as a major strategy?Ninth Five Year Plan

                                                                                                    Women's Component Plan → entered in 7th Plan (27 women's schemes monitored); major strategy in 9th Plan (1997-2002): not less than 30 percent funds for women.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Which one of the following is the correct estimate of the Capital-Output Ratio for the Ninth Five Year Plan:4.0

                                                                                                    9th Plan (1997-2002) → Incremental Capital-Output Ratio (ICOR) 4.3 (nearest option 4.0); savings 26.1% and investment 28.2% of GDP.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The Seventh Five Year Plan ended in March 1990, the Eighth Five Year Plan started in:April 1992

                                                                                                    7th Plan ended 31 March 1990; 1990-91 and 1991-92 were Annual Plans; 8th Plan ran April 1992 to March 1997. Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Which of the following Five Year Plans of India recognized human development as the core of developmental efforts?Eighth Five Year Plan

                                                                                                    8th Plan → recognised 'human development' as core of all development efforts; aimed at near-full employment. Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Which of the following Five Year Plans was focused on Human Resource Development?None of the above

                                                                                                    Human Resource Development focus → 8th Plan (employment, education, public health); not Fifth, First or Third, so 'None of the above'.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • What is the annual growth rate aimed at in the Eighth Five Year Plan?5.6%

                                                                                                    8th Plan (1992-97), delayed two years → target growth 5.6 percent; actual 6.8 percent. Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The rate of industrial development fixed in the 8th Five Year Plan is:7.5%

                                                                                                    8th Plan targets → GDP growth 5.6 percent; industrial growth 7.5 percent.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • What will be the total amount of investment outlay in the Eighth Plan?798000 crore Rs.

                                                                                                    8th Plan → national investment Rs. 798000 crore; public sector outlay Rs. 434100 crore; growth target 5.6% a year.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The largest source of financing the public sector outlay of the Eighth Five Year Plan comes from:government borrowings

                                                                                                    8th Plan public sector outlay (Rs. 434100 crore) → largest source government borrowings (Rs. 202255 crore, 46.6%).

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The major shift in the 8th Five Year Plan from its preceding ones is:the concentration of public investment in infrastructural sectors

                                                                                                    8th Plan's major shift → public investment concentrated in infrastructure sectors; more scope for private sector amid reforms.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • In the context of India’s Five Year Plans, a shift in the pattern of industrialization, with lower emphasis on heavy industries and more on infrastructure begin inEighth Plan

                                                                                                    Shift from heavy industries to infrastructure → 8th Plan (1992-97), with liberalisation under PM P.V. Narsimha Rao; growth 6.8% vs 5.6% target.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The Sixth and the Eighth Five Year Plans covered the period 1980-85 and 1992-97 respectively. The Seventh Five Year Plan covered the period:1985-90

                                                                                                    Plan periods → 6th 1980-85; 7th 1985-90; 8th 1992-97 (postponed two years, 1990-92).

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The main slogan of the Seventh Five Year Plan was:Food, Work and Productivity

                                                                                                    7th Plan (1985-90) slogan → 'Food, Work and Productivity'; achieved 6% growth against 5% target.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The strategy adopted under IRDP in the Seventh Plan was:Adoption of total household approach

                                                                                                    IRDP (launched 2 October 1980 in all blocks) → 'total household approach' adopted as strategy in 7th Plan.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Which one of the following programmes was initiated during the Sixth Five Year Plan?Integrated Rural Development

                                                                                                    IRDP → launched 2 October 1980 in 6th Plan (1980 to 1985); subsidy plus bank credit for rural poor; merged into Swarna Jayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojna April 1999.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Which of the following plan is called Rolling Plan?Sixth Plan

                                                                                                    Rolling Plan → Janata Party's Sixth Plan (1978) after ending Fifth Plan; ended 1979; Congress then ran new Sixth Plan 1980-85.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • During which Five Year Plan was the Emergency clamped, new elections tookplace and the Janata Party was elected?Fifth

                                                                                                    Fifth Plan (scheduled 1974-79) → Emergency 1975, elections, Janata Party win; ended 1978, one year early; final draft by D.P. Dhar.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Which Plan among the following declared its objective of self-reliance and zero net foreign aid?Fifth five Year Plan

                                                                                                    Fifth Plan → twin aims: removal of poverty (Garibi Hatao) and self-reliance (zero net foreign aid). Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The slogan of‘Poverty abolition’ was given in which Five Year Plan?—

                                                                                                    'Garibi Hatao' → Indira Gandhi's 1971 election slogan, during 4th Plan (1969-74); poverty removal became main objective of 5th Plan (UPPSC answer: 5th Plan). Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Consider the following events and arrange these in chronological order: I. Garibi Hatao II. Bank Nationalization III. Beginning of Green Revolution Select the correct answer from the codes given below:III, II and I

                                                                                                    Chronology → Green Revolution (1966-67, HYV seeds) → Bank nationalisation (1969, 14 banks) → Garibi Hatao (Fifth Plan, 1974-79).

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The Growth Centre Approach was adopted under the:Fourth Five Year Plan

                                                                                                    Growth Centre Approach → introduced in 4th Plan (1969-74) to remove regional disparities; special emphasis in 5th Plan.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The objective of self-sustaining development in India was first adopted in:Fourth Five Year Plan

                                                                                                    Self-sustaining development first adopted in 4th Plan → twin aims 'growth with stability' and 'progressive achievement of self-reliance'.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Under which Five Year Plan was the decision to establish a socialistic pattern of society taken?Second Five Year Plan

                                                                                                    Socialistic pattern of society → 2nd Plan (1956-61), on P.C. Mahalanobis model; rapid industrialisation with heavy and basic industries. Must know

                                                                                                    Memory aid Second Plan is also called the 'Mahalanobis Plan'.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Planning in India, in real sense, began with the Second Five Year Plan. Who was the architect of Indian Planning?P.C. Mahalanobis

                                                                                                    Architect of Indian planning → P.C. Mahalanobis; real planning began with 2nd Plan (1956-61), built on his ideas.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Mahalanobis Plan Model adopted in India in the midfifties aimed at:Setting up heavy industries which were capital intensive

                                                                                                    Mahalanobis model (2nd Plan, 1956-61) → rapid industrialisation through capital-intensive heavy and basic industries; agriculture lower priority. Must know

                                                                                                    Memory aid Mahalanobis = Machines (heavy industry).

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Which area was given the maximum emphasis in the Second Five Year Plan?Industrial sector

                                                                                                    2nd Five Year Plan → maximum emphasis on industrial sector (capital-intensive heavy and basic industries).

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • First Five Year Plan was started in:1951-52

                                                                                                    First Five Year Plan → began 1 April 1951 (1951-52); earlier ideas: National Planning Committee 1938, Bombay and Gandhian Plans 1944, People's Plan 1945.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • First Five Year Plan of India was based on the:Harrod-Domar Model

                                                                                                    First Five Year Plan (1951) → based on Harrod-Domar model; focus on primary sector.

                                                                                                    Don't confuse First Plan → Harrod-Domar; Second Plan → Mahalanobis.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • What was the priority of the First Five Year Plan?Development of Agriculture

                                                                                                    First Plan (1951-56) → priority agriculture; Harrod-Domar model; succeeded due to good harvests.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Consider the following statements regarding Indian Planning:1 only

                                                                                                    2nd Plan → heavy industries (true); import substitution began with 2nd Plan in 1950s, not 3rd Plan (false).

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • With reference to India’s Five Year Plans, which of the following statements is/are correct?1 and 2 only

                                                                                                    True: 2nd Plan → thrust on substituting basic and capital goods; 4th Plan → correct concentration of wealth and power. False: financial sector part of 5th Plan.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below:2 4 1 3

                                                                                                    Plan models → 1st Harrod-Domar; 2nd Mahalanobis; 3rd S. Chakravarty; 4th Ashok Rudra.

                                                                                                    Memory aid HMCR (Plans 1 to 4): 'Hard Men Climb Rocks' = Harrod-Domar, Mahalanobis, Chakravarty, Rudra.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Match the following plans and programmes:2 1 3 5 4

                                                                                                    1st Plan → Community Development (1952); 2nd → rapid industrialisation; 3rd → basic industries; 4th → self-reliance, growth with stability; 5th → Minimum Needs Programme.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Match List - I with List - II and select the correct answer using the codes given below:2 3 4 1

                                                                                                    Plan periods → 1st 1951-56; 3rd 1961-66; 4th 1969-74; 6th 1980-85.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • In which Five Year Plan, Economic Development rate was maximum?Tenth Five Year Plan

                                                                                                    Highest actual growth among options → Tenth Plan (7.6%); First 3.6%, Fourth 3.3%, Sixth 5.7%; Eleventh Plan (8.0%) highest overall.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The cumulative annual growth rate of Real Gross National Product in India was maximum in:Eighth Five Year Plan

                                                                                                    Highest real GNP growth among the Fifth to Eighth Plans → Eighth Five Year Plan.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • During the planning periods, the highest growth rate was achieved during the:Tenth plan

                                                                                                    Highest growth among Seventh to Tenth Plans → Tenth Plan; across all Plans, the Eleventh Plan recorded the highest growth. Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • During which Five Year Plan, India has achieved the maximum per-capita growth rate?Eleventh Plan

                                                                                                    Maximum per capita growth → Eleventh Plan; with 9% GDP target, per capita GDP to grow about 7.6% a year, doubling in under ten years.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer by using the code given below the lists:2 4 1 3

                                                                                                    U.P. growth rates → 6th Plan 3.9%; 7th Plan 5.7%; 8th Plan 3.2%; 9th Plan 2.5%.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Since the start of Planning in India, the total number of years not covered by any Five Year Plan is:7

                                                                                                    Seven years with no Five Year Plan → 1966-69 (three Annual Plans), Rolling Plan 1978-79, 1979-80, Annual Plans 1990-92.

                                                                                                    Memory aid 3 + 1 + 1 + 2 = 7 plan-less years.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The Plan Holiday refers to the period:1966-69

                                                                                                    Plan Holiday → 1 April 1966 to 31 March 1969 (three Annual Plans) between 3rd and 4th Plans.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Which one of the following decade in Indian Planning deserves to be called 'the decade of jobless growth'?1991-2000

                                                                                                    Decade of jobless growth → 1991-2000; organised sector job growth 0.36% vs 2.6% target in early 8th Plan; employment growth fell to about 1%.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • 'Twenty Point Economic Programme' was first launched in the year:1975

                                                                                                    Twenty Point Programme → launched 1975; revised 1982 and 1986; restructured 2006; aim: poverty eradication and better quality of life. Must know

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Core sector in the planning mean:Selected basic industries

                                                                                                    Core sector → selected basic industries: electricity, steel, refinery products, crude oil, coal, cement, natural gas, fertilizers.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The principal reason why national economic planning is still being pursued inspite of embracing a market econony since 1991 is that:Five Year Plans can continue to provide a long-term perspective to the economy in market-friendly fashions

                                                                                                    Planning continued after 1991 market reforms → Five Year Plans gave long-term perspective in market-friendly way; 12th Plan (2012-17) was the last.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The planning process in the industrial sector in India has assumed a relatively less important position in the nineties as compared to that in the earlier period. Which one of the following is not true in this regard?The nation's priorities have shifted away from industrial development to rural development

                                                                                                    Industrial planning declined in the nineties (private sector, market role, focus on HRD and infrastructure); untrue: priorities shifted from industry to rural development.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Consider the following statements: Statement (A): ' Bottom-Up Planning' is a goal that is yet to be achieved.Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of(A)

                                                                                                    'Bottom-Up Planning' still a goal; village is the basic planning unit (Article 40, DPSP); 73rd Amendment, 1993 embodied Panchayati Raj.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Arrange the following in their chronological order:4, 3, 1, 2

                                                                                                    Chronology → India joined IMF (1945) → first rupee devaluation (1949) → First Plan to Parliament (8 December 1951) → NDC set up (6 August 1952).

                                                                                                    Memory aid 'I Did Plan Next': IMF, Devaluation, Plan, NDC.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • 'Yojana' magazine is being published by which of the following?Publications Division

                                                                                                    'Yojana' monthly → Publications Division, Ministry of Information and Broadcasting; started 1957, first Chief Editor Khuswant Singh.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • Who authored the book, 'Planned Economy for India'?M. Visvesvaraya

                                                                                                    'Planned Economy for India' → M. Visvesvaraya, first to advocate planning; proposed a ten-year plan to double national income through industrialisation.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                    • The author of the book titled ‘Planning and the Poor’ is:B.S. Minhas

                                                                                                    'Planning and the Poor' → book by B.S. Minhas.

                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)
