                                                                                                                                              Hour 25 →

                                                                                                                                              Hour 25 of 72 · Learn

                                                                                                                                              Money and Banking · part 7 of 7

                                                                                                                                              52 facts · 58 questions · 6 Must know

                                                                                                                                              Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                              • When was the first Regional Rural Bank formed?1975

                                                                                                                                              First RRB → Prathama Grameen Bank, Moradabad (U.P.), 2 October 1975; the other first four: Malda, Gorakhpur, Bhiwani, Jaipur. Must know

                                                                                                                                              Memory aid RRBs born on Gandhi Jayanti (2 October) 1975.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following is not the function of Regional Rural Banks?To take over the functions of Agricultural Refinance Corporation of India.

                                                                                                                                              Taking over the Agricultural Refinance Corporation of India's functions → not an RRB function; RRBs lend to small/marginal farmers and rural people, supplementing commercial banks.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following grants/grant direct credit assistance to rural household?1 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                              Direct credit to rural households → Regional Rural Banks and Land Development Banks; NABARD gives no direct credit, it refinances other institutions.

                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse NABARD's refinance role with direct lending to households.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following events and arrange them in chronological order:4, 1, 2, 3

                                                                                                                                              Chronology: RRB (1975) → NABARD (1982) → SHG-Bank Linkage Programme (1992-93) → Kisan Credit Card (1998).

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following does not implement the Self Help Groups (SHGs) – Bank Linkage Programme?NABARD

                                                                                                                                              SHG-Bank Linkage Programme → started by NABARD in 1992-93; implemented by Commercial Banks, RRBs and Cooperative Banks, not by NABARD.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements:Only two

                                                                                                                                              SHG programme → originally initiated by NABARD (not SBI); SHG members jointly take responsibility for a member's loan; RRBs and Scheduled Commercial Banks support SHGs.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Bhandari Committee is related to:Regional Rural Banks’restructuring

                                                                                                                                              Bhandari Committee (1994) → restructuring of Regional Rural Banks; identified 49 RRBs for restructuring; more powers to RRB Boards.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • The Narasimham Committee for Financial Sector Reforms has suggested reduction in:SLR and CRR

                                                                                                                                              Narasimham Committees (1991, Financial System; 1997, Banking Sector Reforms) → financial sector reforms; suggested reducing SLR and CRR. Must know

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • The Committee on Financial Sector Reforms 2008, in India was headed by:Raghuram Rajan

                                                                                                                                              Committee on Financial Sector Reforms → headed by Raghuram Rajan; set up 2007 by the Planning Commission; report submitted 2008.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • With what subject is Raghuram Rajan Committee connected?Financial Sector Reforms

                                                                                                                                              Raghuram Rajan Committee (2007) → Financial Sector Reforms.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • The Bimal Jalan Panel was set up by Reserve Bank of India to:Scrutinize application for new bank licenses

                                                                                                                                              Bimal Jalan Panel → RBI's three-member committee to scrutinize applications for new bank licenses; report 25 February 2014.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Who was the first Chairman of the ‘Disinvestment Commission’ of India?G.V. Ramkrishna

                                                                                                                                              First Chairman, Disinvestment Commission (1996) → G.V. Ramkrishna; it gave 13 reports covering privatization of 57 public sector units.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Rangarajan Committee on disinvestment of shares was appointed by the Government of India in:1993

                                                                                                                                              Rangarajan Committee (1993) → disinvestment of Government shares in public sector companies.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Who has been recently made the Chairman of the working group on revision of Wholesale Price Index Series?Abhijit Sen

                                                                                                                                              Abhijit Sen working group (2007) → revision of the Wholesale Price Index series; report May 2008; recommended base year 2004-05.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • With reference to ‘Financial Stability and Development Council’, consider the following statements:2 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                              Financial Stability and Development Council (December 2010) → headed by Union Finance Minister; monitors macroprudential supervision; not an organ of NITI Aayog.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Recently, a scheme named ‘Swabhimaan’was launched. It’s main aim is:To take banks to the doorsteps of the rural poor

                                                                                                                                              Swabhimaan Campaign (10 February 2011) → financial inclusion; take banking to the doorsteps of the rural poor. Must know

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • What is/are the facility/facilities the beneficiaries can get from the services of Business Correspondent (Bank Saathi) in branchless areas?Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                              Business Correspondent (Bank Saathi) → villagers in branchless areas can draw subsidies/social security benefits and make deposits and withdrawals; both correct.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • What is/are the purpose/purposes of the Government’s ‘Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme’ and ‘Gold Monetization Scheme’?1 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                              Gold Monetization Scheme and Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme (2015) → bring idle household gold into the economy; cut dependence on gold imports; not to promote FDI.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following is covered by the Kisan Credit Card Scheme?Consumption Credit and Investment Credit

                                                                                                                                              Kisan Credit Card (August 1998) → covers both consumption and investment credit of farmers; run by Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, Cooperatives. Must know

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • With reference to the institution of Banking Ombudsman in India, which one of the following statements is not correct?The orders passed by the Banking Ombudsman are final and binding on the parties concerned.

                                                                                                                                              Banking Ombudsman → appointed by RBI; free of fee; NRIs with Indian accounts can complain; its orders are NOT final and binding on the parties.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements:2 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                              Credit rating agencies regulated by SEBI (CRA Regulations 1999), not RBI; ICRA is a public limited company (listed BSE, NSE); Brickwork Ratings is a SEBI-registered Indian rating agency.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Which is a credit rating agency in India?All of the above

                                                                                                                                              CRISIL, CARE and ICRA → all are credit rating agencies in India.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following Credit Rating Agencies and arrange them in chronological order:3, 2, 1

                                                                                                                                              Credit rating agencies, oldest first: CRISIL (1987) → ICRA (1991) → CARE (1993).

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • CRISIL:evaluates the credit worthiness of a company

                                                                                                                                              CRISIL (Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd., 1987) → evaluates the creditworthiness of companies; one of India's oldest credit rating agencies.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • The Phillips Curve represents relationship between:Inflation and Unemployment

                                                                                                                                              Phillips Curve (A.W. Phillips, 1958) → stable inverse relation between inflation and unemployment; a short-run trade-off.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • 'Smart Money' is a term used for:Credit Card

                                                                                                                                              'Smart Money' → term used for credit card.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • What is called ‘Plastic Money’?Credit card

                                                                                                                                              'Plastic Money' → credit cards (mainly bank-issued), also debit, prepaid, smart and store cards used in place of bank notes. Must know

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • PIN in banking transaction is known as:Personal Identification Number

                                                                                                                                              PIN → Personal Identification Number; numeric code issued with a payment card that adds a layer of security to electronic transactions.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following is not a prepaid payment instrument?Credit Card of a Nationalized Bank

                                                                                                                                              Credit card of a nationalized bank → NOT a prepaid payment instrument; Delhi Metro Rail Card, e-wallet, Airtel Money → prepaid instruments.

                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Credit card = pay later on credit; prepaid instrument = pay first, then use.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • For the existence of a market which is indispensable?Prices

                                                                                                                                              Prices → indispensable for the existence of a market (goods and services are bought and sold on the basis of price).

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Market is an economic tendency, which leads to which of the following trends?Consumerism

                                                                                                                                              Market as an economic tendency → leads to consumerism.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • The buyer's market is known where:supply is more than the demand

                                                                                                                                              Buyer's market → supply exceeds demand; buyers have the advantage over sellers in price bargaining.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Given below are two statements. One is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of(A).

                                                                                                                                              Accounting → 'language of business' (communicates financial information); it gives all information a businessman needs. A and R true, R explains A.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Given below are two statements, in which one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):(A) is true but (R) is false.

                                                                                                                                              Condition → stipulation essential to the contract's main purpose; breach allows repudiation. Warranty → collateral; breach gives damages only. So A true, R false.

                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Don't swap them: breach of condition → repudiate contract; breach of warranty → claim damages.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Match List-I with List-II and choose the correct answer using the code given below:—

                                                                                                                                              Merchandise Turnover = Cost of Goods Sold/Average Stock; Current Ratio = Current Assets/Current Liabilities; Acid Test = Liquid Assets/Current Liabilities; Return on Total Assets = NPBIT/Total Assets.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Auctions or dynamic pricing markets are examples of:B2B commerce; C2C commerce

                                                                                                                                              Auctions and dynamic (real-time) pricing markets → the book accepts both B2B and C2C commerce.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Consumers fix price on their own, which business accept or decline comes under _____ model.C2B

                                                                                                                                              C2B (consumer-to-business) model → consumers fix their own price and the business accepts or declines; opposite of the traditional B2C model.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Which type of market is suitable for vegetable crops?Very short term

                                                                                                                                              Vegetables, flowers, fruits → very short period market (supply fixed; price depends on demand).

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • The supply-side economics lays greater emphasis on the point of view of:producer

                                                                                                                                              Supply-side economics → producer's point of view; production (supply) drives growth; tax cuts for the wealthy trickle down to the economy.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • When the total product remains constant, the marginal product will be:Zero

                                                                                                                                              Total product constant → marginal product is zero (total product at its optimum level).

                                                                                                                                              Memory aid MP = extra output from one more unit; no change in TP means MP is zero.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • A consumer is said to be in equilibrium, if:he is able to fulfil his need with a given level of income.

                                                                                                                                              Consumer equilibrium → consumer fulfils his needs with a given level of income and cannot gain by changing what he buys.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements: Other things remaining unchanged, market demand for a good might increase if:1 and 4 only

                                                                                                                                              Demand for a good rises if its substitute's price rises or its own price falls; not if a complement's price rises or income rises for an inferior good.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • With fixed demand and increase in supply, the price of the commodity is likely to:decrease

                                                                                                                                              Fixed demand + rising supply → price likely to decrease (supply and price inversely related).

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • A rise in general level of prices may be caused by:1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                              General price level rises with all three: higher money supply, lower aggregate output, higher effective demand.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Supply of money remaining the same when there is an increase in demand for money, there will be:an increase in the rate of interest

                                                                                                                                              Money supply fixed + demand for money rises → rate of interest rises.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Assertion (A): All businessmen make profit due to price-hike.Both A and Rare true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.

                                                                                                                                              Price-hike → businessmen make profit (A true); consumers curtail needs as money's purchasing power falls (R true); R does not explain A. Must know

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Improvement of profit volume ratio can be done by the following:All of the above

                                                                                                                                              Profit Volume (P/V) ratio = contribution as % of sales; improved by raising selling price, altering sales mix and reducing variable cost (all).

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • For pricing of public goods, the concept of‘Shadow Prices’ was given by:J. Tinbergen

                                                                                                                                              'Shadow Prices' for pricing public goods → J. Tinbergen; shadow price = estimated true (equilibrium) value of something not normally priced in the market.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following is NOT a Public good?Cars

                                                                                                                                              Cars → not a public good; Government administration, national defence and roads → public goods.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • If a commodity is provided free to the public by the Government, thenThe opportunity cost is transferred from the consumers of the product to the tax-paying public.

                                                                                                                                              Commodity given free by Government (street light, free education) → opportunity cost shifts from its consumers to the tax-paying public.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • With reference to trade, which of the following statements is/are correct?Only 1

                                                                                                                                              Trade → exchange of goods/services for money; represents both demand and supply, not only demand.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                              • With reference to Commerce, which of the following statements is/are correct?Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                              Commerce → removes impediments to exchange and deals with delivering products to consumers (distribution, not production); both statements correct.

                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    Human Development

Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                    • Who originally propounded the theory of three stages of social development?Auguste Comte

                                                                                                                                                    Theory of three stages of social development → Auguste Comte: theological → metaphysical → positive (scientific) stage.

                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid Comte's T-M-P: Theology, Metaphysics, Positive science.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Given below are two statements, one labelled as Assertion (A) and other as the Reason (R).Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is correct explanation of(A)

                                                                                                                                                    HDI and SDG rankings of Indian States → positively related, since SDG targets are closely tied to education and health. A and R true, R explains A.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following is the correct order in which the mentioned measures of development were introduced?Per-capita Income, PQLI, HDI

                                                                                                                                                    Development measures in order: Per-capita Income (US, 1934, Simon Kuznets' team) → PQLI (Physical Quality of Life Index) → HDI (Human Development Index).

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following pairs is the most suitable estimate of the physical quality of life?Infant mortality rate – Literacy

                                                                                                                                                    PQLI → Morris D. Morris (mid-1970s); average of basic literacy, infant mortality and life expectancy; best pair for physical quality of life: infant mortality–literacy. Must know

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following organizations publishes the Human Development Report?U.N.D.P.

                                                                                                                                                    Human Development Report → published by UNDP; first HDR released in 1990.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • The Human Development Index (HDI) was first developed by which of the following?UNDP

                                                                                                                                                    HDI → developed by Pakistani economist Mahbub-ul-Haq for UNDP's Human Development Report (first 1990); rooted in Amartya Sen's capability work. Must know

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following approaches is associated with Prof.Amartya Sen?Capability Approach

                                                                                                                                                    Capability Approach → Prof. Amartya Sen (1980s); alternative to welfare economics, focusing on people's capability to live lives they value.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following was first to concentrate on human aspect of development?United Nations Development Programme

                                                                                                                                                    UNDP → first to focus on the human aspect of development; first Human Development Report in 1990.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Human Development Index is a composite index of:Life expectancy, Educational attainment and per capita GDP

                                                                                                                                                    HDI = composite of life expectancy, education and per capita income (per capita GNI since 2010; per capita GDP before); published by UNDP; value from zero to 1.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Human Development Index comprises literacy rates, life expectancy at birth and:—

                                                                                                                                                    Old HDI → literacy rate, life expectancy at birth, GDP per head at real purchasing power; since 2010 → life expectancy, mean and expected years of schooling, income.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • While calculating HDI, the maximum value and minimum value for Life Expectancy at birth (Years) are taken as:—

                                                                                                                                                    HDI life expectancy goalposts → 85 and 25 years before 2010; now 85 and 20 years (index = 1 at 85, 0 at 20).

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following is not included in Human Development Index?—

                                                                                                                                                    HDI indicators → life expectancy at birth, education level, standard of living (GNI per capita PPP $); not included → social inequality, health and nutrition, urbanization. Must know

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Arrange the following countries on the basis of‘Human Development Index 2022’in descending order. Country3, 4, 1, 2

                                                                                                                                                    HDI ranks for 2021 (HDR 2021/2022): Hong Kong 4th, Australia 5th, Japan 19th, Russia 52nd → descending order: Hong Kong, Australia, Japan, Russia.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • With reference to the Human Development Report, 2021- 22, which of the following statement is/are correct?Neither 1 nor 2

                                                                                                                                                    HDR 2021/2022 → India's HDI rank slipped from 130 (2020) to 132 in 2021, not 2022 (191 countries); HDR 2023/2024 → 134 in 2022.

                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Both statements wrong: 'upgraded' is wrong and the year 2022 is wrong.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which one is correct in the ascending order of HDI 2019 ranking of the following countries?Brazil, China, South Africa, India

                                                                                                                                                    HDI 2019 ranks (HDR 2020): Brazil 84, China 85, South Africa 114, India 131 → ascending: Brazil, China, South Africa, India.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • As per the Human Development Report 2015, consider the following statements: A. India ranks 130 out of 183 countries. B. HDI is based on the indices for life expectancy, education and PCI. C. In comparison to other nations in the BRICS, India has the lowest rank. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?A, B and C

                                                                                                                                                    HDR 2015 → India 130th; HDI uses life expectancy, education and per capita income; India lowest among BRICS. Book marks all three correct.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which country’s Human Development Index rank is first as per Human Development Report 2018?Norway

                                                                                                                                                    HDR 2018 → Norway ranked first in HDI (for 2017); HDR 2023/2024 → Switzerland 1st (0.967), Norway 2nd, for 2022.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • In the year 2014, out of186 countries of the world, India’s rank in Human Development Index was:—

                                                                                                                                                    HDR 2015 → India 130th of 188 (HDI for 2014), UPPSC's answer; HDR 2014 → 135th of 187 (for 2013); HDR 2023/2024 → 134th of 193. Must know

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Improvement in which among the following will make India’s rank high in HDI of UNDP?3 and 4

                                                                                                                                                    India's HDI rank rises with more children going to school and more adults becoming literate (education level); not with safe drinking water or farm credit.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • According to the Human Development Report 1997, out of six crore Indian children with less than four years of age, adequate nutrition is not available to:53 %

                                                                                                                                                    HDR 1997 → about 53% of India's six crore (60 million) children below four years of age were under-nourished.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following organization calls India’s economic growth as ‘Jobless’, ‘Rootless’, ‘Ruthless’, ‘Voiceless’ and ‘Futureless’?UNDP

                                                                                                                                                    UNDP's Human Development Report 1996 → called growth 'Jobless', 'Rootless', 'Ruthless', 'Voiceless' and 'Futureless'.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Gender Inequality Index (GII) was introduced in which Human Development Report (HDR) of UNDP?HDR2010

                                                                                                                                                    Gender Inequality Index (GII) → introduced in UNDP's HDR 2010; dimensions: reproductive health, empowerment, labour market participation.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following statements is false?Higher the adult literacy lower is the infant mortality

                                                                                                                                                    False: 'higher adult literacy, lower infant mortality'. Malaysia and Indonesia both have 84% adult literacy, yet infant mortality is 11 and 47.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • The best performance in terms of Human Development among the Asian countries is by:Korea

                                                                                                                                                    Best human development among the given Asian countries → Korea: life expectancy 71.7 years, adult literacy 98%, infant mortality 6 per 1000.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following has chosen Gross National Happiness as the index of progress:Bhutan

                                                                                                                                                    Gross National Happiness (GNH) → Bhutan; introduced by its 4th King Jigme Singye Wangchuck in the 1970s as an alternative to GDP. Must know

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • The rank of India in Global Happiness Index 2023 is:126

                                                                                                                                                    World Happiness Report 2023 → India 126th of 137 countries (average 2020-2022); WHR 2024 → again 126th of 143.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Consider the following:1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                    Universal Declaration of Human Rights covers all three: right to education (Art 26), equal access to public service (Art 21), adequate living standard incl. food (Art 25).

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • The first Indian State to have its Human Development Report prepared and released by Amartya Kumar Sen in Delhi is:Madhya Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                    First State Human Development Report → Madhya Pradesh (1995); it computed the State's HDI and HDI for all its districts.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Indian Human Development Report does not give for each sample village:Unemployment Related Index

                                                                                                                                                    Indian Human Development Report gives education, health, and infrastructure and amenities indices; it has no unemployment-related index.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following States was having the highest Human Development Index in the year 2001?Kerala

                                                                                                                                                    India's first National Human Development Report 2001 (April 2002) → Kerala highest HDI; Kerala still top in 2019, Bihar last. Must know

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • According to Human Development Index of2001, arrange the following States in descending order and select the correct answer from the codes given below:B, A, D, C

                                                                                                                                                    National HDI 2001 → Kerala first, Punjab second, U.P. 13th, Bihar 15th; descending order: Kerala, Punjab, U.P., Bihar.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Assertion (A): Kerala stands first in terms of Human Development Index.Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of(A).

                                                                                                                                                    IHDR 2011 → Kerala first in HDI; 2011 Census → Kerala also had the highest unemployment rate. Both true, but R does not explain A.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following States had the highest Human Development Index in 2008?Uttar Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                    IHDR 2011 (HDI for 2008) → U.P. 18th, Jharkhand 19th, Bihar 21st, Odisha 22nd; U.P. highest among these.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • The value of Human Development Index of Bihar in 2019 was:0.574

                                                                                                                                                    HDI 2019 → Bihar 0.574 (lowest among States); Kerala 0.782 (highest).

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • With reference to the Bare Necessities Index (BNI), consider the following statements:1 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                    Bare Necessities Index (Economic Survey 2020-21) → rural, urban and all-India levels; 26 indicators on five dimensions (not six); not only for 2018.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • As per the fourth edition of State Health Index released by the NITI Aayog in December 2021, which one of the following States performed best among the ‘Smaller States’ category?Mizoram

                                                                                                                                                    NITI Aayog State Health Index, fourth edition (2019-20, released December 2021) → Mizoram best among Smaller States; Kerala and Tamil Nadu top Larger States.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • As per latest ‘Educational Development Index’ released in February 2011, which are the four States at the top?Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Punjab, Delhi

                                                                                                                                                    Education Development Index 2009-10 (released February 2011) → top States: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Punjab, Delhi (UTs Puducherry, Lakshadweep led overall). Must know

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                    • According to the latest survey report, the percentage of school-going children in the age group of 6-14 years is:93 %

                                                                                                                                                    School-going children aged 6-14 → 93% (question period); ASER 2022 → 98.4%.

                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                          • The Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP) of NITI Aayog was launched in:January 2018

                                                                                                                                                          Aspirational Districts Programme (NITI Aayog) → launched January 2018; aims to transform 112 most under-developed districts; districts ranked monthly.

                                                                                                                                                          Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyaan → launched 20 June 2020 from village Telihar, district Khagaria (Bihar); work for returnee migrant workers after COVID-19.

                                                                                                                                                          • Which one is not the true statement about the PM Cares Fund?None of the above/More than one of the above

                                                                                                                                                          PM CARES Fund (March 2020) → public charitable trust; entirely voluntary contributions; no budgetary support; trustees act pro bono; for emergencies. All statements true.
