                                                                                                                                                          • With reference to Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission, consider the following statements:3 only

                                                                                                                                                          Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (27 September 2021) → seamless portability across the country; hospitals are not required to adopt it, and not every citizen must join.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following statements: Statement-I: India's public sector healthcare system largely focuses on curative care with limited preventive, promotive and rehabilitative care. Statement-II: Under India's decentralized approach to healthcare delivery, the States are primarily responsible for organizing health services. Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is not the correct explanation for Statement-I

                                                                                                                                                          India's public healthcare is largely curative (limited preventive/promotive care); States mainly organise health services. Both correct, but II does not explain I.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • What is the name of World’s largest Health Care Scheme launched by Government of India in 2018?Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojna

                                                                                                                                                          World's largest health care scheme → Ayushman Bharat–PM Jan Arogya Yojana (September 2018); covers over 12 crore families (about 55 crore people).

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • With reference to 'Ayushman Bharat Yojana' which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?2 only

                                                                                                                                                          Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY → free health cover of Rs. five lakh per family per year (not per person); cost shared Centre:State 60:40.

                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse The cover is per family, not per person.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which scheme was recognized as world’s largest insurance scheme launched in India in September, 2018?Pradhan Mantri Jan Aarogya Yojana

                                                                                                                                                          PM Jan Aarogya Yojana (Ayushman Bharat) → launched 23 September 2018 at Ranchi; world's largest health assurance scheme; Rs. 5 lakh per family per year.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following is responsible for implementation of 'Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Aarogya Yojana'?National Health Authority

                                                                                                                                                          Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY → implemented by the National Health Authority (NHA); launched at Ranchi, 23 September 2018.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • With reference to the schemes launched by the Union Government, consider the following statements:2 only

                                                                                                                                                          Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (2007) → launched by Ministry of Labour and Employment, not Health; Rajiv Gandhi Shilpi Swasthya Bima Yojana → Ministry of Textiles.

                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse RSBY moved to the Health Ministry only from 1 April 2015; it began under Labour.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana launched under Social Security Act, 2008 covers:only unorganized sector workers

                                                                                                                                                          Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana → health insurance only for unorganized sector workers (BPL); enrolment from 1 April 2008; now subsumed in PM-JAY.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which feature of Chief Minister Chiranjeevi Health Insurance Scheme is incorrect?The disease for which a patient is admitted to a hospital, 5 days prior to that and 10 days after the discharge from the hospital all expenditure on investigation, medicines and consultation fee in the hospital will be included in the package.

                                                                                                                                                          CM Chiranjeevi Scheme (Rajasthan, 1 May 2021) → 1576 packages; Rs. 4.50 lakh/family/year for serious ailments (later Rs. 25 lakh). Incorrect: '5 days before, 10 days after' coverage.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • In case of critical illness, health insurance covered per family per year under the scheme Ayushman Bharat Mahatma Gandhi Rajasthan Swasthaya Bima Yojana is:Rs. 4.50 lakhs

                                                                                                                                                          Ayushman Bharat Mahatma Gandhi Rajasthan Swasthya Bima Yojana (renamed from Bhamashah, 2019) → Rs. 4.50 lakh critical illness, Rs. 50,000 general, per family per year.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which one is not true about AYUSHMAN SAHAKAR Scheme?The Finance Ministry of India launched this scheme

                                                                                                                                                          AYUSHMAN SAHAKAR (19 October 2020) → launched by Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, not Finance; NCDC scheme helping cooperatives build health infrastructure.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • ‘Mission Indradhanush’ launched by the Government of India pertains to:immunization of children and pregnant women

                                                                                                                                                          Mission Indradhanush (25 December 2014, Health Ministry) → immunization of all children and pregnant women; Intensified Mission Indradhanush on 8 October 2017.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • The National Rural Health Mission was launched on:April 12, 2005

                                                                                                                                                          National Rural Health Mission → launched 12 April 2005; in 2013 became a sub-mission of the National Health Mission (with National Urban Health Mission). Must know

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following is not correct about the 'National Rural Health Mission'?The programme was launched during the Eleventh Plan.

                                                                                                                                                          NRHM launched 2005 in the Tenth Five Year Plan (2002-07), not the Eleventh; aims at a functional village-to-district health system incl. drinking water, sanitation. Must know

                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse Don't put NRHM in the Eleventh Plan; 2005 falls in the Tenth Plan (2002-07).

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • The National Rural Health Mission aims to reduce Infant Mortality Rate to:—

                                                                                                                                                          NRHM (2005) target → infant mortality rate of 28 per 1000 live births by 2012.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Under the National Rural Health Mission(NRHM)Scheme, a village level health worker is known as:ASHA

                                                                                                                                                          ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist) → trained female village health worker under NRHM; chosen from the village, preferably aged 25 to 45; links community and health system. Must know

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • National Health Policy was announced in:1983

                                                                                                                                                          First National Health Policy → 1983 (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare); the newer one → National Health Policy 2017.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following is the public expenditure on health as a percentage of GDP in 2009-10 in India?1.09%

                                                                                                                                                          Public health spending, India 2009-10 → 1.09% of GDP (Union 0.39%, States 0.70%); National Health Policy 2017 target: 2.5% of GDP by 2025.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • According to the National Family Health Survey-3, private medical sector is the primary source of healthcare in India for:70% households in urban areas

                                                                                                                                                          NFHS-3 (2005-06) → private sector the main source of healthcare for 70% urban and 63% rural households; NFHS-5 (2019-21) → 51.8% urban.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • As per Family Welfare Statistics for 2009 released recently by the Union Health Ministry, life expectancy at birth in India for 2006-2010 is:Males 65.8 and Females 68.1

                                                                                                                                                          Life expectancy at birth, India 2006-10 → males 65.8 years, females 68.1 years.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following are the objectives of ‘National Nutrition Mission’?1 and 2 only

                                                                                                                                                          National Nutrition Mission (POSHAN Abhiyaan) aims → malnutrition awareness among pregnant women and lactating mothers; cut anaemia in children, adolescent girls, women. Not millets or eggs.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which month of the year is celebrated as Rashtriya Poshan Maah or National Nutrition Month under the Poshan Abhiyaan of the Government of India?September

                                                                                                                                                          Rashtriya Poshan Maah (National Nutrition Month) → September every year, under Poshan Abhiyaan.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following is not a National Nutrition Programme of the Government of India?National Oral Health Programme

                                                                                                                                                          National Oral Health Programme → part of Non-Communicable Disease Control, not nutrition; Iodine Deficiency, Fluorosis and Iron Plus (anaemia) programmes are nutrition programmes.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • 'Shabri Sankalp Abhiyan' is associated with:National Nutrition Mission

                                                                                                                                                          Shabri Sankalp Abhiyan (Uttar Pradesh, 2017) → National Nutrition Mission; campaign to eradicate malnutrition.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following is NOT covered under Integrated Child Development Programme?Family Planning

                                                                                                                                                          ICDS (2 October 1975, Ministry of Women and Child Development) → six services incl. supplementary nutrition, immunization, nutrition and health education; not family planning. Must know

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which among the following services is not provided under Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) scheme?Distribution of freebooks and school dress to the children

                                                                                                                                                          ICDS (1975) → supplementary feeding, pre-school education, immunization, health check-up, referral, health and nutrition education for under-6 children; no free books or school dress.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists:2 1 4 3

                                                                                                                                                          National Programme for Control of Blindness → 1976; ICDS → 1975; National Leprosy Eradication Programme → 1983; National Rural Health Mission → 2005.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the codes given below the lists:—

                                                                                                                                                          PM Jan Arogya Abhiyan → 2018; PM Vaya Vandana Yojana → 2017; PM Rojgar Protsahan Yojana → 2016 (not 2015); Swachh Bharat Abhiyan → 2014.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the code given below:2 4 1 3

                                                                                                                                                          P.M. Garib Kalyan Package → 2020; Muskan Scheme → 2021; Mission Indradhanush → 2014; Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana → 2018.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following Union Ministries recently launched the YUVA2.0 Scheme in 2022?Education Ministry

                                                                                                                                                          YUVA 2.0 (PM's Scheme for Mentoring Young Authors) → Ministry of Education, launched 2 October 2022; mentors authors below 30 years of age.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following schemes are related to the skill development?2, 3 and 4 only

                                                                                                                                                          Skill development schemes → STRIVE, SANKALP, SHREYAS; STRIDE (UGC) → support for research projects, not a skill scheme.

                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse STRIDE vs STRIVE: STRIDE is UGC research; STRIVE is Skills Strengthening for Industrial Value Enhancement.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • ‘Skill Development Initiative’ has been operationalized in?May 2007

                                                                                                                                                          Skill Development Initiative → Ministry of Labour and Employment, May 2007; aim: train 1 million persons in 5 years, then 1 million each year (unorganized sector).

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • With reference to Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana, consider the following statements:2 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                          PMKVY (July 2015) → flagship of Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, run by NSDC; trains soft skills, entrepreneurship, financial and digital literacy; aligns workforce to NSQF.

                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse PMKVY belongs to MSDE, not the Ministry of Labour and Employment.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • ‘Recognition of Prior Learning Scheme’ is sometimes mentioned in the news with reference to:Certifying the skills acquired by construction workers through traditional channels.

                                                                                                                                                          Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) → PMKVY component certifying skills already gained, e.g. construction workers' skills learnt through traditional channels.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • According to the Union Budget 2023-24, how many Skill India International Centres are to be set up across different States to skill youth for international opportunities?30

                                                                                                                                                          Union Budget 2023-24 → 30 Skill India International Centres across States; PMKVY 4.0 for new-age Industry 4.0 courses (coding, AI, robotics, drones).

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • With reference to ‘National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF)’, which of the statements given below is/are correct?2 only

                                                                                                                                                          NSQF → competency framework with levels one to ten; certification via formal, non-formal or informal learning (not only formal); enables mobility between vocational and general education.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following in respect of ‘National Career Service’:Neither 1 nor 2

                                                                                                                                                          National Career Service (20 July 2015) → Mission Mode Project of Ministry of Labour and Employment, not DoPT; one-stop employment services for all citizens, not only uneducated youth.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • With reference to the Skill India Campaign, which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?1 only

                                                                                                                                                          Skill India Campaign → launched by PM on 15 July 2015; managed by NSDC; trains Indians in varied skills, not mainly in information technology.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • As per ‘Skill India Mission’, 76 lakh youth have acquired skill training upto March, 2016. Out of these how many have entered the job market?26 lakh

                                                                                                                                                          Skill India Mission → 76 lakh youth trained till March 2016, of whom 26 lakh got jobs; 556.1 lakh trained till 19 July 2021.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • The foundation of what is being claimed as India’s biggest Global skill park was laid in July 2017 in:Bhopal

                                                                                                                                                          India's biggest Global Skill Park → Bhopal; foundation laid 3 July 2017; Sant Shiromani Ravidas Global Skills Park, the first multi-skills park.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • What is the theme of World Youth Skills Day, 2021?Reimagining Youth Skills Post-Pandemic

                                                                                                                                                          World Youth Skills Day → 15 July (declared by UNGA, 2014); theme 2021: 'Reimagining Youth Skills Post-Pandemic'; 2023: 'Skilling Teachers, Trainers and Youth for a Transformative Future'.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • The National Programme launched on October 10, 2019 by the Indian Government to encourage talented children to enrich their skills is:DHRUV

                                                                                                                                                          DHRUV (PM Innovative Learning Programme) → launched 10 October 2019 to identify and mentor talented children at centres of excellence.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • The Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) is a flagship initiative set up by:NITI Aayog

                                                                                                                                                          Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) → flagship initiative of NITI Aayog to promote a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship across the country. Must know

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • With reference to the programme ‘NIDHI’ which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                          NIDHI (National Initiative for Development and Harnessing Innovations) → DST umbrella programme turning ideas into startups; supports 20 students' startups each year. Both correct.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • 'SWAYAM’, an initiative of the Government of India, aims at:providing affordable and quality education to the citizens for free

                                                                                                                                                          SWAYAM (Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiring Minds) → free, affordable, quality education for all; based on access, equity, quality; bridges the digital divide.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • What is the aim of the programme ‘Unnat Bharat Abhiyan’?Connecting institutions of higher education with local communities to address development challenges through appropriate technologies.

                                                                                                                                                          Unnat Bharat Abhiyan (Ministry of Education) → links higher education institutions (IIITs, NITs, IISERs) with rural communities to solve development problems through appropriate technology.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • What is the purpose of 'Vidyanjali Yojana'?2 only

                                                                                                                                                          Vidyanjali (Ministry of Education) → improve government schools through community and private sector volunteers (diaspora, alumni, retired teachers); not foreign campuses or money donations.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • The 'Apna Gaon,Apna Kam' scheme was launched on:1 January, 1991

                                                                                                                                                          'Apna Gaon, Apna Kam' → Rajasthan, 1 January 1991; aim: remove rural poverty by creating employment and public assets in villages.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Saubhagya Yojana is concerned with:Provision offree electricity to BPL families

                                                                                                                                                          Saubhagya (PM Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana, 25 September 2017) → free electricity connections to households; nodal agency: Rural Electrification Corporation (REC).

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following ministry is associated with 'Saubhagya Scheme', started in 2017?Ministry of Power

                                                                                                                                                          Saubhagya Scheme (2017) → Ministry of Power; universal household electrification; 2.86 crore households electrified by 31 March 2022.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • ‘Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana’ has been launched for:promoting financial inclusion in the country

                                                                                                                                                          PM Jan-Dhan Yojana → National Mission for Financial Inclusion, launched 28 August 2014; a bank account for every family. Must know

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following is true for ‘Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana’?—

                                                                                                                                                          PM Jan-Dhan Yojana (28 August 2014) → RuPay debit card with accident insurance Rs. 1,00,000 (now Rs. 2 lakh for new accounts) and life cover Rs. 30,000.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • List - I List - II—

                                                                                                                                                          Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana → 2007; PM Aatmanirbhar Swasth Bharat Yojana → 2021; PM Jan Aarogya Yojana → 2018; PM Suraksha Bima Yojana → 9 May 2015 (Kolkata).

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Arrange the following schemes launched by Government of India in chronological order and choose the correct answer from the codes given below: I. Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana II. Atal Pension Yojana III. Make in India IV. Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana Codes:—

                                                                                                                                                          Launch order: PM Jan-Dhan Yojana (28 August 2014) → Make in India (25 September 2014) → Sukanya Samriddhi (22 January 2015) → Atal Pension Yojana (9 May 2015).

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following schemes and arrange these in chronological order of their launching:1, 2, 4 and 3

                                                                                                                                                          Launch order: PM Jan-Dhan Yojana (28 August 2014) → Digital Gender Atlas (9 March 2015) → Mudra Bank (8 April 2015) → PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (9 May 2015).

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • In which city ‘Rastriya Vyosree Yojana’ for senior citizens is started in 2017?—

                                                                                                                                                          Rastriya Vyosree (Vayoshri) Yojana → launched 1 April 2017 in Nellore district (Andhra Pradesh) by Social Justice Ministry; physical aids and assisted-living devices for BPL senior citizens.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • How many minimum hours of power supply is assured for rural agriculture purpose in ‘Atal Jyoti Yojana, 2013’?10

                                                                                                                                                          Atal Jyoti Yojana, 2013 (Madhya Pradesh) → at least 10 hours of power supply assured for rural agriculture.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following Direct Benefit Scheme (DBS) has been recognized by the ‘Guinness Book of World Records’ as the world’s largest Direct Benefit Scheme?PAHAL

                                                                                                                                                          PAHAL (Pratyaksha Hastaantarit Laabh) → Guinness record (2015) as world's largest cash transfer scheme; launched 15 November 2014 in 54 districts by Petroleum Ministry.

                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)
