                                                                                                                                                                Employment & Welfare Schemes · part 2 of 5

                                                                                                                                                                42 facts · 57 questions · 12 Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                                • Choose the correct answer in the context of PAHAL scheme:All these are true.

                                                                                                                                                                PAHAL → LPG subsidy paid directly into customers' bank accounts (DBT); first scheme using JAM (Jan Dhan, Aadhaar, Mobile); all statements true.

                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid JAM = Jan Dhan + Aadhaar + Mobile.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer by using the codes given below the lists.i iv ii iii

                                                                                                                                                                Nai Roshni → minority women empowerment (2012-13); DISHA → IT training; PM Jan-Dhan Yojana → financial inclusion; Swavalamban (2010) → New Pension System. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements about the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana: A. The scheme provides free LPG connection to the women belonging to below poverty line (BPL) households. B. Rs. 8000 crore has been earmarked under the scheme. C. The scheme provides a financial support of Rs. 2,800 for each LPG connection to the BPL households. D. The scheme will benefit 5 crore families across the nation. Which of the above statements are correct?Only A, B and D

                                                                                                                                                                PM Ujjwala Yojana (1 May 2016, Ballia, U.P.) → free LPG connections to BPL women; Rs. 8000 crore; 5 crore families. Wrong: Rs. 2,800 support per connection. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Ujjwala tagline: 'Swachh Indhan Behtar Jeevan' (clean fuel, better life).

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Which organization is giving financial support for ‘Tejaswini Rural Women’s Empowerment Programme’?IFAD

                                                                                                                                                                Tejaswini Rural Women's Empowerment Programme (Madhya Pradesh) → financed by IFAD (International Fund for Agricultural Development); strengthens women's SHGs.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Panch Dhara Yojana is related to:Women Welfare and Development

                                                                                                                                                                Panch Dhara Yojana → Madhya Pradesh, November 1991; development of rural and tribal women.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • ‘Beti Bachao Beti Padhao’ scheme has been launched in India in:January, 2015

                                                                                                                                                                Beti Bachao Beti Padhao → launched 22 January 2015 at Panipat (Haryana); tackles declining Child Sex Ratio; joint effort of WCD, Health and HRD ministries.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Name the scheme launched by Central Government for the Girl-child.Dhan-Lakshmi

                                                                                                                                                                Dhan-Lakshmi Yojana → Centre's girl-child scheme, 3 March 2008 (Ministry of Women and Child Development); insurance cover to discourage child marriage and encourage education.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Which State has launched ‘Bhagyashree’scheme for girl child?Maharashtra

                                                                                                                                                                Bhagyashree Scheme → Maharashtra, 8 March 2015, for BPL girls; replaced the State's 'Sukanya' scheme.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Which State Government has rolled out ‘Rupashree Scheme’ for marriage of poor girls?West Bengal

                                                                                                                                                                Rupashree Prakalpa → West Bengal; one-time grant of Rs. 25,000 for marriage of adult daughters of poor families; in effect from 1 April 2018.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements about Amma Scooter Scheme:—

                                                                                                                                                                Amma Scooter Scheme (Tamil Nadu, AIADMK Govt) → launched by PM Modi, 24 February 2018, Chennai, on Jayalalithaa's 70th birth anniversary; 50% subsidy (up to Rs. 25,000) statewide.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • The scheme ‘DWCRA’is associated with:Upliftment of women living below poverty line

                                                                                                                                                                DWCRA (Development of Women and Children in Rural Areas, 1982-83) → upliftment of rural BPL women through financial help and self-employment.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Swawlamban Scheme fulfills which of the following objectives?Providing skill and training to the women

                                                                                                                                                                Swawlamban (1982-83, earlier NORAD-assisted Mahila Aarthik Karykram) → training and skills for women in traditional and non-traditional trades, for employment or self-employment. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse With the 2010 Swavalamban scheme for workers (pension).

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Two of the schemes launched by the Government of India for women’s development are Swadhar and Swayam Siddha.As regards the difference between them, consider the following statements:Neither 1 nor 2

                                                                                                                                                                Swayam Siddha (2001) → holistic empowerment of women through SHGs; Swadhar → women in difficult circumstances. The question swaps them, so neither statement is correct. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • For empowerment of women Indira Mahila Shakti Nidhi was launched on:18 December, 2019

                                                                                                                                                                Indira Mahila Shakti Nidhi → Rajasthan, 18 December 2019 (Budget 2019-20); Rs. 1,000 crore fund for women's enterprises, skills and rehabilitation of victims.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Recently (in 2013) Government of India has approved the proposal of providing loans to Women Self Help Groups at a lowerinterest rate to eradicatepoverty through women empowerment. The interest rate is:7%

                                                                                                                                                                5 May 2013 → Government announced bank loans to Women SHGs at 7% interest, under the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM).

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following is not correctly matched?Women Empire Plan – 1989

                                                                                                                                                                Wrong pair: Women Empire Plan – 1989. Correct: Mahila Samridhi Yojana – 2 October 1993; Mahila Swa-shakti (Women Self-Empowerment) Project – 1998, IFAD-aided.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Match List I with List II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists:4 3 1 2

                                                                                                                                                                Rashtriya Mahila Kosh → credit needs of poor women; Mahila Samriddhi Yojana → savings among rural women; Indira Mahila Yojana → empowerment; Mahila Samakhya → education for women's equality.

                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Kosh (fund) gives credit; Samriddhi (prosperity) builds savings.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Mahila Samriddhi Yojana was started in India in:1993

                                                                                                                                                                Mahila Samriddhi Yojana → 2 October 1993, thrift/micro-finance for rural women; merged with Indira Mahila Yojana into Mahila Swayam Siddhi Yojana on 12 July 2001.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017?3 only

                                                                                                                                                                Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017 → 26 weeks paid leave for first two children (up to 8 weeks before delivery); 12 weeks after two children. Only statement 3 correct.

                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse Not '3 months before + 3 months after': it is 26 weeks, of which at most 8 before delivery.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • The proposed ‘Janani Suraksha Scheme’ will replace:National Maternity Benefit Scheme

                                                                                                                                                                Janani Suraksha Yojana (April 2005) → replaced National Maternity Benefit Scheme; safe motherhood under NRHM; cuts maternal and neo-natal mortality by promoting institutional delivery. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • The endeavour of‘Janani Suraksha Yojana’Programme is:1 and 2 only

                                                                                                                                                                Janani Suraksha Yojana → promotes institutional deliveries and gives the mother money for delivery cost; no compensation for wage loss during pregnancy.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements in relation to Janani Suraksha Yojana:Only two

                                                                                                                                                                Janani Suraksha Yojana → reduce maternal and neonatal mortality and promote institutional delivery among poor pregnant women; not a State Health Department scheme, not sick-infant care.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • The ambitious scheme launched in June, 2011 by the Government of India to provide free healthcare facilities to pregnant women and infants has been named as:Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram

                                                                                                                                                                Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (1 June 2011) → free, cashless care in Government institutions for pregnant women (normal and caesarean delivery) and sick newborns up to 30 days.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • In which of the following scheme, the main objective is to promote the use of appropriate methods, care and services during pregnancy, safe delivery and lactation period to improve the health and nutritional status of pregnant and lactating women and their infants (0-6 months)?Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana

                                                                                                                                                                Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (revamped Indira Gandhi Matritva Sahyog Yojana) → conditional DBT aid to pregnant/lactating mothers for first live birth (second if girl).

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • The nation-wise breast-feeding programme ‘MAA’has been launched by which Union Ministry?Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

                                                                                                                                                                'MAA' (Mother's Absolute Affection) → Ministry of Health and Family Welfare's nationwide programme to promote breastfeeding.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following is not an income generating program for women?Integrated Rural Energy Programme

                                                                                                                                                                Integrated Rural Energy Programme → minimum domestic energy (cooking, heating, lighting) for rural people, not income generation; IRDP and DWCRA → income-generating programmes for women.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • ABC index announced by the Government of India is associated with which of the following?Health

                                                                                                                                                                ABC index (Achievements of Babies and Children) → child health; unweighted average of four indicators: survival, immunization, nutrition, schooling. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • ‘Gokul Gram Scheme’ is associated with which of the following States?Gujarat

                                                                                                                                                                Gokul Gram Scheme → Gujarat (1995-96); basic infrastructure and better environment for all villages.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following items of work are included in Bharat Nirman? Find your answer with the help of given codes.1, 2 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                Bharat Nirman (December 2005) → irrigation, drinking water, electrification, roads, housing, rural telephony; irrigation covers AIBP, river-linking, water-body restoration. Excludes: displaced-person rehabilitation, sanitation, Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, agro-industries. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Six parts 'I-D-E-R-H-T': Irrigation, Drinking water, Electricity, Roads, Housing, Telephony.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 10 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Bharat Nirman includes (select the correct answer from the codes given below) :1 and 3 are correct

                                                                                                                                                                Bharat Nirman (2005-06 to 2008-09; Phase-II to 2012) → 1 crore (10 million) hectares more irrigation; telephones for remaining villages. Wrong: roads to all 2000-population villages. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • National Rural Drinking Water Programme is one of the components of:Bharat Nirman

                                                                                                                                                                National Rural Drinking Water Programme (renamed from ARWSP of 1972-73, on 1 April 2009) → the drinking water component of Bharat Nirman.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Jal Jeevan Mission Scheme was declared in the Union Budget of which Financial Year?2019-20

                                                                                                                                                                Jal Jeevan Mission (Ministry of Jal Shakti) → Union Budget 2019-20; launched 15 August 2019; tap water to every rural household by 2024 ('Har Ghar Nal Se Jal').

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements with reference to Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT) Scheme:Only 2

                                                                                                                                                                AMRUT (June 2015) → five hundred cities covering over 60% of India's urban population (not 400 cities); revamps urban infrastructure. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • The Thrust Areas of Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT) include:1, 2, 3, 4 and 5

                                                                                                                                                                AMRUT thrust areas → water supply, sewerage/septage, storm water drains, public transport, green spaces and parks for children (all five).

                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Five W-S-S-T-P: Water, Sewerage, Storm drain, Transport, Parks.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • The State who launched ‘Atal Khadyanna Yojana’is:Uttarakhand

                                                                                                                                                                Atal Khadyanna Yojana → Uttarakhand (2011); 10 kg wheat + 10 kg rice a month; APL pay Rs. 4/6 per kg, BPL Rs. 2/3 per kg.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following States introduced ‘One kg rice for rupee one’ scheme?Tamil Nadu

                                                                                                                                                                'One kg rice for rupee one' → Tamil Nadu (2008), the first such scheme; later Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh followed.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • India is home to lakhs of persons with disabilities. What are the benefits available to them under the law?1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                Persons with disabilities (Acts of 1995 and 2016) → free schooling till 18 years, preferential land for business, ramps in public buildings: all three.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan is associated with:Disable Persons

                                                                                                                                                                Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan (Accessible India Campaign, 2015) → universal accessibility for persons with disabilities; by DEPwD, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • The objective of ‘Sangam Yojana’is:To ensure welfare of handicapped

                                                                                                                                                                Sangam Yojana (15 August 1996) → welfare of the handicapped; rural disabled persons form a 'Sangam' group, each given Rs. 15000 for economic activities. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse Nothing to do with Allahabad's Sangam or Ganga cleaning.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • ‘Sankalp’ project is associated with the eradication of:AIDS/HIV

                                                                                                                                                                'Sankalp' project → eradication of HIV/AIDS; run jointly by Hindustan Latex Ltd. and Employees' State Insurance Corporation. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • A village in the plain area of India comes under the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojna, ifits population is more than:500

                                                                                                                                                                PMGSY (25 December 2000) → all-weather roads to unconnected rural habitations of 500+ population in plains (separate limit for hill, desert, tribal areas). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                • The Budget 2001-02 has allocated to the PMGSY a sum of:Rs. 2,500 crore

                                                                                                                                                                PMGSY (since 25 December 2000) → Budget 2001-02 gave Rs. 2,500 crore; Budgets 2023-24 and 2024-25 gave Rs. 19000 crore each.

                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      Employment & Welfare Schemes · part 3 of 5

                                                                                                                                                                      50 facts · 64 questions · 8 Must know

                                                                                                                                                                      Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                                      • ‘Pradhan Mantri Gramodaya Yojana’aims at:meeting rural needs like primary education, health care, drinking water, housing, rural roads.

                                                                                                                                                                      Pradhan Mantri Gramodaya Yojana (2000-01) → rural needs in five areas: primary education, health care, drinking water, housing, rural roads. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following scheme is an attempt to make rural areas socially economically and physically sustainable regions?Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission (SPMRM)

                                                                                                                                                                      Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission (2016) → make selected rural areas socially, economically and physically sustainable regions (economic, social, basic, digital amenities).

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following (Scheme-Year) is not correctly matched?Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission – 2015

                                                                                                                                                                      Wrong pair: Rurban Mission – 2015 (launched 2016). Correct: Rural Housing Interest Subsidy Scheme – 2017; Sansad Adarsh Gram Yojana – 2014; DDU-GKY – 2014.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following is correctly matched?Etawah Pilot Project – Albert Mayer

                                                                                                                                                                      Etawah Pilot Project → Albert Mayer (USA); conceived 1947, started September 1948 at Mahewa village; 64 villages, later 97.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • The pilot project for rural development was started in the year:1948

                                                                                                                                                                      Pilot project for rural development (Etawah) → September 1948, Mahewa village (U.P.); originator Lt. Col. Albert Mayer; aided by U.P. Government and USA's Point-4 programme.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Deen Dayal Gram Jyoti Yojna inaugurated for:—

                                                                                                                                                                      Deen Dayal Upadhyay Gram Jyoti Yojana (Patna, 25 July 2015) → rational electricity supply to rural farm and non-farm consumers; aids rural education, health, sanitation, empowerment.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • The Employment Guarantee Scheme, a rural work programme, was first started in:Mahrashtra

                                                                                                                                                                      Employment Guarantee Scheme → first started by Maharashtra (Government Resolution, 28 March 1972), part of its 15 Point Programme.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • The Employment Assurance Scheme envisages financial assistance to rural areas for guaranteeing employment to at least:one man and one woman in a rural family living below the poverty line

                                                                                                                                                                      Employment Assurance Scheme (2 October 1993, 1778 backward blocks) → wage work for at most two adults per BPL rural family (one man and one woman).

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following schemes is not for rural development?CRY

                                                                                                                                                                      CRY (Child Rights and You) → an NGO for child rights, not a rural development scheme; TRYSEM, JRY, IRDP → rural development schemes.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Consider the following Schemes:II-IV-III-I

                                                                                                                                                                      Order of launch: TRYSEM (August 1979; rural youth aged 18-35) → RLEGP (15 August 1983) → JRY (April 1989) → EAS (latest).

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • TRYSEM is a programme of:Rural Development

                                                                                                                                                                      TRYSEM (Training of Rural Youth for Self-Employment, August 1979) → rural development; a component of IRDP; merged into SGSY in April 1999.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following is not a anti-poverty programme?M.R.T.P.

                                                                                                                                                                      MRTP (Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices) Act, 1969 → controls monopolies, not an anti-poverty programme; RLEGP, IRDP, NREP → anti-poverty programmes.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • The Rural Infrastructure Development Fund (RIDF) has been created under;NABARD

                                                                                                                                                                      Rural Infrastructure Development Fund → created in and administered by NABARD (1995-96, corpus Rs. 2,000 crore); 39 eligible activities; rural industries are not a RIDF programme. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Jawahar Rozgar Yojana was introduced in:Seventh Five Year Plan

                                                                                                                                                                      Jawahar Rozgar Yojana → 1 April 1989, Seventh Plan (1985-90), by merging NREP and RLEGP; replaced by Jawahar Gram Samridhi Yojana on 1 April 1999.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following is true regarding the Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (JRY)?Under the scheme 30% of the employment generated is reserved for women

                                                                                                                                                                      Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (1 April 1989, PM Rajiv Gandhi) → extra wage employment in rural areas; Centre:State cost 80:20; 30% of jobs reserved for women. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                      Don't confuse Launched under Rajiv Gandhi, not Indira Gandhi; meant for the rural, not urban, poor.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following pairs is not correctly matched?JRY – April, 1995

                                                                                                                                                                      Wrong pair: JRY – April 1995; JRY began 1 April 1989 (NREP + RLEGP). Correct: TRYSEM – August 1979; NREP – October 1980; SGSY – April 1999.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • The mainaimofthe IRDP(Integrated Rural Development Programme) is:To provide employment to the households living below the poverty line in rural areas

                                                                                                                                                                      IRDP → begun 1978-79, nationwide from 2 October 1980; aim: lift rural BPL households above the poverty line through income-generating assets/self-employment.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following programmes is not included in the Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY)?JRY

                                                                                                                                                                      SGSY (April 1999) restructured IRDP, TRYSEM, DWCRA, Million Wells Scheme, SITRA and Ganga Kalyan Yojana; JRY was not included. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Swarnajayanti Gram SwarojgarYojana (SGSY) –All the four

                                                                                                                                                                      SGSY (1 April 1999) → merged six programmes (IRDP, TRYSEM, DWCRA, SITRA, GKY, MWS); group approach; skill upgradation; lift BPL families above poverty line. All four correct. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following schemes has been restructured as National Rural Livelihood Mission, launched in June, 2011 by the Government of India?Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana

                                                                                                                                                                      National Rural Livelihood Mission (June 2011) → restructured SGSY; fully replaced it from 1 April 2013; renamed DAY-NRLM on 29 March 2016.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • How does the National Rural Livelihood Mission seek to improve livelihood options of rural poor?2 only

                                                                                                                                                                      NRLM (DAY-NRLM) → better rural livelihoods by strengthening SHGs and skill development; aims to cover 7 crore poor households; no new industries or free farm inputs.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following pairs is not correctly matched?—

                                                                                                                                                                      Wrong pairs: SJSRY (1 December 1997) → urban, not rural, employment; social security is not part of Bharat Nirman. Correct: SIDBI – industrial finance; NABARD – rural credit.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Schemes of(i) Urban Micro Enterprises, (ii) Urban Wage Employment, and (iii) Housing and Shelter Upgradation are parts of:Nehru Rojgar Yojana

                                                                                                                                                                      Nehru Rojgar Yojana (October 1989, end of Seventh Plan) → urban poor; three schemes: Urban Micro Enterprises, Urban Wage Employment, Housing and Shelter Upgradation.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • The Swarnajayanti Shahari Rozgar Yojana which came into operation from 1-12-1997 aims to provide gainful employment to the urban unemployed or underemployed poor but does not include:Prime Minister’s Rozgar Yojana

                                                                                                                                                                      SJSRY (1 December 1997) → subsumed Nehru Rozgar Yojana, Urban Basic Services for the Poor and PM's Integrated Urban Poverty Eradication Programme; not PM's Rozgar Yojana.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the codes given below the lists:4 3 2 1

                                                                                                                                                                      Krishi Shramik Samajik Suraksha Yojana → 2001; SGSY → 1999; Employment Assurance Scheme → 1993; PM Gramodaya Yojana → 2000.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the codes given below the lists:3 1 2 4

                                                                                                                                                                      SGSY → 1999; Swarnajayanti Shahari Rozgar Yojana → 1997; Jawahar Rozgar Yojana → 1989; National Rural Health Mission → 2005.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the code given below the lists.2 1 4 3

                                                                                                                                                                      National Rural Health Mission → 2005; National Social Assistance Programme → 1995; SGSY → 1999; Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana → 2001.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following pairs is not correctly matched?MGNREGA m 2003

                                                                                                                                                                      Wrong pair: MGNREGA – 2003. NREGA 2005 in force 2 February 2006, renamed MGNREGA 2 October 2009. Correct: Janshree Bima – 2000; NRHM – 2005; Aam Aadmi Bima – 2007.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following programmes is not employment related?RMSA

                                                                                                                                                                      RMSA (Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan, March 2009) → secondary education, not employment; MGNREGA, NRLM, STEP (for women, 1986-87) → employment programmes.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act was passed in:2005

                                                                                                                                                                      NREGA → passed 23 August 2005; in force 2 February 2006 in 200 districts (330 in 2007-08); all-India from 1 April 2008; renamed MGNREGA 2 October 2009. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following is the objective of MGNREGA?None of the above/More than one of the above

                                                                                                                                                                      MGNREGA → livelihood security: at least 100 days of wage work a year per rural household (unskilled manual work); builds durable assets; a legal right, not just a scheme. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Tick mark which is incorrect about NREGA:Like in other government programmes transparency and accountability is also not possible in this programme.

                                                                                                                                                                      Incorrect about NREGA: 'transparency and accountability not possible' – the Act has many built-in transparency and accountability measures. It lists permitted works and guarantees employment.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Budget allocation for MGNREGA in the financial year 2009-10 is:Rs. 39,000 crore

                                                                                                                                                                      MGNREGA allocation, Budget 2009-10 → Rs. 39,100 crore (option Rs. 39,000 crore), 149% more than Rs. 16,000 crore in 2008-09.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • In recently announced Central Budget 2020-21, in which among the following budget allocation has been decreased in comparison to Budget 2019-20?Ayushman

                                                                                                                                                                      Budget 2020-21 vs 2019-20 → only PMJAY-Ayushman Bharat allocation fell (from Rs. 6556 crore); MGNREGA rose (60000 → 61500 crore); Mid-day Meal unchanged; Ganga plan rose.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • With reference to the scheme wise allocation in the 2023- 24 Union Budget, which of the following statement/s is/ are correct?Neither 1 nor 2

                                                                                                                                                                      Budget 2023-24 → steepest % cut: Atma Nirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana (not MGNREGA); highest % growth: Reform Linked Distribution Scheme (not Jal Jeevan Mission). Neither statement correct.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • National Rural EmploymentGuaranteeAct (NREGA)does not:Guarantee 100 days employment in a year to every adult member of a rural household

                                                                                                                                                                      MGNREGA → guarantees 100 days of wage employment a year to each rural household (not to every adult member) whose adults do unskilled manual work.

                                                                                                                                                                      Don't confuse The 100 days are per household, not per adult member.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Consider the following statements about positive results of MGNREGA:Only 1 and 3 are correct

                                                                                                                                                                      MGNREGA results → higher rural wages and purchasing power, less distress migration to cities, more (not less) bargaining power for labourers.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Consider the following statements regarding Indira Gandhi Urban Employment Guarantee Scheme:Only (i) is correct.

                                                                                                                                                                      Indira Gandhi Urban Employment Guarantee Scheme (Rajasthan, 2022) → 100 days (125 days from 2023) of work a year per urban family; work within 15 days of registration, not 30.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • ..... Instil into the vast millions of workers, men and women, who actually do the job, a sense of partnership and of cooperative performance..." The above passage related to:Community Development

                                                                                                                                                                      Passage on giving workers 'a sense of partnership and cooperative performance' → Community Development; India's Community Development Programme began 1952 with Ford Foundation help.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • What is the objective of Community Development Programmes?None of the above/More than one of the above

                                                                                                                                                                      Community Development Programme (2 October 1952) → multi-purpose overall rural development: agriculture, animal husbandry, irrigation, education, health, living conditions; so more than one option fits.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Consider the following events and arrange these in chronological order: I. Launching of Community Development Programme (CDP) II. Recommendation of Democratic Decentralization III. Initiation of Key Village Scheme (KVS) IV. Setting up of District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) at district level. Select correct answer from the code given below: Code:III, I, II, IV

                                                                                                                                                                      Chronology: Key Village Scheme → Community Development Programme (October 1952) → Democratic Decentralization (Balwant Rai Mehta Committee, 1957) → DRDA at district level. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • The launching of Community Development Programme (on 2nd October, 1952) set the stage for:Organization of Panchayati Raj

                                                                                                                                                                      Community Development Programme (2 October 1952) → set the stage for organization of Panchayati Raj.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Who among the following was the architect of community development in India?S.K. Dey

                                                                                                                                                                      Architect of community development in India → S.K. Dey, first Cooperative and Panchayati Raj Minister; Community Development Programme began 1952 under PM Nehru.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • In which year was the ‘National Extension Service’ launched?1953

                                                                                                                                                                      National Extension Service → 1953; begun because the Community Development Programme (1952) could not cover all India for lack of funds; wider coverage at less cost.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following was established as the first programme of community development?National Extension Service

                                                                                                                                                                      Among the options, National Extension Service (1953) → the first programme of community development; Cooperation Movement and IRDP are not.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Antyodaya Programme was started first of all in the State of:Rajasthan

                                                                                                                                                                      Antyodaya Programme → first started by Rajasthan (1977-78); 'Antyodaya' = rise (Udaya) of the poorest of the poor.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • With reference to the government's welfare schemes, consider the following statements:1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                      All true then: Antyodaya → wheat Rs. 2/kg, rice Rs. 3/kg; Old Age Pension → Rs. 75/month Central share; BPL family → 25 kg grain monthly below half cost.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Regarding ‘Atal Pension Yojana’, which of the following statements is/are correct?1 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                      Atal Pension Yojana (9 May 2015) → minimum guaranteed pension (Rs. 1000-5000/month) mainly for unorganized workers; same pension to spouse after subscriber's death.

                                                                                                                                                                      Don't confuse Statement 'only one family member can join' is wrong.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Who among the following can join the National Pension System (NPS)?All State Government employees joining the services after the date of notification by the respective State Governments

                                                                                                                                                                      NPS (regulated by PFRDA) → citizens (resident or non-resident) and OCIs aged 18-70; Central staff (not Armed Forces) joining from 1 January 2004; State staff after State notification.

                                                                                                                                                                      Don't confuse Armed Forces are excluded, and the Central date is 1 January 2004, not 1 April 2004.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following statements is NOT correct for National Pension Scheme for Retail Traders/ Shopkeepers and Self-employed persons?National Pension Scheme's member are also eligible

                                                                                                                                                                      PM Laghu Vyapari Maan-dhan (NPS-Traders, 2019) → traders/self-employed aged 18-40, turnover up to Rs. 1.5 crore; voluntary, contributory; minimum pension Rs. 3000/month. NPS members not eligible.

                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)
