                                                                                                                                                                            Hour 30 →

                                                                                                                                                                            Hour 30 of 72 · Learn

                                                                                                                                                                            Employment & Welfare Schemes · part 4 of 5

                                                                                                                                                                            45 facts · 58 questions · 11 Must know

                                                                                                                                                                            Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                                            • When was the 'PM Kisan Maan-dhan Yojana' launched for the purpose of pension to small and marginal farmers?12 September, 2019

                                                                                                                                                                            PM Kisan Maan-dhan Yojana → launched 12 September 2019 at Ranchi; small and marginal farmers get Rs. 3000/month pension after age 60; spouse gets 50% on death.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • In Pradhan Mantri ShramYogi Maan-dhan Scheme, each subscriber shall receive the minimum assured pension of ......... per month after attaining the age of 60 years.Rs. 3,000

                                                                                                                                                                            PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (2019) → voluntary, contributory pension for unorganized sector workers; minimum assured pension Rs. 3000 per month after age 60.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Ashraya Bima Yojana aims to provide:social security to such workers who got unemployed

                                                                                                                                                                            Ashraya Bima Yojana (2001) → insurance for workers who lose jobs; up to 30% of annual salary paid till new work is found or for one year, whichever is earlier.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Aam Aadmi Bima Yojna provides social security to:all landless labourers living below the poverty line in rural areas

                                                                                                                                                                            Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (2 October 2007) → social security for rural landless BPL labourers; head or an earning member aged 18-59 insured; run with States/UTs and LIC. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • With reference to 'Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana', consider the following statements:1 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                            Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (2 October 2007) → insures head or earning member of a rural landless household; scholarship for up to two children from class 9. Wrong: age 30-65. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Consider the following:1, 2, 3 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                            ESI Scheme (ESI Act, 1948) → social insurance for sickness, maternity, disablement, employment-injury death; covers employees of hotels, motor transport, newspapers, private medical institutions (all four).

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • In which one of the following years the Unorganised Workers’ Social Security Act was passed?2008

                                                                                                                                                                            Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act → passed by Parliament in 2008; notified 30 December 2008. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Which one of the following is not a social security programme?Swarnajayanti Shahari Rozgar Yojana (SJSRY)

                                                                                                                                                                            SJSRY → employment generation, not social security; Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana, National Health Insurance Scheme, Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act 2008 → social security.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Which one of the following is not a recent measure for social protection?Skill Development Programme

                                                                                                                                                                            Skill Development Programme → vocational training, not social protection; RSBY, Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana, Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act 2008 → social protection measures.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Which one of the following statements is not true about Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojna?It is open to anyone between the age of 18 and 50 years

                                                                                                                                                                            PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (Budget 2015-16) → personal accident cover, ages 18-70 (not 18-50); premium Rs. 12 a year; announced with PMJJBY and Atal Pension Yojana.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Which of the following is not an Employment Generation and Poverty Alleviation Programme of Government of India?NSSF (National Social Security Fund)

                                                                                                                                                                            National Social Security Fund (2011, Rs. 1000 crore) → social security for unorganized workers, not an employment/poverty programme; MGNREGA, NRLM, SJSRY are.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Choose the incorrect match:None of the above

                                                                                                                                                                            All matched: HRIDAY → Heritage City Development and Augmentation Yojana; SEHAT → Social Endeavour for Health and Telemedicine; AMRUT → Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Which of the following is not correctly matched?Swachh Safe drinking water Bharat Mission

                                                                                                                                                                            Wrong pair: Swachh Bharat Mission – safe drinking water; SBM (2 October 2014) is for sanitation. Correct: UDAY – discom finances; HRIDAY – heritage cities; AMRUT – urban infrastructure.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Swachh Bharat Abhiyan aims to achieve the target of 'Clean India' by the year:2019

                                                                                                                                                                            Swachh Bharat Mission → began 2 October 2014; target Open Defecation Free 'Clean India' by 2 October 2019 (Gandhi's 150th birth anniversary); Rural and Urban parts. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • The second phase of the Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) is to be implemented during which time period?2020-21 to 2024-25

                                                                                                                                                                            Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase II → from 1 April 2020, period 2020-21 to 2024-25; outlay Rs. 1,40,881 crore; ODF Plus, solid and liquid waste management.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Rural Sanitation Strategy launched by Ministry of Jal Shakti in September, 2019 relates to which of the following periods?2019-2029

                                                                                                                                                                            10-Year Rural Sanitation Strategy (2019-2029) → launched 27 September 2019 by DDWS, Ministry of Jal Shakti, to sustain SBM-G behaviour change.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • With reference to Swachh Bharat Mission, which of the following statement/ts is/are correct?Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                            Swachh Bharat Mission (2014) → focuses on collective behaviour change of the whole community, since rural open defecation is tied to morning walks, crop checks, socializing. Both correct.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Which Abhiyan has been inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on 15th September, 2018?Swachhata Hi Seva

                                                                                                                                                                            'Swachhata Hi Seva' → countrywide awareness campaign launched by PM Modi on 15 September 2018; held from 15 September to 2 October.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Which of the following cities was not conferred with fivestar garbage-free city rank according to Swachh Survekshan, 2022?None of the above

                                                                                                                                                                            Swachh Survekshan 2022 → Indore first 7-star garbage-free city; Surat, Bhopal, Navi Mumbai, Mysuru, Vishakhapatnam, Tirupati got 5-star; so none of the options is excluded.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Which one offollowing city was not among the top three cleanest cities in more than one lakh population category in Swachh Survekshan 2021?Tirupati

                                                                                                                                                                            Swachh Survekshan 2021 (1 lakh+ population) → Indore first, Surat second, Vijayawada third; Tirupati not in top three. 2023 → Indore and Surat joint first, Navi Mumbai third.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Uttar Pradesh has secured which place in Swachh Survekshan, 2021?Sixth

                                                                                                                                                                            Swachh Survekshan 2021 → Uttar Pradesh sixth among States with 100+ Urban Local Bodies; in 2023 U.P. ranked 9th and Maharashtra was the cleanest State.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • According to the Rural Cleanliness Survey, which State is at the top of ladder as far as cleanliness is concerned?Telangana

                                                                                                                                                                            Rural cleanliness survey → Sikkim was top at question time; Swachh Survekshan Grameen 2022 → Telangana 1st, Haryana 2nd, Tamil Nadu 3rd among larger States.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Following are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and other as Reason (R):Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of(A)

                                                                                                                                                                            Rural people do not see open defecation as a threat (A true); purity-pollution norms kept toilets out of homes (R true); R does not explain A.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Nirmal Bharat Abhiyan Yojana is associated with:None of the above

                                                                                                                                                                            Nirmal Bharat Abhiyan → sanitation programme revamping Total Sanitation Campaign to make India Open Defecation Free (WASH approach); so 'none of the above'.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • The objective of Nirmal Gram Puraskar Yojna is:Defecation sanitation

                                                                                                                                                                            Nirmal Gram Puraskar (October 2003; first awards 2005) → incentive award for fully sanitized, open defecation free Panchayats, Blocks, Districts, States under Total Sanitation Campaign.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • 'Rashtriya GarimaAbhiyaan' is a national campaign to:eradicate the practice of manual scavenging and rehabilitate the manual scavengers

                                                                                                                                                                            Rashtriya Garima Abhiyaan → eradicate manual scavenging and rehabilitate manual scavengers (per the 2013 Act prohibiting manual scavenging).

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Toilet revolution is:To provide subsidy and loans by Government to the persons constructing flush toilets in villages and cities

                                                                                                                                                                            Toilet revolution → Government subsidy and loans for building flush toilets in villages and cities, to prevent infectious diseases.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Consider the following statements related to Integrated Low Cost Sanitation (ILCS) scheme: I. The system is funded on sharing basis. II. Central subsidy is 75 percent. III. State subsidy is 25 percent. Of these, the correct statements are:I and II only

                                                                                                                                                                            Integrated Low Cost Sanitation (1980-81) → end dry latrines and free manual scavengers; funded on sharing basis with 75% Central subsidy; State subsidy is not 25%.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • National Social Assistance Programme does not include the following scheme for ‘Below Poverty Line’ householdsMahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojna

                                                                                                                                                                            National Social Assistance Programme (15 August 1995, Article 41) → includes National Family Benefit Scheme, Annapurna, old age pension; not Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Consider the following statements with reference to Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS):1 only

                                                                                                                                                                            IGNOAPS (19 November 2007) → BPL persons aged 60+ (lowered from 65 on 1 April 2011); Central pension initially Rs. 200/month, not Rs. 300.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • The objective of 'Minimum Needs Programme' is to provide the infrastructure to:Rural-Urban Population

                                                                                                                                                                            Minimum Needs Programme (Fifth Plan, 1974-78) → basic services for rural and urban population; 'investment in human' approach; social forestry not included. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Which of the following is not a measure of reducing inequalities?Liberalization of economy

                                                                                                                                                                            Liberalization of economy → economic reform, not a measure to reduce inequality; Minimum Needs Programme, taxation, land reforms → reduce inequality. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Consider the following statements regarding the SVAMITVAscheme:1 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                            SVAMITVA → Central Sector Scheme of Ministry of Panchayati Raj (not Mines); drone mapping of rural Abadi land; 'Record of Rights' to owners. Incorrect: statements 1 and 3.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Time span of‘Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana’is:—

                                                                                                                                                                            PM Awas Yojana → launched June 2015 for 'Housing for All' by 2022 (span 2015-2022 at question time); Urban and Gramin parts. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • The salient feature of Indira Awas Yojana is:Providing awas to SC at cheaper cost

                                                                                                                                                                            Indira Awas Yojana (1985, part of RLEGP) → houses for rural BPL SCs/STs and freed bonded labourers at cheaper cost; in JRY from 1989; independent from 1 January 1996.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • ‘Rajiv Awas Yojana (RAY)’that was started in 2011 has been granted extension till:2022

                                                                                                                                                                            Rajiv Awas Yojana (June 2011) → 'Slum free India'; preparatory phase till June 2013; extended till 2022. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • When the Kendriya Vidyalayas were established?1963

                                                                                                                                                                            Kendriya Vidyalayas → scheme approved November 1962 (Second Central Pay Commission); formally set up 15 December 1963 as 'Central Schools'.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya Yojana was started in:2004

                                                                                                                                                                            Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (2004) → schooling for girls, mainly SC, ST, OBC, minority, in educationally backward blocks with low female rural literacy.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • UNO has fixed the target for ‘Education for All’ till the year—

                                                                                                                                                                            'Education for All' (Millennium Development Goal 2) → every child to complete primary schooling by 2015; SDG target 4.1 carries it forward.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan for universalization of elementary education was launched by Government of India in the year:2001

                                                                                                                                                                            Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (2001) → universal elementary education for children aged 6-14 by 2010, with State Governments and local bodies. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • In the latest Union Budget (2006-07), the allocation for Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan in crore rupees is-10,041

                                                                                                                                                                            Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan allocation, Union Budget 2006-07 → Rs. 10,041 crore; National Education Mission 2023-24 → Rs. 38953 crore (budget estimate).

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • The focus of Saakshar Bharat Programme is on:Female literacy

                                                                                                                                                                            Saakshar Bharat (September 2009, restructured National Literacy Mission) → main focus on female literacy; cut adult non-literacy.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • The Right to Education Act, 2009 aims at making a free and compulsory education a right for children upto:Elementary level

                                                                                                                                                                            Right to Education Act, 2009 (in force from April 2010) → free and compulsory elementary education for children aged 6-14.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • According to a policy decision taken by the Central Government, the Centre will bear what percentage of expenditure effectively under the right of children to get free education?68 %

                                                                                                                                                                            Right to free and compulsory education → Centre bears 68% of the expenditure; every child aged 6 to 14 has the right.

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                            • Which one of the following is not a social development programme of Indian Government?Look East Policy

                                                                                                                                                                            Look East Policy → foreign policy, not social development; Mid-day Meal (15 August 1995, NP-NSPE; PM POSHAN from 2021), Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, Rural Health Mission → social development. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                                                  • Mid-day Meal Scheme is financed and managed by:Ministry of Human Resource Development

                                                                                                                                                                                  Mid-day Meal (now PM POSHAN) → financed and managed by Ministry of HRD (now Education); Centre:State 60:40, 90:10 for NE and 3 Himalayan States, 100% for UTs without legislature.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • In Uttar Pradesh, Mid-day Meal programme was started in the year:1995

                                                                                                                                                                                  Mid-day Meal (NP-NSPE) → started 15 August 1995 in 2408 blocks, including Uttar Pradesh; all blocks by 1997-98; now 'PM POSHAN'.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following does not initiate and organize the Mid-day Meal Scheme?Contracter

                                                                                                                                                                                  Mid-day Meal is organized by School Management, Panchayati Raj Institutions and Self Help Groups; not by contractors.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Akshay Patra Foundation in India is associated with:Mid-day meal for primary schools students

                                                                                                                                                                                  Akshay Patra Foundation (2000, Bengaluru) → NGO running Mid-day Meals in Government and aided schools to end classroom hunger.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Adamya Chetna Trust, Havells India Limited, Hindustan Zinc Limited and DCSL Kota (Shriram Group) etc. are corporate trusts. They are related to:Mid-Day Meal Programme

                                                                                                                                                                                  Adamya Chetna Trust, Havells, Hindustan Zinc, DSCL Kota (Shriram Group) → corporate trusts supporting the Mid-Day Meal Programme.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • In Uttar Pradesh when ‘Go to School Campaign’ for primary education was started?In the Year 2000

                                                                                                                                                                                  'School Chalo Abhiyan' (Go to School Campaign) → Uttar Pradesh, July 2000, primary education for all children aged 6-14.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Kalp Yojana is related to:Primary Education

                                                                                                                                                                                  Kalp Yojana → U.P. Government's primary education plan, started 1998. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Consider the following statements and find out the correct answer using the code given below:Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of(A).

                                                                                                                                                                                  Shiksha Mitra Scheme (U.P., 2000-01) → village youth teach in their own village; keeps teacher-student ratio; universalizes primary education. Both true, R not the explanation.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • District Primary Education Programme was initiated in the year:1994

                                                                                                                                                                                  District Primary Education Programme (DPEP) → 1994; revitalize primary education; universal access, retention, better learning, less disparity among social groups.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Prarambhik Shiksha Kosh (PSK) was constituted in 2005 to receive the proceeds of the:Education cess imposed by the Centre

                                                                                                                                                                                  Prarambhik Shiksha Kosh (October 2005) → non-lapsable fund for elementary education that receives the Education Cess (Finance Act, 2004).

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Operation Black Board is related to:Primary Education

                                                                                                                                                                                  Operation Black Board (1987) → minimum essential facilities in all primary schools.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • In India,‘Inclusive Education for the Disabledat Secondary Stage’ scheme launched in the year 2009-10 is being provided under:Rastriya Madhyamik Siksha Abhiyan

                                                                                                                                                                                  Inclusive Education for Disabled at Secondary Stage (IEDSS, 2009-10) → disabled students of classes 9 to 12; replaced IEDC; subsumed in RMSA since 2013.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the codes given below:3 4 1 2

                                                                                                                                                                                  Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan → 2001; Sakshar Bharat Mission → 2009; Operation Black Board → 1987; National Literacy Mission → 1988. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Andragogy is the name for:Adult Education

                                                                                                                                                                                  Andragogy → methods and principles of adult education.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Andragogy (teaching adults) with pedagogy (teaching children).

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • The objective of starting the RUDSET Institute is:Provide skills and entrepreneurship training to unemployed rural youth to set up their own enterprise

                                                                                                                                                                                  RUDSET (Rural Development and Self Employment Training) Institute → skills and entrepreneurship training for unemployed rural youth to set up their own enterprises.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Recently (in 2013) a term ‘Roshni’ was in the news. It is related to:Skill development and training programme for tribal youths

                                                                                                                                                                                  'Roshni' (2013, Ministry of Rural Development) → placement-linked skill training for rural/tribal youth in Left Wing Extremism affected districts.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • The programme announced by the Prime Minister for the welfare of minorities in India is called:15 point programme

                                                                                                                                                                                  PM's New 15 Point Programme for Welfare of Minorities → announced on Independence Day 2005, revised programme in 2006.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • The ‘Nalanda Project’ is a programme of which of the following ministries?Ministry of Minority Affairs

                                                                                                                                                                                  Nalanda Project (4 March 2014) → Ministry of Minority Affairs; faculty development for minority higher education institutions, taken up at Aligarh Muslim University. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • With reference to the funds under Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme (MPLADS), which of the following statements are correct?1, 2 and 4 only

                                                                                                                                                                                  MPLADS (3 December 1993) → durable community assets (health, education, sanitation, roads, water); a set share must benefit SC/ST populations; unused funds do carry forward.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which programme was launched on 11th October, 2014, the birth anniversary of Lok Nayak Jayaprakash Narayan?Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana

                                                                                                                                                                                  Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana → launched 11 October 2014, birth anniversary of Jayaprakash Narayan; MPs develop model villages.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • The year 1981 was celebrated as the International Year of:Disabled

                                                                                                                                                                                  1981 → International Year of Disabled; 2023 → International Year of Millets; 2024 → International Year of Camelids.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • World Literacy Day is celebrated on:September 8

                                                                                                                                                                                  World Literacy Day → 8 September every year.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Women's Day is celebrated on:8 March

                                                                                                                                                                                  International Women's Day → 8 March every year. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • When is SamajikAdhikarita Smriti Divas celebrated?March 20

                                                                                                                                                                                  Samajik Adhikarita Smriti Divas → 20 March every year.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • World Consumer Rights Day is celebrated on:March 15

                                                                                                                                                                                  World Consumer Rights Day → 15 March every year.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • In which year the Bonded Labour (Abolition) Act came into force?1975

                                                                                                                                                                                  Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act → enacted 1976 but in force from 25 October 1975. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Passed in 1976, effective from 1975; both years appear as answers.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which among the following causes are responsible for rapid social change in Indian society?—

                                                                                                                                                                                  Rapid social change in India → modern science and technology, social planning, population growth and physical prosperity (all four).

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • What is true for ‘Kurukshetra’s among the following?It is a lead magazine for rural development.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Kurukshetra → monthly magazine on rural development, by Publications Division (Ministry of I&B), since 1952.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Planning Commission’s expert panel has recently recommended surcharge on taxable income for the purpose of:Providing free health care

                                                                                                                                                                                  Planning Commission expert panel (August 2011) → health surcharge on taxable income to give free health care to all.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • National Children’s Fund was set up in:1979

                                                                                                                                                                                  National Children's Fund → 1979 (International Year of the Child); corpus Rs. one lakh under the Charitable Endowment Act, 1890.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • National Institute of Rural Development is located in:Hyderabad

                                                                                                                                                                                  National Institute of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj → Hyderabad (Telangana); autonomous body under the Ministry of Rural Development.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • CAPART is associated with:Helping and evaluating rural welfare schemes

                                                                                                                                                                                  CAPART (Council for Advancement of People's Action and Rural Technology, 1 September 1986) → under Ministry of Rural Development, New Delhi; aids and evaluates rural welfare projects. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • ‘AADHAAR’ is a programme:to provide identity to Indian Residents

                                                                                                                                                                                  Aadhaar → 12-digit identity number issued by UIDAI to all residents of India; proof of identity and address. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • With which of the following would you associate village Tembhli, which was in the news in September 2010?Project Aadhaar

                                                                                                                                                                                  Aadhaar launched 29 September 2010 from Tembhli village, Nandurbar district (Maharashtra), the first 'Aadhaar gaon'. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                  • ‘Vision 2020 for India’ document is related to:Economic Development

                                                                                                                                                                                  'Vision 2020 for India' → economic development document under Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, to make India a developed country. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • PURA(Providing Urban Amenities to Rural Areas) model was advocated by:A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

                                                                                                                                                                                  PURA (Providing Urban Amenities to Rural Areas) → model by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, explained on the eve of the 54th Republic Day, 2003. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Prime Minister’s Shram Awards are given to the employees of:public sector undertakings of State and Central Governments and selected manufacturing units of Private sector.

                                                                                                                                                                                  PM's Shram Awards (Ministry of Labour) → workers of Central/State PSUs and departmental undertakings, and private units employing 500 or more workers.

                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                  • With reference to the National Rehabilitation and Resettlement Policy, 2007, consider the following statements:Neither 1 nor 2

                                                                                                                                                                                  National Rehabilitation and Resettlement Policy, 2007 → covers displacement by land acquisition or any other involuntary cause; made by Ministry of Rural Development. Both statements wrong.

                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Government of India has established National Handicapped Finance Corporation under which of the following ministries?The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

                                                                                                                                                                                  National Handicapped (now Divyangjan) Finance and Development Corporation → January 1997, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment; finances income-generating activities of disabled persons.

                                                                                                                                                                                  • The National Institute for the Visually Handicapped is situated at:Dehradun

                                                                                                                                                                                  National Institute for the Visually Handicapped (now for Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities) → Dehradun; under DEPwD, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Headquarters offirst University to be established for only physically handicapped persons in India will be at:Chitrakoot

                                                                                                                                                                                  First university only for the disabled → Chitrakoot (U.P.), 2001; now Jagadguru Rambhadracharya Divyang State University.

                                                                                                                                                                                  • At which of the following place first Open University established?Andhra Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                  First Open University → Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Open University, Hyderabad (then Andhra Pradesh), August 1982.

                                                                                                                                                                                  • The voluntary institution ‘Tarun Bharat Sangh’for rural youth is functioning in which of the following States?Rajasthan

                                                                                                                                                                                  Tarun Bharat Sangh → NGO in Rajasthan founded by Dr. Rajendra Singh; works for sustainable development.

                                                                                                                                                                                  National Youth Policy 2014 (approved 9 January 2014, replaced NYP 2003) → youth aged 15-29; five objectives, 11 priority areas.
