                                                                                                                                                                                        Poverty & Unemployment · part 1 of 2

                                                                                                                                                                                        47 facts · 57 questions · 6 Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                        Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following are the types of poverty?Only 1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                        Types of poverty → absolute and relative (by threshold), objective and subjective (by data), transversal and persistent (by duration); 'functional poverty' is not a type.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • In which year UNO adopted a definition of absolute poverty?1995

                                                                                                                                                                                        UNO adopted absolute poverty definition → 1995: severe deprivation of basic needs (food, water, sanitation, health, shelter, education, information); World Bank line US $2.15 (September 2022).

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following methods has/have been used to estimate poverty in India?1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                        Poverty estimation in India has used head count ratio, calorie intake and household consumption expenditure (current method, Tendulkar Committee 2005-2009); not per capita income.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • The basis of poverty estimates in India is:Household consumption expenditure

                                                                                                                                                                                        Poverty estimates in India → based on household consumption expenditure (NSSO survey), not income, since incomes of self-employed and daily wagers are hard to measure. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which Index is considered as the basis for estimation of poverty in urban areas?Consumer Price Index of Industrial Workers (CPI-IW)

                                                                                                                                                                                        State poverty lines updated with → CPI for Industrial Workers (CPI-IW) in urban areas; CPI for Agricultural Labourers (CPI-AL) in rural areas.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse Don't swap: IW → urban, AL → rural.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • The methodology followed for poverty estimation by using 61st NSSO data in 2004-05 is:Both URM and MRM

                                                                                                                                                                                        61st NSS Round (2004-05) → two consumption distributions: Uniform Recall (30-day recall, all items) and Mixed Recall (365-day for five infrequent non-food items).

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which method is not used to decide the poverty line?Literacy

                                                                                                                                                                                        Literacy → not used to fix the poverty line; per capita income, calorie intake and head count ratio are used.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following Committees recommended a poverty line based on nutritional requirements exclusively?Alagh Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                        Alagh Committee (task force 1977, report 1979) → poverty line based only on nutritional (calorie) needs and the related consumption expenditure.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • According to the Planning Commission, how many average daily calories per person define the poverty line in urban areas?2100

                                                                                                                                                                                        Alagh task force (1979) → poverty line = spending to get 2400 kcal per person per day in rural areas and 2100 kcal in urban areas. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid Rural work is harder, so more calories: 2400 rural, 2100 urban.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Government of India constituted a committee to set new standards for the estimation of population living below the poverty line. Who was the chairman of this committee?Suresh Tendulkar

                                                                                                                                                                                        Tendulkar Committee (set up 2005, report 2009) → new standards to estimate population below poverty line; moved away from calorie norms.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • In a given year in India, official poverty lines are higher in some States than in others becausePrice levels vary from State to State

                                                                                                                                                                                        Official poverty lines differ across States because price levels vary from State to State (inter-state price differentials in the Tendulkar poverty line basket).

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • According to the Planning Commission of India, which of the following are correct for the poverty line? I. Rs. 42 per capita per day in Urban area II. Rs. 26 per capita per day in Rural area III. Rs. 32 per capita per day in Urban area IV. Rs. 32 per capita per day in Rural area Choose the correct option from the following:II and III

                                                                                                                                                                                        Planning Commission poverty line 2011-12 (Tendulkar method): rural Rs. 816 per month (about Rs. 26 per day); urban Rs. 1000 per month (about Rs. 32 per day).

                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse Don't swap them: Rs. 32 per day is the urban line, not rural; Rs. 42 is not an official line.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which statement is not true about the poverty estimates based on the 68th round of NSSO?The 33.35 percent population of India was living below the poverty line.

                                                                                                                                                                                        NSS 68th round (2011-12, Tendulkar method): poverty line Rs. 27.20/day rural, Rs. 33.33/day urban; 21.9% below poverty line, not 33.35%.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid Rs. 816 and Rs. 1000 per month divided by a 30-day month give 27.20 and 33.33.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who has determined the poverty-line, Rs. 32/– per day, per person consumption expenditure for rural area and Rs. 47/– per day, per person consumption for urban area in India?Prof. C. Rangarajan Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                        C. Rangarajan Committee (set up 2012, report June 2014) → poverty line Rs. 32/day per person rural, Rs. 47/day urban; separate rural and urban consumption baskets.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following is measured by the Lorenz curve?Inequality of income

                                                                                                                                                                                        Lorenz curve → measures inequality of income (Max O. Lorenz, 1905); the 45° straight line = perfectly equal distribution; the more the curve sags, the more inequality.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Measures of distribution of income:Lorenz Curve

                                                                                                                                                                                        Lorenz Curve → measures distribution of income or wealth (inequality); developed by Dr. Max O. Lorenz in 1905.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding Gini coefficient? I. It measures the level of income inequality in the society. II. Higher the Gini coefficient, lower the inequality. III. It can be derived using the Lorenz curve. Select the correct answer from the options given below:I and III only

                                                                                                                                                                                        Gini coefficient (Corrado Gini) → measures income inequality; ranges 0 (perfect equality) to 1 (perfect inequality); derived from Lorenz curve; higher Gini = higher inequality.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid Gini = Gap: bigger number, bigger gap between rich and poor.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • The idea of'Cultural Poverty' was given by:Oscar Lewis

                                                                                                                                                                                        'Cultural Poverty' (Culture of Poverty) → Oscar Lewis, American anthropologist; poverty as a way of life passed on through generations.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • The concept of‘Vicious Circle of Poverty’ is related to:Nurkse

                                                                                                                                                                                        'Vicious Circle of Poverty' → Ragnar Nurkse, 'Problems of Capital Formation in Underdeveloped Countries' (1953); poor countries stay poor, trapped by demand- and supply-side forces.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • The cyclic poor are those:Who continuously shuffle between being poor and non-poor

                                                                                                                                                                                        Cyclic poor → those who keep shuffling between poor and non-poor; cyclical poverty is widespread but of limited duration (job loss, food scarcity, business cycle).

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following fixes the poverty line in India?Planning Commission (Now NITI Aayog)

                                                                                                                                                                                        Poverty line in India fixed by the Planning Commission (nodal agency for national and State estimates); NITI Aayog replaced it from 1 January 2015. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Lakdawala Committee (1993) is related to:poverty estimation

                                                                                                                                                                                        Lakdawala Committee (1993) → poverty estimation: calorie-based consumption; State-specific poverty lines updated by CPI-IW (urban) and CPI-AL (rural); end 'scaling' to National Accounts.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following committee is related to the estimation of poverty in India?—

                                                                                                                                                                                        Committees on poverty estimation → Suresh Tendulkar Committee and Lakdawala Committee (both correct); Vijay Kelkar and S.P. Gupta Committees are not.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which among the following committee’s recommendations are used for estimating the poverty line in India?Lakdawala Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                        Poverty-line committees: Alagh (1979), Lakdawala (1993), Tendulkar (2009), C. Rangarajan (2014); among the options, Lakdawala Committee's recommendations were used.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid Order A-L-T-R: Alagh, Lakdawala, Tendulkar, Rangarajan.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following committees was set up in India for identification of BPL families in Urban Areas?Hashim Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                        Identifying urban BPL families → S.R. Hashim Expert Group (2010, Planning Commission); threefold test: residential, social and occupational vulnerability.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following statements:A and R both are true and R is the correct explanation of A.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Treating people below poverty line as an identified group helps target poverty programmes: A and R true, R explains A.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following statements:Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of(A)

                                                                                                                                                                                        In India both rich and poor are malnourished: rich eat wrong (over or unhealthy) diet, poor eat poor diet; A and R true, R explains A.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Tendulkar Committee has estimated that in India the percentage of the population below poverty line is:37.2

                                                                                                                                                                                        Tendulkar Committee: 37.2% below poverty line in 2004-05; by Tendulkar method (mixed reference period) 21.9% in 2011-12 (Planning Commission, July 2013). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid 37.2 → 21.9: Tendulkar before (2004-05) and after (2011-12).

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • According to the data released by the Planning Commission in April 2011, poverty in India in 2009-10 has declined to:30%

                                                                                                                                                                                        Planning Commission (Tendulkar method): poverty fell 7.3 points, from 37.2% (2004-05) to 29.8% (about 30%) in 2009-10; data released 19 March 2012.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • What percentage of people in India live below the poverty line?27.5 percent

                                                                                                                                                                                        Planning Commission 2004-05 estimate (Uniform Recall Period) → 27.5% of Indians below the poverty line.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • According to official estimates the percentage of Indian population living below poverty line is about:26

                                                                                                                                                                                        Planning Commission 1999-2000 estimate (Mixed Recall Period) → about 26% (26.1%) of Indian population below the poverty line.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Eleventh Five Year Plan aims to reduce the poverty ratio by what percentage by the year 2012?10.0%

                                                                                                                                                                                        Eleventh Five Year Plan (2007-2012) target → cut poverty head count ratio by 10 percentage points, with 7 crore new jobs; Twelfth Plan: 2 points per year.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • According to the World Development Report 2005, the percentage of population in India earning less than US$ 2 per day is:80%

                                                                                                                                                                                        World Development Report 2005 → 80% of India's population earned less than US$ 2 per day; World Bank: 12.9% below US$ 2.15/day in 2021.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • According to latest (2003) estimates of FAO, India’s contribution to the World’s hungry population is:30%

                                                                                                                                                                                        FAO estimate (2003) → India had about 30% of the world's hungry; UN WFP now: about one-fourth of world's undernourished live in India.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • What is the India’s rank in the Global Hunger Index (GHI) in 2017?100th

                                                                                                                                                                                        Global Hunger Index 2017 (IFPRI) → India 100th of 119 countries; GHI 2022: 107th of 121; GHI 2023: 111th.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following is/are the indicator/indicators used byIFPRItocomputetheGlobalHunger Index Report?1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                        Global Hunger Index → 4 indicators: undernourishment, child wasting, child stunting, child mortality (under five); created 2006 by IFPRI and Welthungerhilfe.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid U-W-S-M: Undernourishment, Wasting, Stunting, Mortality.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Among which one of the following sets of social/religious groups is the extent of poverty the highest, as per Government Statistics for the nineties?Tribals in Bihar, Orissa, M.P. and Maharashtra

                                                                                                                                                                                        Government statistics of the nineties → poverty highest among Tribals of Bihar, Odisha, M.P. and Maharashtra.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • According to a survey conducted by the ‘National Council of Applied Economic Research’(data released recently), which State in India has the highest percentage of population below the poverty line?Bihar

                                                                                                                                                                                        NCAER survey (question period) → Bihar had the highest share below poverty line among given States; 2011-12 Planning Commission: Chhattisgarh highest (39.93%).

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Assertion (A): Bihar is a backward State of the country.Both (A) and (R) are correct, but (R) is not the correct explanation of(A).

                                                                                                                                                                                        Bihar is backward due to income inequality, illiteracy, lack of industry and political will; regional disparity exists but is not the cause: A and R true, R not explanation.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • As per the Planning Commission Report of 1999-2000 the highest percentage of people living below the poverty line was in:Odisha

                                                                                                                                                                                        Planning Commission 1999-2000 → highest poverty share in Odisha (47.1%); 2011-12 → most poor people in Uttar Pradesh (598.19 lakh), highest ratio Chhattisgarh (39.93%). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse Highest poverty ratio (percentage) with highest number of poor people (Uttar Pradesh).

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Planning Commission has updated recently the poverty estimates for the year 2011-12.According to these estimates what is the percentage of population below the poverty line in Rajasthan?15 percent

                                                                                                                                                                                        Rajasthan 2011-12 (Tendulkar method, Planning Commission July 2013) → 14.71% (about 15%) below poverty line; 102.92 lakh poor.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Poverty-Ratio based on the methodology adopted by Dr. C. Rangarajan Expert Group was incorrect for the State for year 2011-12 in relation to the population of the State of:Chhattisgarh 37.9%

                                                                                                                                                                                        Rangarajan poverty ratio 2011-12: All India 29.5%, Chhattisgarh 47.9% (not 37.9%), Goa 6.3%, Rajasthan 21.7%.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following States has the minimum percentage of population below poverty line?Himachal Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                        Lowest poverty ratio 2011-12 (Tendulkar): A&N Islands 1.00%, Lakshadweep, Goa 5.09%, Kerala 7.05%, Himachal Pradesh 8.06%, Sikkim, Punjab 8.26% → HP lowest among options.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • The minimum percentage of population below the poverty line is recorded in:Goa

                                                                                                                                                                                        Lowest poverty ratio among J&K, Punjab, Haryana and Goa → Goa (5.09%, Tendulkar method).

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following States has the least percentage of its population below the poverty line?Kerala

                                                                                                                                                                                        Least poverty among Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Kerala, Punjab → Kerala (19.6% in 2004-05; 7.05% in 2011-12, Tendulkar method). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • According to the report of World Bank, more than 50 percent poor in India, live in these four states:Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha

                                                                                                                                                                                        World Bank: over 50% of India's poor lived in Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha; 2011-12 most poor: UP (598.19 lakh), then Bihar, MP.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid BUMO: Bihar, UP, MP, Odisha.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following pairs is correct? Percentage of Population below Poverty Line (1993-94)—

                                                                                                                                                                                        Poverty ratio 1993-94: Punjab 11.77%, Bihar 54.96% (about 55%), Uttar Pradesh 40.85%, Rajasthan 27.41%; none of the given pairs is correct.

                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                              Poverty & Unemployment · part 2 of 2
