Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Consider the following statements about 'Rules of Origin':All of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Rules of Origin → criteria to fix a product's national source; they matter because duties and restrictions depend on import source; used for customs, trade statistics, MFN/preferential treatment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Read the following statements about Supply Chain Resilience Initiative (SCRI):Only 1 is true

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Supply Chain Resilience Initiative (SCRI) → launched 27 April 2021 by India, Japan and Australia (three, not five countries); ensures uninterrupted imports by diversifying suppliers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which Ministry of Government of India is related for India’s Foreign Trade Policy?Ministry of Commerce and Industry

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's Foreign Trade Policy → Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The long-term vision of the Department of Commerce is to make India a major player in the world trade by:2020

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Foreign Trade Policy 2015-20 vision → make India a major player in world trade by 2020; FTP 2023 targets US$ 2 trillion exports by 2030. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • With reference to the international trade of India at present, which of the following statements is/are correct?1, 3 and 4 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India (Economic Survey 2022-23): merchandise exports < imports; services exports > imports; overall current account deficit; imports of iron and steel, fertilisers, machinery increased.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In 2011-12, data of external trade of India reached at about:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's total external merchandise trade in 2011-12 → Rs. 3811360 crore (Department of Commerce), so none of the given options is correct. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following statements is correct about 'India's Trade Gross Domestic Product' ratio?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's Trade-to-GDP ratio (World Bank): above 50% since 2000 only in 2008 and 2011-2013; 45.69% in 2007; 40% in 2019 vs 44% in 2018; no option correct.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • India's total merchandise trade as a percentage of GDP has increased from 29.5% in 2004-05 to what percentage in 2012-13?40.6%

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's merchandise trade as % of GDP rose from 29.5% (2004-05) to about 40.6% (2012-13); World Bank: 31.1% in 2023. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The combined share of exports and imports of goods wasalmost three times that of1990-91

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Exports + imports of goods: 14.2% of GDP in 1990-91 → almost three times that by 2011-12.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The exports of goods and services from India as a percentage of India’s GDP in 2010-11 was:22 percent

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's exports of goods and services in 2010-11 → about 22% of GDP; World Bank 2023: exports 21.9%, imports 24% of GDP.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Consider the following statements: Statement-I: India accounts for 3.2% of global export of goods. Statement-II: Many local companies and some foreign companies operating in India have taken advantage of India's 'Production Linked Incentive' scheme. Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's share in global goods exports → 1.8% (2021, 2022), not 3.2%; PLI scheme (incentive on incremental sales) used by local and foreign firms; Statement-I false, II true.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In 1950, India’s share in global exports was 1.85 percent, but today it is:0.60 percent

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's share in world exports: 1.85% in 1950, down to about 0.5-0.7% in the 1990s (answer 0.60%); 1.8% in 2022 (WTO).

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • What was the share of India in total world's export in the year 2013?1.7 percent

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's share in world merchandise exports: 1.7% in 2013, 2018 and 2019; 1.6% in 2020; 1.8% in 2021 and 2022.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • What was the rank of India in Commercial Services Exports in the world in 2014?8th

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India in commercial services exports: 8th in 2014 (US$ 155.6 billion, Economic Survey 2015-16); 7th in 2022 with 4.4% share (WTO).

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which country has the largest share in international trade?China

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Largest share in international trade now → China (14.4% of world merchandise exports, 2022); USA led in the question period and is the largest importer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following regions has emerged as the largest International Trade Partner (Export and Import) of India in 2008-09?Asia and ASEAN

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's largest trade partner region → Asia and ASEAN; Asian countries supply more than 50% of India's imports (60.92% in 2023-24). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • With which of the following groups of countries India has the largest import trade?OPEC

                                                                                                                                                                                                    In the question period India's largest import trade was with OPEC; now Asia supplies 60.92% of India's imports (2023-24).

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In 2011 which two countries accounted for the largest share percent in India’s total trade with rest of the world?China and UAE

                                                                                                                                                                                                    2010-11 and 2011-12 → China and UAE together had the largest share in India's trade; 2023-24 → China, USA, UAE.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following countries is India’s largest trading partner?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's largest trading partner: USA in 2006-07 (9.8%) and in 2021-22, 2022-23; China took the top spot in 2023-24, then USA, UAE. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following countries is India'stop trading partner in 2019-20?USA

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's top trading partner: USA in 2019-20, 2021-22 and 2022-23 (China 2nd, UAE 3rd); China became largest in 2023-24. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse The answer depends on the year asked: USA for 2019-20 to 2022-23, China for 2023-24.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Among the following countries India's trade balance surplus is maximum with which country in 2019-20?USA

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's largest trade surplus → with USA (2019-20 to 2022-23; about US$ 36.74 billion); USA is one of the few countries India has a surplus with.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • With which of the following nations, India's trade on current account is more in the foreign trade balance?USA

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's largest current account trade (goods + services) → with USA.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The largest part of India’s import (in value) comes from:China

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Largest source of India's imports → China (15.06% in 2023-24), then Russia and UAE. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Consider the following statements:2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                    South Asia trade: Indo-Sri Lanka trade fluctuated (no steady rise); textiles about 30% of India-Bangladesh trade; Bangladesh, not Nepal, is India's largest South Asian partner.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Assertion (A): The USA re-emerged as India's single largest import source in the early nineties.(A) is true, but R is false

                                                                                                                                                                                                    USA re-emerged as India's largest import source in the early nineties (A true); India did not turn to USA for defence; Russia top arms supplier (36%, 2019-23).

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The largest part of India’s export (in value) goes to:United States of America

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Largest destination of India's exports now → USA (17.74% in 2023-24), then UAE, Netherlands, China; UAE led in the question period.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In the year 2009-10, which of the following countries accounted for largest share in exports from India?UAE

                                                                                                                                                                                                    2009-10 → UAE accounted for the largest share of India's exports. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Don't mix years: UAE topped India's exports in 2009-10; USA tops at present.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In India's total exports, the share of United States of America is:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                    USA's share in India's exports: about 20% in the question period (option c); 17.41% in 2022-23 and 17.74% in 2023-24.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The trade balance of India (merchandise and services) for December 2022 (provisional) is:(–) 11.98 USD billion

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's trade balance (merchandise + services), December 2022 (provisional) → (–) 11.98 USD billion; final figure (–) 7.75 USD billion.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following statements is correct about the balance of trade of India?India’s trade balance remained negative for the entire period from 1949-50 to 2015-16 except two years 1972- 73 and 1976-77, when it was positive.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's trade balance was negative from 1949-50 onwards, except 1972-73 (Rs. 104 crore) and 1976-77 (Rs. 68 crore), when it was positive.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Assertion (A): India’s trade deficit, after reaching the highest level in the year 2012-13 registered continuous decline since 2013-14.Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of(A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's trade deficit peaked at US$ 195.66 billion in 2012-13, then fell till 2016-17 as both POL and non-POL deficits declined; A and R true, R explains A. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following is included in Balance of Trade?Goods

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Balance of Trade → difference between value of exports and imports of goods only (visible items); services and transfers are not included.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Net export equals to:Export – Imports

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Net exports = Exports – Imports (goods and services); positive = trade surplus, negative = trade deficit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The payment of foreign trade is related with:Balance of Payment

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Payment for foreign trade → recorded in the Balance of Payments (account of all international transactions of a country).

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Term ‘Balance of Payment’ is used in relation to which of the following?Exports & Imports

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Balance of Payments → systematic record of all economic transactions (goods, services, assets) between residents and the rest of the world, usually for a year; current and capital accounts. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Balance of payment includes:All of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Balance of Payments includes visible trade (goods), invisible trade (services, transfers) and borrowings: all of the above.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • With reference to Balance of Payments, which of the following constitutes/constitute the Current Account?1 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Current Account of BoP → Balance of Trade (goods) + Balance of Invisibles (services, transfers); foreign assets and SDRs are not part of it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid Current account = T + I: Trade + Invisibles.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Given below are two statements, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).(A) is true, but (R) is false

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Current Account Deficit → payments for goods, services, transfers and net income exceed receipts; occurs when a country imports (not exports) more; A true, R false. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Among the following commodities imported by India during the year 2000-01, which one was the highest in terms of Rupee value?Pearls, precious and semi-precious stones

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's top import by rupee value in 2000-01 (among options) → pearls, precious and semi-precious stones, ahead of edible oils and fertilisers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • India spends the maximum foreign exchange on the import of which item?Petroleum products

                                                                                                                                                                                                    India spends the most foreign exchange on petroleum products (crude and products US$ 209418 million, about 29.4% of imports in 2022-23). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following has been the most important item in the total imports of India in recent years?Petroleum & Edible Oil

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Most important item in India's imports → petroleum (crude and products 26.52% of imports in 2023-24); iron and steel 3.52%, edible oils 2.20%. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Two largest items of import in India in recent years are:Capital goods and petroleum products

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Two largest import items → petroleum products (fuel) and capital goods; petroleum products alone have the maximum share. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Goods imported at Haldia Port is:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Haldia Port (West Bengal) imports fertilisers, foodgrains, coking coal, petroleum, iron and steel, machinery and general cargo.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Import procedure begins with:Indent

Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A Letter of Credit has to be produced by:An importer

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Letter of Credit → produced by the importer, through the importer's bank (Issuing Bank), promising payment to the exporter against stipulated documents. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following items had the largest share in India's export in the year 2004-05?Manufactured Goods

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The table given below depicts the composition of India's exports between 1992-93 and 1994-95: The changing composition of the export trade is indicative of structural transformation of Indian economy in favour of modernization. The best indicator of this trend is the: Percentage shareincrease in the share of manufactured products in exports

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Rising share of manufactured goods in exports (75.5% in 1992-93 to 78.0% in 1994-95) → best sign of structural transformation towards modernisation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following commodities has highest export from India in 2017?Engineering goods

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Highest export item from India (2017 and now) → engineering goods (US$ 112102 million in 2021-22), ahead of agriculture, chemicals and textiles. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following groups constitutes the largest items of export from India?Engineering Goods and Tea

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Largest export items: Readymade Garments and Gems & Jewellery in the question period (per explanation); at present Engineering goods has the highest value and share. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The largest contribution to the export earnings of India comes from the export of:Agricultural and allied products

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Largest export earner: Gems and jewellery in the question period; among the given items, agricultural and allied products lead in recent years (14.3% in 2020-21). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • As per 2010 statistics, percentage share of gems and jewellery in India’s export is around:18

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Gems and jewellery share in India's exports → about 18% (2010 statistics); 9.3% of commodity exports in 2021-22.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • India earns maximum foreign exchange by the export of:Textile

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Among iron, tea, textile and rubber → India earns the most foreign exchange from textiles (US$ 36686 million in 2022-23).

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The earnings of India from diamond export is quite high. Which one of the following factors has contributed to it?Expertise available for cutting and polishing of imported diamonds which are then exported

                                                                                                                                                                                                          India's high diamond export earnings → expertise in cutting and polishing imported diamonds; India exports 75% of the world's polished diamonds (GJEPC).

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following set of commodities are exported to India by the arid and semi-arid countries in middle east?Fruits and palm oil

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Arid and semi-arid Middle East countries export fruits, dry fruits and palm oil to India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For which one of the following items, is Tirupur wellknown as a huge exporter to many parts of the world?Knitted garments

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Tiruppur (Tamil Nadu), 'Manchester of South India' → huge exporter of knitted garments (hosiery); 90% of India's cotton knitwear export.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The rank of India in World Textile Exports is:Third

                                                                                                                                                                                                          India → third largest exporter of textiles and apparels in the world; second largest producer of MMF fibre after China (Ministry of Textiles, 2022-23).

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The largest importer country of Indian textiles is:United States of America

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Largest importer of Indian textiles → USA (29% in 2022-23), then Bangladesh, UK and UAE, Germany.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following States contributed maximum to India's exports in dollar terms in 2007-08 and 2008-09:Maharashtra

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Top exporting State in 2007-08 and 2008-09 → Maharashtra; now Gujarat leads (33.12% in 2022-23), Maharashtra second.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Assertion (A): During the year 2001-02, the value of India's total exports declined, registering negative growth of 2.17%.A is false, but R is true

                                                                                                                                                                                                          2001-02 (book): A false, exports did not fall by 2.17%; R true, iron and steel, coffee, textiles and marine products had negative export growth.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Match List-I and List-II, and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists:A-3, B-1, C-4, D-2

                                                                                                                                                                                                          India's exports → destination: Iron ore → Japan (from Bailadila); Leather goods → Russia; Tea → UK; Cotton fabrics → USA.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The largest quantity of steel was exported by India in 2003-04 to:China

                                                                                                                                                                                                          India's largest steel export destination in 2003-04 → China (23.0% share); in 2023-24 → Italy, then Belgium.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • India export maximum leather to:U.S.A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          India's largest leather export market → USA (19.13%, April 2023 to March 2024), then Germany and UK. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • At what rate did exports by India increase in 1994-95?18%

                                                                                                                                                                                                          India's exports grew about 18% in 1994-95; in 2021-22 they rose 44.6% to about US$ 422 billion.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In which of the years given below growth rate of Indian exports was highest?2004-05

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Highest export growth among 2002-03 to 2005-06 → 2004-05 (30.8%, Economic Survey 2007-08).

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • India became the largest exporter (2015) of rice, replacing which of the following countries?Thailand

                                                                                                                                                                                                          India became the world's largest rice exporter in 2015, replacing Thailand; still top in 2022-23, followed by Thailand, Vietnam, Pakistan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The largest tea exporting country of the world is:Kenya

                                                                                                                                                                                                          World's largest tea exporter → Kenya; order in 2021 and 2022: Kenya > China > Sri Lanka > India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse Don't pick India or Sri Lanka: Kenya leads tea exports; India is only fourth.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following statements: Statement-I: Switzerland is one of the leading exporters of gold in terms of value. Statement-II: Switzerland has the second largest gold reserves in the world. Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Switzerland → world's largest gold exporter by value (USD 101 billion, 2022): true; but not second in gold reserves (top: Australia, Russia, South Africa).

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The production ofcultured pearl is an important cottage industry of:Japan

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Cultured pearl production → important cottage industry of Japan (pioneer Kokichi Mikimoto, Akoya oyster).

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The largest producer and exporter of long staple cotton in the world is:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Long staple cotton: USA was the largest producer and exporter in the question period; now India is the top producer and USA the top exporter.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following services was the largest foreign exchange earner for India in the year 2007-08 and 2008-09?IT-Software services

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Largest services foreign exchange earner (2007-08, 2008-09 and now) → IT-Software services; IT services are over 51% of IT-BPM.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Assertion (A): India's software exports increased at an average growth rate of 50% since 1995-96.Both A and Rare true and R is the correct explanation of A

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Indian software exports grew over 50% a year since 1995-96 (CAGR 57% in IX Plan) as firms were cost-effective with international quality; A and R true, R explains A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following statements:Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Question period: software exports grew at about 60% CAGR and the software industry about 28% in 2001-2002 (both correct); 2022-23 software exports US$ 185.5 billion.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In terms of economy, the visit by foreign nationals to witness the XIX Commonwealth Games in India amounted to:Export

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Foreign visitors watching the XIX Commonwealth Games in India → an export (tourism earnings are an invisible export).

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Invisible Export means export of:Services

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Invisible export → export of services (tourism, banking, insurance, software, finance); no goods are involved. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Entrepot trade means:Goods imported for export

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Entrepot trade → goods imported for re-export, with no processing and no customs duty (trans-shipment port).

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A tariff:reduces the volume of trade

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Tariff (tax on imports) raises import prices → reduces the volume of trade; now used mainly to protect domestic industry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Duty-Draw-Back implies:Refund of import duty to exporters

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Duty drawback → refund to exporters of customs and excise duties paid on inputs used to make export goods (refund of import duty).

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • What is/are the cause/s of slow progress of India’s export?All of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Slow growth of India's exports → high price, foreign competition, low quality goods: all of these; India's share was 1.8% of global exports in 2022.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The New Exim Policy announced in 1992, is for period of:5 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Exim Policy of 1992 → 5 years; FTP 2015-20 extended to 31 March 2023; FTP 2023 dropped the five-year tradition for a long-term focus.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following is not a part of the Exim Policy 2002-2007?1 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Exim Policy 2002-2007 aimed at least 1% (not 10%) of global trade by 2007; EHTP units could sell in DTA only up to 50% of FOB value.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The duration of the New Foreign Trade Policy of the Government of India is:2004-2009

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Foreign Trade Policy of the question period → 2004-2009 (five years); FTP 2023 adopts a long-term focus instead.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following statements about the recent Foreign Trade Policy:only 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Foreign Trade Policy 2004-09 (August 2004): aim to double India's share of global merchandise trade; stressed both development and employment; not 2005-10.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The objective of the new Foreign Trade Policy is to increase India’s share in the World Trade by 2009 to:1.50%

                                                                                                                                                                                                          FTP 2004-09 target → raise India's share in world trade to 1.5% by 2009; FTP 2015-20 target: from 2% to 3.5% by 2019-20.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • India’s Trade Policy (2009-14) seeks to:1 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Foreign Trade Policy 2009-14 (Anand Sharma): double India's share of global trade by 2020; double exports by 2014; 15% growth till 2011, then 25%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The registered exporters, whose export performance in several years is of high quality, are known as:Star Trading Houses

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Registered exporters (ascending): Export House → Trading House → Star Trading House → Super Star; high export performance over many years → Star Trading House.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Assertion (A): The new EXIM policy is liberal, market-oriented and favours global trade.Both A and Rare individually true, but R is not the correct explanation of A

                                                                                                                                                                                                          EXIM Policy 2002-07 was liberal and market-oriented; GATT/WTO helped liberalise the economy; both true but R does not explain A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following has not been named as ‘Towns of Excellence’ for exports upto March, 2014?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                          FTP 2009-14 → 21 'Towns of Export Excellence', including Panipat, Ludhiana, Tirupur and Madurai (none excluded); FTP 2023 added Faridabad, Moradabad, Mirzapur, Varanasi.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A ‘closed economy’ is an economy in which:neither exports nor imports take place

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Closed economy → no trade with other economies: neither exports nor imports; fully self-sufficient.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The process of Globalization refers to:dismantling barriers in international trade

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Globalisation → growing interdependence of world economies; mainly free trade by dismantling barriers in international trade.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Globalization of Indian Economy means:having minimum possible restrictions on economic relations with other countries

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Globalisation of Indian economy → minimum possible restrictions on economic relations with other countries (free flow of goods, services, capital, people).

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)
