                                                                                                                                                                                                            Spaced review: 15 questions from earlier hours

                                                                                                                                                                                                              Your weak questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Hour 36 →

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Hour 36 of 72 · Learn

                                                                                                                                                                                                                International Trade · part 3 of 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                47 facts · 57 questions · 7 Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Globalization does not include:disinvestment of Public Sector Equity

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Globalisation includes lower import duties, no import licensing, free FDI flow; disinvestment of public sector equity is privatisation/liberalisation, not globalisation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following statements about ‘Globalization’ is not correct?It has created a sense of optimism among small entrepreneurs in India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Globalisation pushed Indian firms to seek foreign investment and buy foreign ventures, and foreign firms to buy Indian ones; it did not create optimism among small entrepreneurs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Given below are two statements, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other labelled as Reason (R).Both A and Rare true and R is the correct explanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Cutting import duties on capital goods → key liberalisation tool (after 1991), helping local entrepreneurs upgrade technology for global markets; A and R true, R explains A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The first phase of liberalization was initiated in India under the regime of:P.V. Narsimha Rao

                                                                                                                                                                                                                First phase of liberalisation → 1991 New Economic Policy under Prime Minister P.V. Narsimha Rao.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Encouraging more multinational companies in India is to promote the policy of:All of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Encouraging MNCs in India → promotes privatisation, globalisation and liberalisation: all of the above. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid LPG: Liberalisation, Privatisation, Globalisation all welcome MNCs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following has/have occurred in India after its liberalization of economic policies in 1991?2, 3 and 4 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                After 1991: India's share in world exports rose (0.5% in 1990 to 1.8% in 2022); FDI and forex reserves rose; agriculture's share fell (about 30% to 17.6%).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following is not true about globalization and its impact on India?Increase in exports is greater than increase in imports.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Globalisation expanded trade and FDI inflows into India, but exports did not grow faster than imports (merchandise trade deficit kept rising).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • When was the process of economic reforms started in India?1991

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Economic reforms in India began in 1991 amid a severe economic crisis: liberalisation, privatisation and globalisation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Free Trade Policy refers to a policy where there is:Absence of tariff

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Free trade policy → goods and services cross borders with little or no tariffs, quotas, subsidies or bans; i.e. absence of tariff.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Free Trade Zones have been established in India for the:promotion of export industries

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Free Trade Zones (SEZs/FTWZs) → set up to promote export industries; goods landed, made and re-exported generally free of customs duty. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In India, Special Economic Zone policy was announced in:April, 2000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Special Economic Zone (SEZ) policy in India → announced 1 April 2000, to boost foreign investment and give a hassle-free environment for exports. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Special Economic Zone (SEZ)Act became effective in:2006

                                                                                                                                                                                                                SEZ Act 2005 → passed May 2005, assent 23 June 2005, in force 10 February 2006; aims: economic activity, exports of goods and services, investment, jobs, infrastructure. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse Passed in 2005 but effective in 2006; it promotes exports of goods and services, not services only.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following cities does not have the Special Economic Zone:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Asia's first EPZ → Kandla (Gujarat), 1965; Chennai, Kandla, Kochi and Surat all have SEZs (converted EPZs), so no option fits. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Kandla first, and Asia's first: 1965.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which among the following does not have a ‘Free Trade Zone’:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Free Trade Zones: Kandla, Mumbai, Visakhapatnam had them; Thiruvananthapuram had none in the question period (now has SEZs, notified 2006).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements:Only 1, 2 and 3 are correct

                                                                                                                                                                                                                India's first EPZ → 1965; SEZ policy → 2000; Vadodara → Patola silk (as per book); Panna (MP) → diamond mining, not gold mines.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The first Export Processing Zone of the Private Sector was established at:Surat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                First private-sector EPZ → Surat (1997), converted into SEZ from 1 November 2000; run by Diamond and Gem Development Corporation (DGDC).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which group was permitted at Nandigram area under the SEZ policy:Salim group

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Nandigram (Purba Medinipur, West Bengal) → Salim Group allowed a chemical hub under SEZ policy in 2007; villagers protested heavily.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In relation to the previous year, growth rate in exports from the functioning of Special Economic Zones was highest in which year?2007-08

                                                                                                                                                                                                                SEZ export growth among 2004-05 to 2007-08 → highest in 2007-08 (93%); later peak 121.40% in 2009-10.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following States has the largest no. of approved as well as operational Special Economic Zones as on June 2012?Andhra Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Most approved and operational SEZs (June 2012) → Andhra Pradesh; now Tamil Nadu has most operational, Telangana most approved (276 operational SEZs, 31.12.2023).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • SEZ India mobile app has been launched in January, 2017 by:Ministry of Commerce and Industry

                                                                                                                                                                                                                SEZ India mobile app → launched January 2017 by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (e-Governance initiative).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which among the following organizations are responsible for channelizing export and import of India: I. Mineral and Metal Trading Corporation II. Exim Bank III. State Trading Corporation IV. Food Corporation of India Select the correct answer from the code given below: Code:I, II, III and IV

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Channelising India's exports and imports → MMTC, Exim Bank, State Trading Corporation and Food Corporation of India: all four.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In which year the Export-Import (EXIM) Bank of India was set up?1982

                                                                                                                                                                                                                EXIM Bank of India → set up in 1982 under the Export-Import Bank of India Act, 1981; purveyor of export credit. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse The Act year (1981) with the year the bank was set up (1982).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which organization promotes the foreign trade?All of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Foreign trade promotion bodies → ECGC (export credit risk insurance), STC and MMTC: all of the above.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ECGC is related to:Export Financing and Insurance

                                                                                                                                                                                                                ECGC (Export Credit Guarantee Corporation, set up 1957, Government of India) → export financing and credit risk insurance for exporters. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • What is the full form of EPCG?Export Promotion Capital Goods

                                                                                                                                                                                                                EPCG → Export Promotion Capital Goods scheme: import of capital goods without customs duty to make quality export goods.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Government of India announced a new scheme 'NIRVIK' in the Budget for 2020-21. Which of the following sectors of economy will take the benefit from this scheme?Export sector

                                                                                                                                                                                                                NIRVIK (Niryat Rin Vikas Yojana), Budget 2020-21 → export sector: higher insurance cover and lower premium for small exporters.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • India Brand Equity Fund was established in:1996

                                                                                                                                                                                                                India Brand Equity Foundation (IBEF) → Trust set up in 1996 by the Department of Commerce to promote the 'Made in India' label abroad.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Morgan Stanley has rated India as one of the most emerging markets in 1998 and has placed it at:3rd position

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Morgan Stanley (1998) → India 3rd among emerging markets, after Brazil (1st) and Mexico (2nd).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Tourism industry in India is quite small compared to many other countries in terms of India's potential and size. Which one of the following statements is correct in this regard?In India, the infrastructure required for attracting tourists is inadequate

                                                                                                                                                                                                                India's tourism industry is small for its size and potential because tourist infrastructure is inadequate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • According to the 2006 Report of World Tourism Organization, maximum tourists visited that year to:France

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Most visited country (World Tourism Organization 2006, and in 2022) → France; in 2022 followed by Spain and USA.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • According to report of U.N. World Tourism Organization (2010) the most visited country in the world is:France

                                                                                                                                                                                                                UNWTO Report 2010 → France was the most visited country in the world (still top in 2022).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following countries was the most favourite (in terms of total number ofvisitors) destination of Indian tourists in the year 2010?Singapore

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Most favoured destination of Indian tourists in 2010 → Singapore; in 2022 → UAE (28.0%), then Saudi Arabia, USA, Singapore, UK.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In which of the following years, Foreign TouristArrivals (FTAs) had registered decline over the previous year in the country?2009-10

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Foreign Tourist Arrivals fell in 2009 (–2.2%, to 5.17 million from 5.28 million in 2008) → answer 2009-10.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which among the following is the Top State in India in terms of Foreign Tourist Visits?Maharashtra

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Top State in foreign tourist visits (question period) → Maharashtra; in 2022 → Gujarat first (20.70%), Maharashtra second.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • As per the recent data, which among the following is the top State in terms of number of domestic tourist visits:Andhra Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Top State in domestic tourist visits (question period) → Andhra Pradesh; in 2022 → Uttar Pradesh (317.91 million), Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The city which has been selected by a famous International Magazine 'Travel and Leisure' in its survey 2009 as the best city from tourism point of view in the world is:Udaipur

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Travel + Leisure survey 2009 → Udaipur best city in the world for tourism; in 2023 Udaipur was 2nd after Oaxaca (Mexico).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Nathu La was reopened in 2006 for trans-border trade between India and:China

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Nathu La (Sikkim–Tibet pass) → reopened in 2006 for India-China border trade; sealed for about 4 decades after 1959.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • India signed the Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement (ECTA) with which country?Australia

                                                                                                                                                                                                                India-Australia ECTA (Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement) → signed 2 April 2022, in force from 29 December 2022.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • India in February 2011 signed Free Trade Agreement with:Japan

                                                                                                                                                                                                                16 February 2011 → India signed a Free Trade Agreement (CEPA) with Japan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse Don't mix: Japan (CEPA) and Malaysia (CECA) agreements were both signed in February 2011.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • India has recently signed Comprehensive Economic Co-operation Agreement with:Malaysia

                                                                                                                                                                                                                18 February 2011 → India signed a Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement with Malaysia at Putrajaya.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which country has recently signed a free trade agreement (FTA) with the United Arab Emirates?Israel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Israel–UAE Free Trade Agreement → signed 31 May 2022; Israel's first FTA with an Arab country (aim: trade above US$ 10 billion).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Recently, which of the following two countries signed a bilateral Free Trade Agreement (FTA)?China and Bangladesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                January 2002 → China and Bangladesh signed a bilateral Free Trade Agreement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which country among the following used maximum number of anti-dumping measures during 1995-2005?India

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Most anti-dumping measures in 1995-2005 → India (WTO data); in 2022 the USA had the most measures in effect (493).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Super '301' is related to:Blockade in free trade

                                                                                                                                                                                                                'Super 301' (Special 301) → US Trade Representative's annual process naming foreign trade barriers to US exports, i.e. blockade in free trade.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • With reference to the India International Trade Fair-2021, which of the following statements is/are correct?Only 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                IITF 2021 (40th edition, ITPO) → theme 'Atmanirbhar Bharat', held November 2021 at Pragati Maidan, New Delhi, not Jaipur.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?Import Quota Physical Control

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Import quota → physical control (limits quantity of imports to protect domestic producers); the correctly matched pair.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Match the ColumnAwith Column B and select the correct answer using the codes given below:2 1 4 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Open general licence → External trade; TRYSEM → Employment; Wholesale Price Index → Inflation; Cash Reserve Ratio → Debt control.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)
