                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Third largest economy (nominal): China in 2007 per explanation; Japan in 2022, after USA and China; India is 3rd in PPP terms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • According to the World Bank's development report, the position of the Indian economy in the world is the:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  World Development Report 2008 → India the fourth largest economy in PPP terms, so none of the options fits; 5th by nominal GDP in 2019 and 2022.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Measured in terms of Purchasing Power Parity, Indian economy continues to be the 4th largest country in the world. The first three positions are occupied by:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  By PPP in 2009 → USA, China, Japan, then India (4th); in 2022 → China, USA, India, Japan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In terms of PPP the Indian economy’s rankin the world is:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  India's rank by PPP → 4th in the question period; 3rd since 2011 (after China and USA).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Consider the following statements:1 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  PPP exchange rates compare prices of the same basket of goods in different countries (true); by PPP India is 3rd, not 6th (after China, USA).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • According to American based think tank Population Review Report 2020, which of the following statements is/are correct?1, 2 and 3 correct

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Population Review 2020 → India's 2019 GDP about Rs. 209 lakh crore (2875142 million dollars); 5th largest economy, overtaking Britain and France.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • As per World Development Report of the World Bank, 2008 arrange the following countries according to the size of their economy in descending order. State which one of the following is the correct order:USA > China > UK > India

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  World Development Report 2008 (nominal GDP) → USA > China > UK > India; India overtook the UK in 2019. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • India aims to achieve the 5 trillion dollar economy by:2024

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  5 trillion dollar economy target (PM Modi, 2019) → by 2024-25; may be delayed by COVID-19. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Consider the following statements: Most international agencies which fund development programmes in India on intergovernmental bilateral agreements, mainly provide:1, 2 and 3 are correct

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  International agencies funding India under bilateral agreements (World Bank, ADB) → technical assistance, soft loans with interest, grants; not food assistance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Loan and grants, for the improvement of infrastructure of States in India have been given by which one of the following institution?World Bank

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Loans and grants for States' infrastructure → World Bank; Aid-India Consortium (1958, World Bank-led) later became the Indian Development Forum. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following Indian States has recently signed a $ 220 million agreement with the World Bank?Bihar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  12 January 2011 → World Bank signed a 220 million dollar agreement with Bihar for the 'Bihar Kosi Recovery Project'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • World Bank has announced the approval of loans and concessional credit of $ 600 million in 2007 to India for beefing up its:Rural Cooperative Structure

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2 November 2007 → World Bank agreed a 600 million dollar loan over 4 years to strengthen India's Rural Cooperative Structure.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The World Bank has recently sanctioned a loan of 944 million dollars to India, for which of the following sectors, the loan is not meant for?Rural roads and sanitation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  World Bank's 944 million dollars (2 November 2007) → rural finance, vocational training, community-based water management; not rural roads and sanitation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The ‘National Agricultural Innovation Project’ is being implemented by ICAR with credit assistance from the World Bank. It has got how many components?Four components

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  National Agricultural Innovation Project (ICAR with World Bank aid, 2006) → four components (e.g. ICAR as catalyst of change, value-chain research).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ‘Green Index’ has been developed by:World Bank

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'Green Index' → launched by the World Bank in 2009; first eco-friendly stock index tracking carbon efficiency of firms in emerging economies.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following constitute the World Bank?1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  World Bank Group (five bodies) → IBRD (1944), IFC (1956), IDA (1960), ICSID (1966), MIGA (1988); the IMF is not part of it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid By year: IBRD, IFC, IDA, ICSID, MIGA.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The World Bank was established in:1945

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  World Bank (IBRD) → created at 1944 Bretton Woods Conference with IMF; became effective 27 December 1945; headquarters Washington, D.C. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Created in 1944, but established (effective) in 1945.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following World Bank affiliates, provides assistance for poverty alleviation to the world's poorest countries?International Development Association

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  IDA (World Bank affiliate, set up 24 September 1960) → zero/low-interest loans ('credits') and grants to the world's poorest countries for poverty reduction.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse IDA with IFC or MIGA, the other World Bank affiliates in the options; IMF is a separate body.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Regarding International Monetary Fund, which one of the following statements is correct?It grants loans to only member countries

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  IMF lends only to member countries; its main function → help members solve balance of payments problems and keep the international monetary system stable. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • International Monetary Fund loans can be used for which of the following purposes?To meet temporary deficits in balance of payments

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  IMF loans → to meet temporary balance of payments deficits of member countries; IMF is not a development bank (not for projects, gold reserves or capital formation).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Bretton Woods Conference led to the establishment of:1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Bretton Woods Conference (44 nations, 1-22 July 1944, New Hampshire, USA) → created IMF and IBRD (World Bank) only; not the UN or WTO.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid Bretton Woods twins = IMF + World Bank.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • How is the United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference wherein the agreements were signed to set up IBRD, GATT and IMF, commonly known?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference, 1944 = Bretton Woods Conference → set up IMF and IBRD; GATT was signed separately in Geneva by 23 nations, 30 October 1947.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Under which agreement International Monetary Fund was established?Bretton Woods Agreement

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  IMF → formally established under the Bretton Woods Agreement on 27 December 1945.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Don't fall for look-alike names such as 'Bretton Stone' or 'S. Woods' Agreement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • At present, how many countries are the members of the International Monetary Fund (IMF)?190

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  IMF has 190 member countries; Andorra became the 190th member in October 2020.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • When did India become a member of International Monetary Fund?1945

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  India → founding member of IMF and World Bank; became a member of both on 27 December 1945. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • What are the special drawing rights percentage and vote percentage respectively of India in International Monetary Fund (IMF)?2.75%, 2.63%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  India in IMF (as on June 2024) → 2.75% of SDR quota and 2.63% of votes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Don't swap the two: quota share (2.75%) is higher than vote share (2.63%).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Gold Tranche (Reserve Tranche) refers to:a credit system granted by IMF to its members

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Gold Tranche (Reserve Tranche) → IMF credit to members; an unconditional drawing right on the IMF, usable any time without conditions or fee; normally 25% of quota.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ‘Rapid Financing Instrument’ and ‘Rapid Credit Facility’ are related to the provisions of lending by which one of the following?International Monetary Fund

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Rapid Financing Instrument (RFI) and Rapid Credit Facility (RCF) → IMF lending windows for member countries with an urgent balance of payments need.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The term 'paper gold' refers to:Special Drawing Rights (SDR) of IMF

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  'Paper gold' → Special Drawing Rights (SDR) of IMF: an international reserve asset and IMF's unit of account, added to members' foreign currency and gold reserves. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Recently, which one of the following currencies has been proposed to be added to the basket of IMF’s SDR?Renminbi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Chinese renminbi (yuan) added to IMF's SDR basket (decided November 2015, effective October 1, 2016), joining US dollar, euro, Japanese yen and pound sterling.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following organizations brings out the publication known as ‘World Economic Outlook'?The International Monetary Fund

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  World Economic Outlook → IMF; Human Development Report → UNDP; World Development Report → World Bank; Global Competitiveness Report → World Economic Forum.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Don't link 'World Economic Outlook' to the World Economic Forum just because of the name.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ‘Global Finance Stability Report’is prepared by the:International Monetary Fund

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Global Financial Stability Report → IMF, released twice a year (April and October); assesses the global financial system and markets.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In October 2018, which Economist has been appointed as Economic Counsellor and Director of the IMF’s Research Department?Geeta Gopinath

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Gita Gopinath (Harvard) → IMF Economic Counsellor and Research Director (Chief Economist), appointed October 2018; First Deputy Managing Director since 21 January 2022.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The main security guard of international trade is:WTO

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  WTO → main security guard of international trade; started 1 January 1995 under Marrakesh Agreement (signed 15 April 1994), replacing GATT, its earlier form. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The headquarters of W.T.O. is located atGeneva

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  WTO headquarters → Geneva, Switzerland. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Practise this hour: 40 questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Spaced review: 15 questions from earlier hours

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Your weak questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Hour 40 →

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Hour 40 of 72 · Learn

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        International Organizations · part 2 of 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        69 facts · 73 questions · 4 Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following statements: The Ministerial Meeting of WTO held in December 1999 was unsuccessful because it attempted to link trade with:1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3rd WTO Ministerial Conference, Seattle (USA), 30 November-3 December 1999 → failed over linking trade with labour standards and environment issues.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • One of the important agreements reached in the 1996 Ministrial Conference of WTO refers to:Commerce in Information Technology

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1st WTO Ministerial Conference, Singapore, 9-13 December 1996 → agreement on expanding world trade in information technology products.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Doha, where Ministerial Conference of World Trade Organization was organized, is located in:Qatar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Doha (Qatar) → 4th WTO Ministerial Conference, November 2001, launched Doha Development Agenda; 12th MC Geneva June 2022; 13th MC Abu Dhabi 2024.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • As regards the use of international food safety standards as reference point for the dispute settlements, which one of the following does WTO collaborates with?CodexAlimentarius Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        WTO uses food safety standards of the Codex Alimentarius Commission (set up 1963 by FAO and WHO) as reference point in dispute settlement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following were the aims behind the setting up of the World Trade Organization (WTO)?1,2,3, and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        WTO aims → free trade and resource flows, protection of intellectual property rights, balanced trade, East Bloc-West trade; started 1 January 1995. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • As President of World Trade Organization Pascal Lamy was replaced by:Roberto Azevedo

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Roberto Azevedo (Brazil) → 6th WTO Director-General, replaced Pascal Lamy on 1 September 2013; Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala (Nigeria) → seventh DG from 1 March 2021.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse WTO's head is the Director-General, not a 'President' as the question says.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • India became the member of WTO (World Trade Organization) in the year:1995

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        India → WTO member since 1 January 1995 (founding); GATT member since 8 July 1948; WTO has 164 members (Afghanistan 164th, 29 July 2016).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one among the following countries recently joined World Trade Organization as the 147th member:Nepal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Nepal → 147th WTO member on 23 April 2004.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following is not a member of World Trade Organization?Serbia

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Serbia is not a WTO member; it only has observer status (Slovenia, Slovakia and Colombia are members).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What is not true about the World Trade Organization (WTO)?It has brought liberalization in trade

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        WTO: set up 1 January 1995, born of the Uruguay Round (1986-93) of GATT; aims at trade liberalisation but is still far from achieving it (book).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The central issue in Doha Round oftalks of World Trade Organization was:Issues related to agriculture

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Doha Round (launched at 4th WTO Ministerial, Doha, November 2001) → central issue: agriculture, especially farm subsidies.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following is not included in the main three pillars of the 'Agreement on Agriculture' under the World Trade Organization?Anti-dumping and compensatory duties

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        WTO Agreement on Agriculture (Uruguay Round, in force 1 January 1995) three pillars → market access, domestic support, export competition; anti-dumping duties are not a pillar.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The difference of the Government Minimum Support Price (MSP) and market price, which is paid directly to the farmers under W.T.O. is called:Blue box subsidies

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Blue box → direct payments to farmers under production-limiting programmes (e.g. gap between MSP and market price); WTO subsidy boxes: green, amber, blue. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid Traffic lights: green = go (permitted), amber = slow down (reduce), red = stop (no red box in AoA).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse India's MSP itself is amber box; NITI Aayog's Price Deficiency Payment (MSP minus market price) would be blue box.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following statements about farm subsidies in India.1 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Fertilizer input subsidy and cuts in power/irrigation bills → indirect farm subsidies (not direct); WTO does not ban indirect subsidies; book treats all Indian subsidies as indirect.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • In the context of the affairs of which of the following is the phrase ‘Special Safeguard Mechanisms’ mentioned in the news frequently?World Trade Organization

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Special Safeguard Mechanism (SSM) → WTO tool letting developing countries temporarily raise tariffs on farm imports during import surges or price falls.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Most-Favoured-Nation (MFN) clause under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) implies:Most favour to all countries

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Most-Favoured-Nation (MFN) clause (GATT/WTO) → a trade concession given to one member must go to all members; means equal treatment, not favouritism.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • GATT stands for:General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        GATT = General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade; signed 30 October 1947 at Geneva by 23 countries; in force from 1948, office at Geneva. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Dunkel proposal is related to:Right to Intellectual Property

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Dunkel proposal (draft, December 1991, Uruguay Round of GATT) → related to intellectual property rights (TRIPS), plus services (GATS) and investment (TRIMs).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The name of Arthur Dunkel is associated with:GATT

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Arthur Dunkel → Director General of GATT (1980-1993); launched the Uruguay Round in September 1986, which led to WTO. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following statement/statements about the Dunkel draft is/are correct?Only 1, 2 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Dunkel draft (book): mandatory for India to accept all proposals; cut farm subsidies; accepted by Parliament; it did not keep the Multi-fibre Agreement (replaced by Agreement on Textiles and Clothing).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Uruguay round pertains to:GATT

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Uruguay Round (1986-1993, 8th round, 123 countries) → GATT trade talks that led to creation of WTO.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • TRIMs stands for:Trade-Related Investment Measures

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        TRIMs = Trade-Related Investment Measures (WTO, Uruguay Round) → bars investment rules that favour domestic firms; applies only to trade in goods.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • With reference to Trade-Related Investment Measures (TRIMs), which of the following statements is/are correct?1 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        TRIMs → quantitative restrictions on imports by foreign investors are prohibited; covers trade in goods only (not services); not concerned with regulating foreign investment itself.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following statements:1 and 2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement → part of 2013 Bali Ministerial package; India ratified April 2016 (76th member); in force February 2017, not January 2016.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Following are the subjects of Trade-Related Intellectual Property Rights related to trade:1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        TRIPS covers copyright, trade marks, industrial designs, geographical indications and more; labour standards are not part of TRIPS.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following is not included in TRIPS agreement for granting protection?Plant Breeding

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        TRIPS protects trade marks, layout-designs of integrated circuits, geographical indications, patents, trade secrets, copyright; plant breeding is not included.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the investments in the following assets:Only three

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Intangible investments → brand recognition, intellectual property, mailing list of clients (customer lists); inventory is a tangible asset.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid If you cannot touch it, it is intangible.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • With reference to the ‘National Intellectual Property Rights Policy’, consider the following statements:Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        National IPR Policy (May 2016) → reiterates India's commitment to Doha Development Agenda and TRIPS; DIPP is the nodal agency for IPR in India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • India enacted The Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999 in order to comply with the obligations to:WTO

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999 → enacted to meet WTO obligations under TRIPS.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • In order to comply with TRIPSAgreement, India enacted the Geoprahical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection)Act, 1999. The difference/differences between a ‘Trade Mark’and a 'Geographical Indication' is/are:1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Trade Mark → individual/company right, can be licensed; GI → community right, cannot be licensed; GIs cover farm goods, handicrafts and manufactured goods too.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following statements – Statement (A): Under the WTO obligations, it is not necessary to reduce subsidy in India's agriculture sector.A is false, but R is true.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        WTO Agreement on Agriculture → developing countries like India also had to cut farm subsidies (export subsidy 24% by value over ten years; total AMS 13.3%).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The terms ‘Agreement on Agriculture’, ‘Agreement on the Application of Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures’ and ‘Peace Clause’ appear in news frequently in the context of the affairs of the:World Trade Organization

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        'Agreement on Agriculture', 'Agreement on Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures' and 'Peace Clause' → all World Trade Organization terms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The World Trade Organisation (WTO) is sometimes criticised for all of the following reasons except that:it has no way to solve trade disputes among member nations.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        WTO is criticised as puppet of MNCs, cutting sovereignty, favouring free trade over quality; but it does settle trade disputes (Dispute Settlement Body).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ‘Broad-based Trade and Investment Agreement (BTIA)’ is sometimes seen in the news in the context of negotiations held between India and:European Union

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Broad-based Trade and Investment Agreement (BTIA) → India-European Union talks, begun June 2007 in Brussels; stalled since 2013.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following statements about G20:Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        G20 → set up 1999 for Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors; raised to Heads of State level after the 2007-08 crisis; digital public infrastructure was India's G20 priority.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The G20 members represent:Only 1 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        G20 members → about 85% of global GDP, more than 75% of global trade (not 50%), about two-thirds of world population.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • In which one of the following groups are all the four countries members of G20?Argentina, Mexico, South Africa and Turkey

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        G20 = 19 countries + EU + African Union; includes Argentina, Mexico, South Africa, Turkey; Malaysia, New Zealand, Iran, Vietnam, Singapore are not members.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What is/are not true in reference to G20?(i) and (ii)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        G20 → 19 countries + EU + African Union; no permanent headquarters (not London); India is in Group-2 with Russia, South Africa and Turkey.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which year will India chair the prestigious G20 forum?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        India held the G20 presidency from 1 December 2022 to 30 November 2023; hosted the G20 Leaders' Summit for the first time in September 2023.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • With reference to G20 (Group of 20), which of the following statements is/are correct? I. India tookover the G20 presidency from Australia on 1st December, 2022. II. The first G20 Summit was held in Washington in 2008. Select the correct answer using the options given below:Only II

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        First G20 Summit → Washington D.C., 2008 (true); India took G20 presidency from Indonesia, not Australia, on 1 December 2022.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • With reference to the ‘G20 Common Framework’, consider the following statements:Both 1 and 2
