                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        G20 Common Framework (2020) → endorsed by G20 with the Paris Club; supports Low Income Countries with unsustainable debt, beyond the DSSI.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The term 'Base Erosion and Profit Shifting' is sometimes seen in the news in the context of:curbing of the tax evasion by multinational companies

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) → tax planning by multinationals that shifts profits to low-tax places; context: curbing tax evasion by multinational companies.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following countries have formed NAMA-11?Developing countries

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NAMA-11 → group of developing countries (India, Brazil, South Africa, Argentina, Egypt etc.) in WTO Non-Agricultural Market Access talks; seeks flexibility in opening industrial goods trade.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Digital Economy Report, 2019 issued first time by whom?UNCTAD

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Digital Economy Report → UNCTAD; first released September 2019, second in September 2021.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who among the following is the founder of 'World Economic Forum'?Klaus Schwab

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        World Economic Forum → founded 1971 by Klaus Schwab as a not-for-profit foundation; headquarters Geneva; known for its annual meeting at the end of January.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Where was the World Economic Forum Meet-2016, organized?Switzerland

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        WEF Annual Meeting 2016 → Davos-Klosters, Switzerland (January 2016); the 2024 meeting was also at Davos, 15-19 January, motto 'Rebuilding Trust'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following were underlined by Indian Prime Minister as the Global challenges at the World Economic Forum's Annual Summit at Davos (Switzerland) on 23rd January, 2018?1, 2 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        WEF Davos Summit, 23 January 2018 → PM Narendra Modi named climate change, terrorism and protectionism as global challenges (not Cold War).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following is NOT correctly matched as per the World Economic Forum's release of Global Talent Competitive Index, 2020?U.S.A. 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Global Talent Competitiveness Index 2020 (INSEAD, released at WEF Davos) → Switzerland 1, USA 2 (not 4), Singapore 3, India 72.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Global Competitiveness Report is published by the:World Economic Forum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Global Competitiveness Report / Global Competitiveness Index → World Economic Forum (yearly till 2020).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which among the following is not a parameter for estimating Global Gender Gap Index of World Economic Forum?Leisure

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        WEF Global Gender Gap Index (first 2006) → four sub-indexes: economic participation, educational attainment, political empowerment, health and survival; leisure is not one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid HEEP: Health, Education, Economy, Politics.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following gives ‘Global Gender Gap Index’ ranking to the countries of the world?World Economic Forum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Global Gender Gap Index / Report → World Economic Forum (first 2006); India 127 of 146 (2023), 129 of 146 (2024).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What is India's rank on the World Economic Forum's Global Gender Gap Index, 2020?112th

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        India in WEF Global Gender Gap Index 2020 → 112th of 153; 2023 → 127th and 2024 → 129th of 146 (Iceland top, Sudan last).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Recently, the first 'Gender Social Norms Index' was released by which of the following?United Nations Development Programme

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        First Gender Social Norms Index (GSNI) → UNDP, 5 March 2020; shows how social beliefs block gender equality in politics, work and education.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Travel and Tourism Competitive Index (TTCI) is released by:World Economic Forum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Travel and Tourism Competitiveness Index → World Economic Forum (every two years); from 2021 replaced by Travel and Tourism Development Index.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • India is a member of which of the following?1 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        India → founding member of Asian Development Bank (1966) and Colombo Plan (1951); not a member of APEC or OECD.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse Don't assume India is in APEC just because it is an Asia-Pacific country.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The India Regident Mission of Asian Development Bank is situated in:New Delhi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ADB's India Resident Mission → New Delhi (opened 1992).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following:1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        India is a member of all three → AIIB (founding member, second-largest vote; HQ Beijing), MTCR (2016) and SCO (2017).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The headquarters of European Economic Community is at:Brussels

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        European Economic Community → created by Treaty of Rome, 1957; headquarters Brussels; became the European Community within the EU in 1993.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following statements about the European Union:1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        EU: earlier European Community; Single European Act (1986) and Maastricht Treaty were milestones; citizens have dual citizenship; Switzerland is not an EU member.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following country is not a member of European Union?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Poland joined the EU only in 2004 (not a member in 1997); EU now has 27 members incl. France, Germany, Italy, Poland; UK left 31 January 2020.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ‘European Stability Mechanism’, sometimes seen in the news, is an:agency of EU that provides financial assistance to eurozone countries.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        European Stability Mechanism (2012, Luxembourg) → EU agency giving financial help to eurozone countries in distress; successor of European Financial Stability Facility.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following statements: The 'Stability and Growth Pact' of the European Union is a treaty that:Only one

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        EU Stability and Growth Pact (1997) → limits budget deficit to 3% and debt to 60% of GDP; nothing about sharing infrastructure or technology.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The term ‘Digital Single Market Strategy’ seen in the news, refers to:EU

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Digital Single Market Strategy → European Union (announced May 2015 by Juncker Commission); covers digital marketing, e-commerce and telecom.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following statements: Statement-I: Recently, the United States of America (USA) and the European Union (EU) have launched the 'Trade and Technology Council'. Statement-II: The USA and the EU claim that through this they are trying to bring technological progress and physical productivity under their control. Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        EU-US Trade and Technology Council → launched June 15, 2021 in Brussels to coordinate trade and technology issues; not to control technological progress (Statement-II false).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following infrastructure sectors:Only three

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        UNOPS S3i (set up March 2020) → invests in affordable housing, renewable energy and health infrastructure; mass rapid transport is not a focus.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The FAO accords the states of ‘Globally Important Agricultural Heritage System (GIAHS)’ to traditional agricultural systems. What is the overall goal of this initiative?2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        FAO's GIAHS (started 2002) → goal: identify and safeguard eco-friendly traditional farm practices, landscapes, agro-biodiversity and local knowledge; not modern technology or GI status.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The 100th ILOAnnual Conference has decided to protect the interest of:Domestic workers

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        100th ILO Conference (1-17 June 2011) → adopted standards to protect domestic workers; ILO created 1919 under the Treaty of Versailles.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • International Labour Organization’s Conventions 138 and 182 are related to:Child labour

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ILO Conventions 138 (Minimum Age) and 182 (Worst Forms of Child Labour) → child labour; India's Cabinet approved ratifying both in March 2017.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Assertion (A): The United States of America has threatened to ask the World Trade Organization (WTO) to apply sanctions against the developing countries for the non-observance of ILO conventions.(A) is true, but (R) is false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        USA presses developing countries on ILO labour standards (threat of WTO sanctions) but is itself unconcerned with implementing them → A true, R false.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)
