                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • World Social Protection Report is published by:International Labour Organization

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              World Social Protection Report → International Labour Organization (ILO).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • World Social Security Report is released by which of the following?ILO

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              World Social Security Report → earlier released by ILO; ILO now releases the World Social Protection Report instead.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • To integrate cultural leaders into its meetings, which one of the following gives ‘Crystal Award’?World Economic Forum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Crystal Award → World Economic Forum, given annually to artists and cultural leaders who inspire change.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • UNSC stands for:United Nations Security Council

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              UNSC = United Nations Security Council → 5 permanent members (China, US, France, Russia, UK) + 10 non-permanent members elected for two years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Match the following:2 1 4 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              WTO → generally forbids quantitative restrictions in trade; IMF → finance to correct balance of payments; SAARC → South Asian cooperation; IDA → soft loans.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • With reference to the International Monetary and Financial Committee (IMFC), consider the following statements:Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              IMFC (24 members, meets twice a year) → discusses global economic concerns and advises IMF on the direction of its work; World Bank attends as observer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following organizations' headquarters is correct?WTO – Geneva

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Headquarters → UNO New York; WTO Geneva; ILO Geneva; FAO Rome.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Don't swap them: ILO is in Geneva, FAO is in Rome.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In which of the following city is the headquarter of Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) situated?Rome

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), UN agency fighting hunger → headquarters Rome.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • How many members of UNO are there?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              UN members: 191 till 2005; Montenegro 192nd (28 June 2006); South Sudan 193rd (14 July 2011); now 193 member states.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following is not related to United Nations?Bank for International Settlements

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Bank for International Settlements → not related to the UN (coordinates central banks); MIGA, IFC and ICSID are World Bank Group units, part of the UN system.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following countries:1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              UNCTAD 'Emerging Economies' → Brazil, Mexico and South Africa (also China, India, Argentina, Indonesia, Russia and others).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • With reference to ‘Asia-Pacific Ministerial Conference on Housing and Urban Development (APMCHUD)’, consider the following statements:Neither 1 nor 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              First APMCHUD → New Delhi, December 2006, theme 'A vision for sustainable urbanization in the Asia-Pacific by 2020'; biennial, hosted by different countries.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • With reference to the ‘Trans-Pacific Partnership’ consider the following statements:Neither 1 nor 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Trans-Pacific Partnership → trade deal of 12 Pacific Rim countries (signed 4 February 2016), not all Rim nations, not maritime security; replaced by CPTPP (TPP-11) after US exit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following countries is not a member of Asia-Pacific Trade Agreement (APTA)?Myanmar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Asia-Pacific Trade Agreement (APTA, earlier Bangkok Agreement, 1975) → Bangladesh, China, India, South Korea, Lao PDR, Mongolia, Sri Lanka; Myanmar is not a member.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 13 NAM conference 24-25 February, 2003 was organized at:Kuala Lumpur

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              13th NAM Summit → Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, February 2003; 19th → Kampala, Uganda, January 2024; NAM founded 1961 at Belgrade, now 121 countries.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Where was the Ministerial Meeting of the Coordinating Bureau of Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) held in 2019?Venezuela

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NAM Coordinating Bureau Ministerial Meeting 2019 → Caracas, Venezuela (20-21 July); 18th NAM Summit → Baku, Azerbaijan, October 2019.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The main emphasis of OPEC (Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries) is on which of the following?Both (a) and (b)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              OPEC (founded 14 September 1960, Baghdad; 12 members) → emphasis on both production and prices of petroleum, to stabilise oil markets.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following countries is not a member of OPEC?China; Indonesia

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              China is not an OPEC member; OPEC (Baghdad 1960, HQ Vienna) has 12 members incl. Algeria, UAE; Indonesia suspended membership on 30 November 2016.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following is not a member of ‘South Asian Association of Regional Cooperation’ (SAARC)?Thailand

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              SAARC → 8 South Asian members; founded 8 December 1985 at Dhaka by 7 countries; HQ Kathmandu; Afghanistan joined 2007; Thailand and Cambodia are not members. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid MBBS PAIN: Maldives, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Afghanistan, India, Nepal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Indian Grain Storage Management and Research Institute for providing training to the SAARC member countries is situated at:Hapur

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Indian Grain Storage Management and Research Institute (IGMRI) → Hapur, Uttar Pradesh; trains SAARC officials; set up 1958 as Grain Storage Research and Training Centre.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In which year, for the first time, SAARC meet was organized in India?1986

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              First SAARC summit in India → November 1986; SAARC secretariat Kathmandu; 18th summit Kathmandu 2014; 19th (Islamabad, 2016) was cancelled.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following is different from the rest?SAARC

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              UNICEF, IMF and WHO → global organisations; SAARC → regional body of 8 South Asian countries, so it is the odd one out.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Where UNICEF Headquarter is situated?New York

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              UNICEF (United Nations Children's Fund) → headquarters New York.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Where is the BRICS Summit, 2019 scheduled to be held?Brazil

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Eleventh BRICS Summit 2019 → Brasilia, Brazil (November); 12th (2020) held by video due to COVID-19; 13th (2021) hosted by India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • With reference to a grouping of countries known as BRICS, consider the following statements:2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              First BRIC summit → Yekaterinburg, Russia, 16 June 2009 (not Rio); South Africa joined last, September 2010 → BRIC became BRICS; Canada is not a member. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Since 1 January 2024 Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and UAE have also joined, taking BRICS to 9.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The host country of the 9th BRICS Summit is:China

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              9th BRICS Summit → Xiamen, China, 2017; 15th → Johannesburg, South Africa, 2023; 16th → Russia, 2024.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which bank has been established in China by BRICS countries?New Development Bank

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              New Development Bank (BRICS bank) → agreed at 6th BRICS summit, Fortaleza, July 2014; in force July 2015; HQ Shanghai; set up by BRICS, not APEC. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who coined the term BRICs in 2001?Jim O' Neil

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Term 'BRIC' coined in 2001 by British economist Jim O'Neill (Goldman Sachs) in 'Building Better Global Economic BRICs'; his subject → economics.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who is appointed as the first President of New Development Bank (or BRICS bank)?K.V. Kamath

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              K.V. Kamath → first President of New Development Bank (2015); succeeded by Marcos Troyjo (2020) and Dilma Rousseff (March 2023).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • With reference to BRIC countries, consider the following statements:1 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              BRIC: China's GDP exceeds the combined GDP of Brazil, Russia and India (true); China's population is not more than any two others combined (India + Brazil exceed it).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following BRICS’ nations has highest per capita income?China

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Highest per capita income among given BRICS nations → China (World Bank, 2022); Russia was highest in 2010; India is near the bottom.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in which India, was inducted as a full member was held at:Astana

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India and Pakistan became full SCO members in 2017 at the Astana summit; SCO founded 15 June 2001, Shanghai; Shanghai Five (1996) never included Vietnam. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following countries is not a member of SCO?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India was only an observer in SCO in 2010; it became a full SCO member in 2017.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Identify the Regional Grouping, in which India is not associated as a full member?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India is a full member of BASIC, G-4 and BRICS; it joined SCO only in 2017, so it was not an SCO member in 2013.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following is not a member of ‘Gulf Cooperation Council’?Iran

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Gulf Cooperation Council (1981, HQ Riyadh) → Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE; Iran is not a member.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following is not a member of The Ganga-Mekong Swarnbhoomi Cooperation Project:Bangladesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Mekong-Ganga Cooperation (launched November 2000, Vientiane, Laos) → 6 members: India, Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia, Laos, Vietnam; Bangladesh and China are not members. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Four MGC areas: tourism, culture, education, transport.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following statements is/are true about the three day International Seminar on 'Climate Smart Farming System' for BIMSTEC countries held during December 11-13, 2019?Only 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              BIMSTEC seminar on 'Climate Smart Farming System' (December 11-13, 2019) → held at New Delhi, not Kathmandu; aimed at climate-resilient tropical smallholder farming.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following groups of countries is known as 'Benelux Countries'?Belgium, Netherlands, Luxembourg

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Benelux countries → Belgium, Netherlands, Luxembourg.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid BE-NE-LUX = BElgium, NEtherlands, LUXembourg.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • "They are fantastically diverse. They speak hundreds of languages and dialects. They comprise scores of ethnic groups. They include highly industrialized economics and up-and-coming economies. They span halfthe surface of the earth and are home to two-fifths of the world's population." The group of countries referred to here belongs to:APEC

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              APEC (1989, HQ Singapore) → 21 diverse Pacific Rim economies spanning half the earth's surface, home to two-fifths of world population; promotes free trade.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following is not associated with NAFTA?Great Britain

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NAFTA (in force 1 January 1994) → Canada, Mexico and USA only; Great Britain not part; replaced by USMCA (agreed September 2018).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The latest regional economic bloc to be formed is:NAFTA

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Formation years → COMECON 1949, ASEAN 1967, APEC 1989, NAFTA 1994 (the latest of the four).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In which year was the SAPTA (South Asian Preferential Trade Agreement) constituted?1993

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              SAPTA (SAARC Preferential Trading Arrangement) → signed 11th April 1993 at the Seventh SAARC Summit, Dhaka; SAFTA agreed January 6, 2004 at 12th summit, Islamabad.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following agreements: I. ISLFTA(India-Sri Lanka Free Trade Agreement) II. SAFTA(South Asian Free Trade Area) III. CECA (Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement between India and Singapore) IV. SAPTA (South Asian Preferential Trade Arrangement) Which of the following is the correct chronological order of the above agreements?IV – I – II – III

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Chronology → SAPTA (1993) → India-Sri Lanka FTA (signed 1998) → SAFTA (2004) → India-Singapore CECA (2005).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid S-I-S-C: SAPTA, ISLFTA, SAFTA, CECA.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following pairs:2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Headquarters → ADB Manila (not Tokyo); APEC Singapore (correct); ASEAN Jakarta (not Bangkok).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • G-15 is:An organization of developing countries of the World

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              G-15 → informal forum of developing countries of the world; set up September 1989 at the 9th NAM summit, Belgrade; HQ Geneva.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following countries is not a member of the G-8 Group?Spain

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              G-7 → France, Germany, Italy, UK, Japan, USA, Canada (G-6 in 1975); Russia joined 1997 → G-8, suspended 2014; Spain and India never members.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The 37 Summit of G-8 was held in France on 26-27 May 2011 at:Deauville

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              37th G-8 summit → Deauville, France, 26-27 May 2011; 50th G-7 summit → Fasano, Apulia, Italy, June 2024.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • G-8 Maskoka Initiative is concerned with:Maternity and Child Health

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              G-8 Muskoka Initiative (36th summit, Huntsville-Muskoka, Canada) → maternal, newborn and child health; extra $5 billion for MDGs 4 and 5 (2010-2015).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • With reference to ‘Indian Ocean Rim Association for Regional Cooperation (1OR-ARC)’, consider the following statements:Neither 1 nor 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              IOR-ARC (now IORA) → set up 7 March 1997 at Port Louis, Mauritius, for trade and socio-economic cooperation; not recent, not only maritime security; 23 members.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A group formed by India, China, Brazil and other developing countries for future negotiations at World Trade Organization is known as:G-77

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              G-77 → formed 15 June 1964 by India, China, Brazil and other developing countries to negotiate jointly in the UN and WTO.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following is not a member of ASEAN?India

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ASEAN = Association of South-East Asian Nations; founded 8 August 1967, Bangkok; 10 members; HQ Jakarta; India and South Korea are not members. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Of which one group of Nations is Brunei a member?ASEAN

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Brunei → member of ASEAN (not NATO, EEC or SAARC).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following countries:1, 3, 4 and 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ASEAN's FTA partners → Australia, New Zealand, China, India, South Korea, Japan, Hong Kong; not Canada or USA; India opted out of RCEP (November 2019).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The term 'Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership' often appears in the news in the context of the affairs of a group of countries known as:ASEAN

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              RCEP → FTA of 10 ASEAN members + Australia, China, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand; signed 15th November 2020; in force 1 January 2022; Pakistan not a member.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • India is a member of which among the following?3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India is a member of the East Asia Summit (set up 14th December 2005; 18 members), but not of APEC or ASEAN.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following statements is/are true about Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (CDRI)? I. India is a member of CDRI. II. It is a UN agency. III. Its headquarters is located in Paris. IV. It was launched during G20 Summit, 2023. Select the correct answer from the options given below:Only I

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              CDRI → launched by PM Modi at UN Climate Action Summit, September 2019; India founding member; HQ New Delhi; not a UN agency, not Paris, not G20 2023.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • With reference to 'Water Credit', consider the following statements:1 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              WaterCredit → Water.org initiative using microfinance in water and sanitation, so the poor meet water needs without subsidies; not a WHO/World Bank initiative.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Adam Smith (Scottish economist) → 'Father of Modern Economics' and 'Father of Capitalism'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following sets of economists strongly favoured a market economy?Adam Smith, Ricardo, J.K. Galbraith

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Free competition and free trade → classical school led by Adam Smith ('Wealth of Nations', 1776) with Ricardo, J.S. Mill, J.B. Say; book's answer: Smith, Ricardo, Galbraith.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Who is the author of the book 'Wealth of Nations'?Adam Smith

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          'An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations' (1776) → Adam Smith; foundation of classical economics.

Galbraith and Amartya Sen).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following is not included in country's wealth?Money supply

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A country's wealth includes mines, dams and livestock; money supply is not counted in it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Who is the author of the book 'The Accumulation of Capital'?Mrs. Joan Robinson

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          'The Accumulation of Capital' (1956) → Joan Robinson; basic theory for problems of a developing economy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The term 'Prisoner’s Dilemma' is associated with which one of the following?A situation under the game theory

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Prisoner's Dilemma → game theory situation where two rational individuals may not cooperate even when cooperation is in their best interest.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Who is the father of scientific management?F.W. Taylor

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          F.W. Taylor → father of scientific management ('Taylorism'); book 'The Principles of Scientific Management' (1911).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • One common agreement between Gandhismand Marxism is:the final goal of a stateless society

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Gandhism and Marxism agree on the final goal → a stateless (and classless) society; Gandhi by non-violent means (Rama Rajya), Marx by violent means.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The theory of trusteeship of business assets was pronounced by:Mahatma Gandhi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Theory of trusteeship of business assets → Mahatma Gandhi; assets held in trust for society's welfare, a middle path between capitalism and Marxism.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Gandhian economy is based on the principle of:Trusteeship

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Gandhian economy → based on trusteeship (propounded by Mahatma Gandhi): the wealthy act as trustees for the welfare of the people. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Drishti (Vision) 2025 of ICAR → increase in food production.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following statements: Statement-I: Carbon markets are likely to be one of the most widespread tools in the fight against climate change. Statement-II: Carbon markets transfer resources from the private sector to the State. Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is not the correct explanation for Statement-I

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Carbon markets → among the most widespread tools against climate change; like taxes they shift resources from private sector to State, but that does not explain Statement-I.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The term'Intended Nationally Determined Contributions' is sometimes seen in the news in the context of:Plan of action outlined by the countries of the world to combat climate change

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          INDCs (Intended Nationally Determined Contributions) → countries' post-2020 climate action plans; they become NDCs once a country ratifies the Paris Agreement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The term ‘Domestic Content Requirement’ is sometimes seen in the news with reference to:Developing solar power production in our country

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Domestic Content Requirement → Jawaharlal Nehru National Solar Mission (2010) rule favouring Indian-made solar panels; US called it a non-tariff barrier.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • With reference to the Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited (IREDA), which of the following statements is/are correct?Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          CAMPA (Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority) exists at both National and State levels; Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act 2016 does not make people's participation mandatory.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In India, ‘extended producer responsibility’ was introduced as an important feature in which of the following?The e-Waste (Management and Handling) Rules, 2011

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Extended producer responsibility (producers responsible for disposal of post-consumer products) → first introduced in e-Waste (Management and Handling) Rules, 2011.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In international policy processes, which of the following is not a specific achievement with which women's empowerment is implicitly equated with:Strategic Choices

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Women's empowerment in international policy is equated with political participation, legal reforms and economic security; 'strategic choices' (a sociology doctrine) is not one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Rural Electrification Policy (23 August 2006) → electricity access to all households by 2009; minimum lifeline 1 unit per household per day by 2012.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Union Budget 2006-07 → target to add 15,000 MW of power capacity by March 2007; India's installed capacity 444757 MW on 31 May 2024.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Renewable energy share of India's generation capacity → about 11% (December 2011); 33.0% (146652 MW of 444757 MW) on 31.5.2024.
