                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                UDAY (Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana, November 2015) → financial turnaround of power DISCOMs; cuts their interest burden, power cost and losses.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following is a purpose of 'UDAY', a scheme of the Government?Providing for financial turnaround and revival of power distribution companies

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                UDAY (approved 5th November 2015, Ministry of Power) → financial turnaround and revival of power distribution companies (DISCOMs).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following is not correctly matched?Primary Energy – Tidal Power

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Tides are primary energy but tidal power is converted (secondary) energy, so 'Primary Energy – Tidal Power' is wrong; oil and gas commercial; dung non-commercial; solar non-conventional.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements. Regional disparities in India are high and have been rising in recent years because:1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Regional disparities in India → investment only in select places, agro-climatically poor areas, little agrarian transformation; political instability is not counted.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The East-West corridor of the Golden Quadrilateral connects which of the following centers (nodes)?Silchar and Porbander

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Golden Quadrilateral links Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, Chennai; East-West corridor → Silchar to Porbander; North-South → Srinagar to Kanyakumari; the two cross at Jhansi.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following statements is not correct regarding the roadways of Madhya Pradesh according to Basic Road Statistics 2018-19?This State ranks first in the country in road density.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Basic Road Statistics 2018-19 → highest road density in Chandigarh, then Delhi, Puducherry, Lakshadweep, Kerala; Madhya Pradesh is not first.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In which of the following States, India's first Railway line has been made under public-private partnership model?Gujarat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                India's first PPP broad-gauge railway line → Gujarat, Tuna Tekra Port to Gandhidham, dedicated on 14 July 2015.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • How many railways stations have been identified for modernization under 'Amrit Bharat Station Scheme' in Uttar Pradesh as on February, 2023?149

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Amrit Bharat Station Scheme → 149 UP stations identified (February 2023); later 156 of 1309 stations nationwide (December 2023).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The cities which are included in 'Golden Triangle' of Indian Tourism are:Agra, Delhi and Jaipur

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Golden Triangle of Indian tourism → Delhi, Agra and Jaipur (triangle shape on the map).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • More than one-third of the crude steel production of the world comes from:China

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                China → over one-third of world crude steel (question period); about 53.86% in 2023 (1019.1 of 1892.2 million tonnes); India second (140.8 million tonnes).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • As of early 2022, which country was at the top in steel production in the world?China

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Top steel producer (early 2022 and 2023) → China, followed by India and Japan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Kamaiya system is:a system of bonded labour in Nepal which continues from generation to generation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Kamaiya system → bonded labour in Nepal passed from generation to generation; abolished after protests in 2000 and 2006.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following statements is not correct?India was a supplier of manufacturing goods during British rule.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Under British rule India supplied raw materials, not manufactured goods; its economy stagnated; British colony till 1947 (from Plassey, 1757).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following statements about Arthashastra is not true?It describes the then economic life of the country.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Kautilya's Arthashastra → treatise on statecraft, economic policy, military strategy: king's duties, politics, financial reforms; book says it does not describe the then economic life.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In how many adhikarnas is the Kautilya Arthashastra divided?15

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Kautilya's Arthashastra → divided into 15 adhikaranas (books).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • What is the meaning of'Athavana'?Revenue department

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Athavana → Department of Revenue in the Vijayanagar administration.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ‘TRAI’ is a regulatory body associated with which of the following sectors?Telecom

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                TRAI → telecom regulator, set up 20 February 1997 by the TRAI Act, 1997; regulates telecom services and tariffs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following statements are true about Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI)? I. It was first established in 1997. II. It is a statutory body. III. It was established to regulate telecom services, including fixation/revising tariffs. IV. Its headquarters is located in Mumbai. Select the correct answer:Only I, II and III

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                TRAI → set up 1997; statutory body; regulates telecom services and tariffs; headquarters New Delhi, not Mumbai.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • India is divided into how many PIN zones?8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                India has 9 PIN zones: 8 for States/UTs + 9th for Army Post Office and Field Post Office; book's answer counts the 8 State zones.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements:1 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Post offices exceed 1.5 lakh (159225 in December 2022); BSNL formed 2000 (not 1997); TRAI set up 1997 (not 2000). Only statement 1 correct.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse TRAI (1997) came before BSNL (2000); the statements swap the years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 'Project Arrow' is concerned with the modernization of which of the following?Post Offices

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Project Arrow (India Post, April 2008) → modernisation of Post Offices; improves core operations and ambience, giving post offices a new identity. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which bank has been presented with the ‘Asian Banking Award 2001’for operational efficiency in treasury operations:Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Asian Banking Award 2001 for efficient treasury operations → Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In which State, India’s largest Naphtha Cracker Plant was inaugurated by Union Petroleum Minister in February, 2011?Haryana

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                India's largest Naphtha Cracker Plant → IOC's Panipat complex, Haryana, inaugurated February 2011.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • How much is one barrel of oil approximately?159 litres

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                One barrel of oil ≈ 159 litres (158.9873 litres = 42 US gallons).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Weight of L.P.G. in Kilogram filled in non-domestic gas cylinder is:19.0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                LPG cylinder weight → non-domestic 19.0 kg; domestic 14.2 kg (other sizes: 5 kg, 47.5 kg, 425 kg).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse Don't swap: 14.2 kg is the domestic cylinder, 19.0 kg the non-domestic one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The correct full form of PVR cinema is:Priya Village Road Show

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                PVR = Priya Village Roadshow (joint venture of Priya Exhibitors and Village Roadshow, 1995; operations from June 1997).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • As per the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, which of the following mark is made mandatory on all processed fruit products sold in our country?FPO

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                FPO (Food Products Order) mark → mandatory on all processed fruit products in India (jams, squashes, pickles etc.).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ‘AGMARK’ is related with:Quality

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                AGMARK → quality seal for agricultural products; issued by Directorate of Marketing and Inspection (not FCI) under Agricultural Produce (Grading and Marking) Act, 1937. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements:1 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                BIS Standard Mark mandatory for all automotive tyres and tubes (from 18 May 2010); AGMARK → agricultural produce, notified by DMI (Agriculture Ministry) under 1937 Act, not FAO.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ISO 14001 is:an international certificate issued to industrial units for having established Pollution Control System

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ISO 14001 → international certificate for industrial units with an established pollution control / environmental management system.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following items has not been granted protection under the Geographical Indications Act, 1998?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Lucknow Chikan Craft, Banarasi Sarees, Darjeeling Tea and Surkha Guava of Allahabad → all have GI tag protection.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 'Geographical Indication Tag' for black pottery is associated with which of the following place in Uttar Pradesh?Nizamabad

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                GI tag for black clay pottery with engraved silver patterns → Nizamabad, Azamgarh district, Uttar Pradesh (2015).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 'Eco mark' is given to the Indian products that are:environment friendly

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Eco mark → given to environment-friendly Indian products; scheme run by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Considering the geographical-environmental conditions and the culture of Rajasthan, which sector should naturally be given top-policy priority for long term, sustainable, inclusive development?Tourism

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Rajasthan (book) → tourism should get top policy priority for long-term, sustainable, inclusive development.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • At present, what is the main source of wealth in Bihar?Agriculture

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Bihar's main source of wealth → agriculture.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The country in which a major controversy has erupted regarding outsourcing:U.S.A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Outsourcing controversy → USA, where it became a big issue in the 2004 Presidential Election.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Now, Packaging has assumed importance, because:It provides all the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Packaging matters because it gives products protection, attractiveness and credibility (all of these).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • After the merger of Air India and Indian Airlines, the New entity is now known as:Air India

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Air India + Indian Airlines merged entity → Air India; founded by J.R.D. Tata as Tata Airlines (1932); sold back to Tata Group in October 2021.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The 'Transaction Fee' which has been banned by a recent Supreme Court order from being realised from customers relates to:Air journey

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Supreme Court banned the 'transaction fee' charged on air journey tickets (January 2013).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Universal Service Obligation Fund is concerned with:adjustment of liabilities of telecom companies

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Universal Service Obligation Fund (from 1.04.2002) → telecom; subsidises telegraph services in rural and remote areas; non-lapsable fund.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements:1, 3 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Vietnam → among fastest-growing economies; growth from global supply chains, exports, low labour costs and stable exchange rates; one-party Communist State; e-services still nascent.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 'Belt and Road Initiative' is sometimes mentioned in the news in the context of the affairs of:China

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Belt and Road Initiative (earlier One Belt One Road) → China's global infrastructure development strategy, adopted 2013.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yamuna (Taj) Expressway → 6-lane, 165.5 km, Greater Noida to Agra, Uttar Pradesh.
