                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Ifthe birth and death rates are the same and there is no internal or external migration, then there is no change in the population, this is known as:Stability of Population

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Birth rate = death rate and no migration → population does not change → Stability of Population (population stabilization).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Book's answer is 'Stability of Population', not 'Zero population growth' or 'Steady population'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Crude death rate in India presently stands at:below 9 percent

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's crude death rate → below 9 per thousand: 7.6 (2005, Economic Survey 2006-07); 6.0 (2020, SRS May 2022).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Death rate in India in the year 2000, is estimated to be:9 per thousand

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's death rate in 2000 → 8.5 per thousand (about 9); 6.0 per thousand in 2020 (SRS).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Among the following in which State the death rate in the year 2015 was lowest?Maharashtra

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Lowest death rate 2015 (given States) → Maharashtra (5.8); West Bengal 5.9, Gujarat 6.1, Karnataka 6.6. In 2020 range: Delhi 3.6 to Chhattisgarh 7.9.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Consider the following statements:Neither 1 nor 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Infant Mortality Rate → deaths of infants under one year per 1000 live births in a year; not deaths within one month, not per 100.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse IMR counts deaths before the first birthday, not the fifth.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Consider the following statements about infant mortality rate:2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    IMR → deaths before age 1 per 1000 live births (not 10000); India's IMR 189.6 in 1950 and 30 in 2019 → statements 2 and 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Under the Civil Registration System (CRS), it is legally mandatory to register birth and death events within how many days in India?21 days

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969 → every birth, still birth and death must be registered within 21 days.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following States has started the death Census?Karnataka

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    First State to start a death census → Karnataka.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Infant mortality rate in India at present is nearly:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's IMR at question time (about 2000) → nearly 70 per thousand; fell to 30 (2019) and 28 per thousand live births (2020, SRS).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • According to the Census 2011, which of the following States had the lowest infant mortality rate?Kerala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    IMR, Census 2011: India 44; lowest Goa and Manipur (11), Kerala 12; highest Madhya Pradesh (59), UP and Odisha (57).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • According to the 2001 Census, which State of India has the lowest child mortality rate?Kerala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Lowest child mortality, Census 2001 → Kerala (16 per thousand); Goa 36, Maharashtra 49, Tamil Nadu 53. India's IMR 71 (2001), 44 (2011).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The lowest infant mortality in urban areas of India is found in:Kerala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Lowest urban IMR among options → Kerala; SRS 2022: Kerala 9, Tamil Nadu 10, Maharashtra 11, Gujarat 17 per thousand live births.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following States had less Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) than All India Average IMR in 2011?Tamil Nadu

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    IMR below all-India average → Tamil Nadu (17 in 2016, 13 in 2020; India 34 and 28); Rajasthan, UP, MP are above.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The target to reduce Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) during Eleventh Plan period was kept at:28 per 1000 live births

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    IMR target: 11th Plan (2007-2012) → 28 per 1000 live births by 2012; 12th Plan (2012-17) → 25. IMR still 28 in 2020.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • According to the UNICEF report, the highest child mortality rate is in:Odisha

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Highest child mortality (then UNICEF report) → Odisha (75 per 1000 live births). 2020 highest IMR: Madhya Pradesh (43), UP and Chhattisgarh (38).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Assertion (A): According to statistics, more female children are born each year than male children in India.(A) is false, but (R) is true

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    In India more male than female children are born each year (A false); death rate of male children is higher than female (R true).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which Indian State has the highest percentage of children suffering from malnutrition?Madhya Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Highest share of malnourished children (MoSPI, 2011) → Madhya Pradesh (60%); Jharkhand 56.5%, Bihar 55.9%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following ministries/organizations has released ‘Youth in India Report, 2022’?Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    'Youth in India 2022' report → Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI); youth aged 15-29 = 27.2% of population in 2021.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The Census Projection Report shows that India is one of the youngest nation in the world. In year 2020, the average age of Indians will be of:29 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Average age of Indians in 2020 → 29 years (Economic Survey 2013-14); median age 28.4 in 2021, 30.27 in 2026 (National Health Profile 2022).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • According to the 1991 Census, the highest percentage of population in India is to be found in the age-group of:5 to 14 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Census 1991: largest population share in age group 5 to 14 years. NFHS-5 (2019-21): 0-14 → 27%, 15-59 → 61%, 60+ → 12%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • According to Census 2011, what percentage of total population in India is under 14 years?29%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Population under 14 years (0-13), Census 2011 → about 29% (28.67) of India's 1210854977.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The percentage of the population in the age group 20 years and above out of the total population of India as per 2011 Census is:59.29%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Population aged 20 years and above, Census 2011 → about 59.29% of India's total population.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • According to the provisional figures of Census 2011, what percentage of population is below the age of35 years in India?65 %

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Population below 35 years, Census 2011 → 65% (provisional); 65.6% (final).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The old age dependency ratio in India (2011) is:14.2%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Old age dependency ratio (60+ vs 15-59) in India → 14.2% in 2011 (10.9% in 1961); women 14.9%, men 13.6%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • What is the approximate percentage of persons above 65 years of age in India's current population?5-6%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Persons above 65 years in India → about 5% (2005); 4.8% in Census 2011 → the 5-6% option.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • India is regarded as a country with 'Demographic Dividend'. this is due to:its high population in the age group of 15-64 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's 'Demographic Dividend' → its high share of working-age population (15-64 years).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The demographic dividend is:Working population of 15 to 59 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Demographic dividend (UPPCS 2022 answer) → working population of 15 to 59 years, since India's retirement age is generally 60.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Don't reject 15-59 here: UPPCS 2022 accepted it because India's retirement age is generally 60.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • When population experts refers to the possible 'Demographic Bonus' that may accrue to India around 2016, they are referring to the Phenomenon of:A surge in the population in the productive age group

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    'Demographic bonus' → surge in population of productive (working) age; UNFPA: when working-age share (15 to 64) exceeds non-working share.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which group refers to dependent population in the population pyramid?0-14 years group

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Dependent population in a population pyramid → 0-14 years (also 65 and above); working population → 15-64 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The Dependency Ratio in India is declining because:Population of15-59 years is relatively high

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Dependency ratio falling → working-age (15-59) share relatively high; India's age dependency ratio 79% (1975) → 58% (2008) → about 48% (2021).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • To obtain full benefits of demographic dividend, what should India do?Promoting skill development

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    To reap the demographic dividend → promote skill development (close the gap between skill demand and supply).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following is not an adverse effect of population growth in an economy?Increase in size of working population

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Not an adverse effect of population growth → bigger working population (a favourable effect); smaller holdings, unemployment, less food per head are adverse.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Role of Human Resources in Economic development, which of the following statement/s is/are correct?Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Human resources and development: both links hold → economic development affects population growth, and population growth affects economic development.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • According to recent data, in India, how many disabled people are self-dependent?2 percent

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Census 2011: 2.1% of India's population disabled; only about 2% of them self-dependent.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which State has topped the list of States with most number of beggars, as per data released by the Union Ministry of Social Justice?West Bengal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Most beggars (Census 2011; Social Justice Ministry, March 2018) → West Bengal (81244), then UP (65835); India total 413670.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Consider the decadal Census data given below:Christians

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Christians in India: 10.7 million (1961) → 18.9 million (1991, 2.25%) → about 27.8 million (2011, 2.3%).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Arrange the following religious communities of India in ascending order of their population size and select the correct answer using the codes given below: Religious community:3, 1, 4, 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Religious communities ascending (2011): Jain (4451753) < Buddhist (8442972) < Sikh (20833116) < Christian (27819588).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid J-B-S-C, smallest first: Jain, Buddhist, Sikh, Christian.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which State of India has the largest Muslim population according to the 2001 Census?Uttar Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Largest Muslim population (2001 and 2011) → Uttar Pradesh (38483967 in 2011); then West Bengal, Bihar, Maharashtra, Assam.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • According to the 1991 Census, the percentage share of Christians in the total population of the State is highest in:Nagaland

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Highest Christian share of State population → Nagaland (90% in 1991; 87.93% in 2011); then Mizoram (87.16%), Meghalaya.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The largest number of Buddhists is found in:Maharashtra

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Largest Buddhist population → Maharashtra (5838710 in 2001; 6531200 in 2011).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Statement (A): Literacy is highest in Kerala.A is true, but R is false.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Kerala has the highest literacy (A true), but the highest Christian share is in Nagaland, not Kerala (R false).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Arrange the following Indian religious communities, in descending order according to their sex-ratio, using the codes given below:3, 1, 2, 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Sex-ratio by religion, 2011 descending: Christian 1023 > Buddhist 965 > Jain 954 > Muslim 951.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which community has the lowest sex-ratio in India as disclosed in the additional data pertaining to Census 2011 released recently?Sikh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Lowest sex-ratio among religions (Census 2011 data, released 25 August 2015) → Sikh (903); Buddhist 965, Jain 954, Muslim 951.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Among the following religious groups, which one has recorded the highest percentage of literacy rate as per the 2011 Census?Jains

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Highest literacy among religious groups, Census 2011 → Jains.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • As per the 1991 Census, the average size of households in terms of number of persons per household in respect of the given states follows the sequence (highest first, lowest last).—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Average household size, Census 2001: UP 6.5 > Haryana 5.7 > Gujarat 5.25 > West Bengal 5.05 > Kerala 4.73 > Tamil Nadu 4.25.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Under the National Literacy Mission, threshold literacy rate of 75 percent was fixed. The target year for this was:2007

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    National Literacy Mission (Rajiv Gandhi, 5 May 1988) → target: sustainable threshold of 75% literacy by 2007.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The tribal population in Andaman and Nicobar Islands belongs to the:Negroid race

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Andaman and Nicobar tribes → mainly Negroid race: Great Andamanese, Onges, Jarawas, Sentinelese.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Although the human population of India is increasing at a rapid rate, the bird population is declining rapidly because:3 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Bird decline in India → habitat loss and heavy use of insecticides, chemical fertilizers, mosquito repellants (not predators or organic inputs).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following is not an effect ofpopulation growth in India?Increase in wildlife

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Population growth in India → more floods and pollution, less cultivable land, fewer wild animals; 'increase in wildlife' is not an effect.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Assertion (A): Ganga Plain is the most densely populated part of India.Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of(A)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Ganga Plain → most densely populated part of India because Ganga is India's most harnessed river (A and R true; R explains A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Progressive population-resource areas of India includes:1 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Progressive population-resource regions: West Bengal delta, Deccan Trap, Tamil Nadu, Punjab Plain and Ganga-Yamuna Doab, South-East Karnataka Plateau.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          India : Urbanization · part 1 of 3
