                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Recently, India’s first ‘National Investment and Manufacturing Zone’ was proposed to be set up in:Andhra Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    First National Investment and Manufacturing Zone proposed → Prakasam district, Andhra Pradesh; NIMZs are tools of National Manufacturing Policy, 2011. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Logo of'Make in India' is:Lion

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Make in India logo → silhouette of a lion on the move; initiative launched September 2014. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ‘Stand-up India’Scheme’s purpose is:To encourage entrepreneurship among the SC/STs and women entrepreneur

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Stand-Up India (5 April 2016) → bank loans of 10 lakh to 1 crore to at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower per branch for a greenfield enterprise. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following activities has not been included in the Industrial Production Index of India?Construction

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    IIP (by NSO, monthly) covers mining, manufacturing, electricity; construction is not included (nor gas and water supply). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Consider the following statements about Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)Act, 2020:1 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    MSME revised definition: announced in Atmanirbhar Bharat Package 13th May 2020; notified 1st June 2020; effective 1st July 2020; one composite formula for manufacturing and service units. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Notification date (1st June 2020) with the date it came into effect (1st July 2020).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In Industrial Policy of 1991, the investment amount for small scale industries approved for general and auxiliary units was:Rs. 60 lakh, Rs. 75 lakh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1991 Policy: SSI limit Rs. 60 lakh (was 35), ancillary Rs. 75 lakh (was 45); MSMED Act 2006; micro now: investment ≤ Rs. 1 crore, turnover ≤ Rs. 5 crore. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid 60-75: small 60, ancillary 75 in 1991.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Investment in Plant and Machinery in a small scale manufacturing unit should be:Above Rs. 25 lakhs but not more than Rs. 5 crore

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    MSMED Act 2006, old manufacturing limits (plant and machinery): micro up to Rs. 25 lakh; small Rs. 25 lakh to 5 crore; medium Rs. 5 to 10 crore. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse These are the old 2006 limits; the revised definition uses a composite investment-plus-turnover formula.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following committees recommended the abolition of reservation of items for the small scale sector in industry?Abid Hussian Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Abid Hussain Committee (Expert Committee on Small Enterprises, 1995) → total abolition of reservation of items for small scale industries; report 1997. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In India, the highest production of mill-made cotton cloth comes from:Gujarat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Highest mill-made cotton cloth production → Gujarat (2016-17), then Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The industry for which Nepanagar is known is:Newsprint paper

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Nepanagar (Burhanpur, Madhya Pradesh) → newsprint paper; Nepa Mills pioneered newsprint in India, production from April 1956. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Consider the following statements:Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    MMTC → India's largest international trading organisation and government trading company; Neelachal Ispat Nigam (1982, Kalinga Nagar, Odisha) promoted by MMTC with Odisha government (IPICOL). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following does not enjoy ‘Maharatna’ status(as on February 2013)?Oil India Limited

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Not Maharatna (February 2013) → Oil India (then Navratna; Maharatna in 2023) and BEL; Maharatna scheme 2010-11; now 13 Maharatna, 20 Navratna, 65 Miniratna. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid 13-20-65 = Maha, Nav, Mini (as on 30 April 2024).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Mega Food Parks scheme has been initiated by the Government of India with the objective:To improve infrastructure facilities for food processing industries

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Mega Food Parks → better infrastructure for food processing; cluster approach linking farmers, processors and retailers to cut wastage and raise farmers' income. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Concept of 'Joint Sector' for industrial development of India was envisaged in Industrial Policy Resolution of:1956

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Joint Sector concept → Industrial Policy Resolution 1956 (second policy, placed by Nehru, April 1956; expand public and co-operative sectors). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse 1948 = first policy (mixed economy); 1956 = Industrial Policy Resolution; 1991 = liberalised policy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following are the purposes to which the National Renewal Fund has been set up?1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    National Renewal Fund (February 1992) → safety net for workers hit by modernisation, restructuring or closure of sick units; funded VRS and retraining; not for refugees. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following is referred to as the ‘Golden Handshake’:Voluntary Retirement Scheme

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Golden Handshake → Voluntary Retirement Scheme (VRS), used to cut surplus staff in public and private companies. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Kandla, situated in the Gulf of Kutch, is well known for which of the following industries?Export processing zone

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Kandla (Gulf of Kutch) → Asia's first Export Processing Zone, 1965; now India's largest multi-product SEZ (KASEZ). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In India Tertiary Sector includes:1 and 2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Tertiary (services) sector: trade, transport, hotels, communication, finance, real estate; forestry, fishing and mining are not services; services share 54.9% of GVA (2023-24). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following is a tertiary activity?Marketing

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Marketing → tertiary activity; farming and forestry → primary; manufacturing → secondary; agriculture is the primary sector. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The largest share of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in India comes from:Services sector

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Largest share of India's GDP/GVA → services (tertiary) sector; order: Services > Industry > Agriculture. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • What kind of tax is GST?Indirect Tax

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    GST → single, comprehensive, multi-stage, destination-based indirect tax (from 1 July 2017); subsumed Service Tax, Central Excise and State VAT. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following Constitution (Amendment) Act provides for Goods and Services Tax (G.S.T.)?The Constitution (One Hundred and First) Amendment Act, 2016

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    GST → Constitution (One Hundred and First) Amendment Act, 2016; GST in force from 1 July 2017. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Act number (101st) differs from its Bill number (One Hundred and Twenty Second Amendment Bill).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In India, which one among the following formulates the fiscal policy?Ministry of Finance

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Fiscal policy → formulated by Ministry of Finance; monetary policy → RBI; Finance Commission (Article 280) → tax sharing between Union and States. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Economic Survey of India is related to:Ministry of Finance

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Economic Survey → Ministry of Finance (prepared by Department of Economic Affairs under the Chief Economic Adviser); presented before the Union Budget. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Economic Survey of India is published officially, every year by the:Ministry of Finance, Govt. of India

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Economic Survey → published every year by the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance; reviews the past financial year; tabled before the Budget. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In which of the following countries, zero-based budgeting was first adopted?U.S.A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Zero-based budgeting (Peter Pyhrr, 1970s) → first adopted in USA (Jimmy Carter, Georgia, 1973); India: DST 1983, Government 1986; every scheme reviewed from zero. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • As per Budget Estimates 2010-11, presented to the Parliament on 2016-02-10, arrange the following sectors in descending order as per their Central Plan outlay.2, 4, 3, 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Central Plan outlay 2010-11, descending: Energy > Social Services > Transport > Rural Development. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following come under Non-Plan Expenditure?1, 2, 3 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Non-Plan expenditure (before Budget 2017-18): subsidies, interest payments, defence, maintenance of past-plan assets, salaries, pensions, statutory transfers to States. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following did not take place in the Union Budget for 2017-18?Increase in the number of centrally sponsored schemes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Budget 2017-18 reforms: presented 1 February (a month earlier), Railway Budget merged, Plan/Non-Plan ended; no increase in centrally sponsored schemes. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which among the following is the most important item of revenue expenditure of the Union Government?Interest Payment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Largest item of revenue (and total) expenditure of the Union → interest payments (2024-25: 32.57% of revenue expenditure). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 8 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following is the most important item of Non-Plan expenditure of the Central Government during 2015-16 budget?Interest payments

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Largest Non-Plan expenditure item (2015-16) → interest payments; Plan/Non-Plan classification ended in Budget 2017-18. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following statements is/are correct with reference to India?1 and 2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Fiscal deficit: 2017-18 raised to 3.5% (from 3.2%); 2018-19 target 3.3%; 2020-21 projected 3.0% (not 3.1%); 2021-22 estimated 6.8%. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Fiscal deficit/GDP ratio has been maximumin the financial year:2011-2012

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Highest fiscal deficit/GDP among 2011-2012 to 2014-2015 → 2011-12 (5.9%); 1990-91 was 8.4%; 2020-21 hit 9.2%, highest since 1990-91. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • As per the Budget 2001-2002 the current fiscal deficit of India is:4.7 percent

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Fiscal deficit as per Budget 2001-2002 → 4.7% of GDP; 2024-25 interim → 5.1% (Rs. 1685494 crore). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Consider the following budget deficits of Central Government:2, 3, 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Descending order of deficits: Fiscal > Revenue > Primary; fiscal deficit is always higher than revenue deficit. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid F-R-P: Fiscal is Fattest, Primary is Puniest.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Match List I with List II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists:3 1 2 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Budget deficit = total expenditure – total receipts (dropped from 1997-98); Revenue = revenue expenditure – revenue receipts; Fiscal = budget deficit + borrowings; Primary = fiscal – interest payments. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Must-know questions: 40

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Hour 57 →

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Hour 57 of 72 · Revise

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Revise: Fiscal Policy & Revenue to Planning

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      42 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Cover each line, recall it, then check. Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If interest payments are subtracted from gross fiscal deficit, the remainder will be:Gross primary deficit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Primary deficit = Fiscal deficit – Interest payments; so primary deficit + interest = fiscal deficit. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Memory aid Primary deficit = today's gap without the burden of past debt's interest.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • After deducting grants for the creation of capital assets from revenue deficit, we arrive at:Effective Revenue Deficit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Effective Revenue Deficit = revenue deficit – grants for creation of capital assets; introduced in Union Budget 2011-12; added to FRBM Act in 2012. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Assertion (A): Deficit financing leads to inflation.Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of(A)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Deficit financing (new currency) raises money supply relative to goods and services → inflation (A and R true; R explains A). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • With respect to the procedure of Budget in the Parliament, "the amount of demand be reduced to Re 1" is called:Policy Cut Motion

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Cut motions: Policy Cut → demand reduced to Re 1 (disapproval of policy); Economy Cut → by a specific amount; Token Cut → by Rs. 100. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Memory aid Policy = Re 1; Token = Rs. 100; Economy = specific amount.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following is not correctly matched?Vote on Account – Parliamentary sanction of all budgetary demands for grants in a financial year

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Vote on Account → advance grant from Consolidated Fund for short-term spending until the Budget is passed; not sanction of all demands for the year. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The tax-GDP ratio in India is nearly:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Tax-GDP ratio (Centre + States) at question time → about 15%; Centre's gross tax-GDP: 11.5% in 2021-22, 11.7% in 2024-25 (B.E.). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following statements are true for the Income Tax in India? I. It is a progressive tax II. It is a direct tax III. It is collected by the State Governments IV. It is a proportional tax Code:only I and II are correct

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Income tax in India → direct and progressive; levied and collected by the Union, not States; not proportional. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following has been the most important source of the tax revenue of the Union Government in 2009-10?Corporation Tax

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Most important Union tax source in 2009-10 → Corporation Tax. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following taxes is the largest source of revenue in India?Income Tax

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Largest tax revenue source now → Income Tax (then GST, Corporation Tax); in 2004-05 and 2005-06 Union excise duties were largest. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following is not a tax/duty levied by the Government of India?Road Tax

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Road tax → levied by State governments, not the Union; service tax, education cess and customs duty are Union levies. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Match the list-I with the list-II and select the correct answer from the code given below the lists:4 2 3 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Capital Gain Tax → sale of property; Central Excise Duty → factory produce; Customs Duty → imports; Corporate tax → company income. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • MODVAT is related to:Excise duty

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MODVAT (Modified Value Added Tax, 1986) → excise duty, to reduce tax cascading; CENVAT also relates to Union excise duties. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following is not a feature of'Value Added Tax'?It is basically a subject of the Central Government and the State Governments are only a facilitator for its successful implementation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      VAT features: tax on value added at each stage, multi-point destination based, borne by final consumer; it is not mainly a Central subject. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following state have not introduced VAT system? Select the correct answer from the code given below:2 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      VAT → introduced April 01, 2005 (L.K. Jha Committee, 1978); Haryana first (April 2003); Uttar Pradesh last (2008); Chhattisgarh and UP initially stayed out. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Consider the following statements regarding Service tax.Only 2 and 3 are correct

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Service tax → indirect tax, introduced 1994-95 (Chelliah Committee); replaced by GST from 1 July 2017. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The number of services subject to Service Tax in 2009- 10 was:110

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Services under service tax in 2009-10 → 109 (nearest option 110); 117 in 2010-11, 119 in 2011-12; negative list from 2012-13. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The tax on import and export is known as:Custom duty

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Tax on imports and exports → customs duty (levied by the Union). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following is a direct tax?Wealth Tax

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Direct taxes (cannot be shifted): income, corporation, wealth, property, gift tax; indirect (shifted): customs, excise, service tax, sales tax, GST, VAT. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Generally after every five years, Finance Commission is appointed in India to:determine the share of States in the Central grants and revenue of the Union

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Finance Commission (Article 280, every fifth year) → recommends sharing of Union tax proceeds and grants between Union and States. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • With reference to the Fourteenth Finance Commission, which of the following statements is/are correct?1 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      14th Finance Commission (Dr. Y.V. Reddy, appointed 2 January 2013) → States' share raised from 32% to 42%; no sector-specific grants. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Who has been appointed as the Chairman of the 13th Finance Commission on 14 November, 2007?Dr. Vijay L. Kelkar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      13th Finance Commission → Dr. Vijay L. Kelkar (November 2007); award period 2010-15, from 1 April 2010. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Thirteenth Finance Commission has proposed that the combined debt-GDPratio of the Centre and the States by year 2014-15 should be:68 percent

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Thirteenth Finance Commission → combined Centre and States debt-GDP target 68% by 2014-15; also a road map for fiscal and revenue deficits. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)
