                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following is not an instrument of selective credit control in India?Variable reserve ratios

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Selective (qualitative) control → margin requirements, consumer credit regulation, credit rationing, moral suasion; quantitative → Bank Rate, OMO (securities sale), Repo, variable CRR/SLR. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid Quantitative = how much credit (rates, ratios, OMO); qualitative = where credit goes (margins, rationing).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Open market operations of Reserve Bank of India refer to:trading in securities

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Open market operations → RBI buys government securities and T-bills to raise money supply, sells them to cut it. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid OMO: Buy = boost money supply; Sell = squeeze it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • When the Reserve Bank of India reduces the Statutory Liquidity Ratio by 50 basis points, which of the following is likely to happen?Scheduled Commercial banks may cut their lending rates.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SLR cut by 50 basis points → banks get more lendable funds and may cut lending rates; SLR = share of deposits kept as cash, gold, securities. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The mandatory proportion ofthetotaldeposits and reserves of the commercial banks deposited with the Reserve Bank of India is called:Cash Reserve Ratio

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) → mandatory share of banks' deposits kept as cash with RBI. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • When the Reserve Bank of India announces an increase of the Cash Reserve Ratio, what does it mean?The commercial banks will have less money to lend

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Higher CRR → banks deposit more with RBI and have less money to lend; credit creation and money supply fall, curbing inflation. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Must-know questions: 40

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Hour 59 →

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Hour 59 of 72 · Revise

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Revise: Money and Banking to Employment & Welfare Schemes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          42 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Cover each line, recall it, then check. Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 'Repurchase Option’ is used:None of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Repo (Repurchase Option) → used by RBI to regulate money supply and inflation, not to handle rupee sell-off in exchange market. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The interest rate at which the Reserve Bank of India lends to Commercial banks in the short term to maintain liquidity is known as:Repo Rate

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Repo Rate → rate at which RBI lends short-term (overnight) funds to commercial banks against government securities under LAF. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Memory aid Repo: RBI gives money; Reverse Repo: RBI takes money.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Bank Rate implies the rate of interest:at which the Reserve Bank of India discounts the Bills of Exchange

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Bank Rate → rate at which RBI rediscounts bills of exchange, i.e. lends to commercial banks; a monetary policy tool. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • At present, who is the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India?None of the above/More than one of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          RBI Governors → Raghuram Rajan (2013–2016), Urjit Patel (2016–2018), Shaktikanta Das (25th Governor, from 12 December 2018). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The accounting year of the Reserve Bank of India is:April - March

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          RBI accounting year → January–December, then July–June (from 1940), now April–March (from 2020-21, a nine-month transition year). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Arrange the following in asscending order of time in relation to their establishment:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Order → LIC (1956), UTI (February 1964), IDBI (July 1964), SEBI (1988). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority was set up in India on:April, 2000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          IRDAI → from Malhotra Committee; autonomous body 1999; statutory body from April 2000; regulates insurance companies. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which among the following agency regulate the mutual funds in India?SEBI

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SEBI → regulates mutual funds and stock markets; non-statutory 1988, statutory April 12, 1992 (SEBI Act 1992); HQ Mumbai. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Memory aid SEBI: born 1988, made statutory (given teeth) in 1992.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A rise in 'SENSEX' means:an overall rise in prices of shares of group of companies registered with Bombay Stock Exchange

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Rise in SENSEX → overall rise in share prices of its group of 30 companies on Bombay Stock Exchange (free-float market-weighted). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • As on March 2014, no. of companies BSE Greenex Index includes was:25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          BSE Greenex → 25 top 'green' companies by greenhouse gas emissions, market cap and liquidity. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Terms ‘Bull’and ‘Bear’are associated with which branch of commercial activity:Share Market

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          'Bull' and 'Bear' → share market terms: bull market = prices rising; bear market = prices falling. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Memory aid A bull tosses up with its horns; a bear swipes down with its paws.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which among the following is not a speculator in the stock exchange?Broker

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Stock market speculators → Bulls, Bears, Stags, Lame Ducks; a broker is an authorised member trading for customers, not a speculator. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Insider trading is related to:Share market

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Insider trading → share market dealing using non-public material information; illegal. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Gilt-edged market means:market of Government securities

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Gilt-edged market → market of Government securities (G-secs); called 'gilt-edged' because interest payment and redemption on the due date are certain. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse Gilt-edged (Government securities) with bullion market (gold, silver).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following is irrelevant in the context of share market?SAPs

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SAPs (Structural Adjustment Programmes) → World Bank/IMF loan-linked policies for developing countries, not share market; Sensex, BSE, Nifty are share market terms. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Land Development Bank provides loan to farmers for:Long term

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Land Development Bank → long-term loans to farmers (land development, higher agricultural production). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Central Cooperative Banks work at:District level

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Cooperative credit is three-tier: PACS (village level) → Central Cooperative Banks (district level) → State Cooperative Banks (state level). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Memory aid V-D-S ladder: Village PACS, District CCB, State StCB.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • During which Plan Period was the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) established?Sixth Five Year Plan

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          NABARD → set up July 1982, during the Sixth Five Year Plan; HQ Mumbai; apex bank for agricultural refinance. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Only organization to cater to all types of credit requirements of agriculture and rural development activities, is:NABARD

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          NABARD → apex body for all credit needs of agriculture and rural development; set up 12 July 1982 under Act 61 of 1981; gives refinance. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 9 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The nodal agency for implementing the ‘Rural Infrastructure Development Fund Programmes’ is:NABARD

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          NABARD → nodal agency for the Rural Infrastructure Development Fund (RIDF); RIDF created 1995-96 with initial corpus of Rs. 2000 crore. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • When was the first Regional Rural Bank formed?1975

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          First RRB → Prathama Grameen Bank, Moradabad (U.P.), 2 October 1975; the other first four: Malda, Gorakhpur, Bhiwani, Jaipur. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Memory aid RRBs born on Gandhi Jayanti (2 October) 1975.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Narasimham Committee for Financial Sector Reforms has suggested reduction in:SLR and CRR

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Narasimham Committees (1991, Financial System; 1997, Banking Sector Reforms) → financial sector reforms; suggested reducing SLR and CRR. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Recently, a scheme named ‘Swabhimaan’was launched. It’s main aim is:To take banks to the doorsteps of the rural poor

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Swabhimaan Campaign (10 February 2011) → financial inclusion; take banking to the doorsteps of the rural poor. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following is covered by the Kisan Credit Card Scheme?Consumption Credit and Investment Credit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Kisan Credit Card (August 1998) → covers both consumption and investment credit of farmers; run by Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, Cooperatives. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • What is called ‘Plastic Money’?Credit card

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          'Plastic Money' → credit cards (mainly bank-issued), also debit, prepaid, smart and store cards used in place of bank notes. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Assertion (A): All businessmen make profit due to price-hike.Both A and Rare true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Price-hike → businessmen make profit (A true); consumers curtail needs as money's purchasing power falls (R true); R does not explain A. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following pairs is the most suitable estimate of the physical quality of life?Infant mortality rate – Literacy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          PQLI → Morris D. Morris (mid-1970s); average of basic literacy, infant mortality and life expectancy; best pair for physical quality of life: infant mortality–literacy. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Human Development Index (HDI) was first developed by which of the following?UNDP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          HDI → developed by Pakistani economist Mahbub-ul-Haq for UNDP's Human Development Report (first 1990); rooted in Amartya Sen's capability work. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following is not included in Human Development Index?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          HDI indicators → life expectancy at birth, education level, standard of living (GNI per capita PPP $); not included → social inequality, health and nutrition, urbanization. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In the year 2014, out of186 countries of the world, India’s rank in Human Development Index was:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          HDR 2015 → India 130th of 188 (HDI for 2014), UPPSC's answer; HDR 2014 → 135th of 187 (for 2013); HDR 2023/2024 → 134th of 193. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following has chosen Gross National Happiness as the index of progress:Bhutan

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Gross National Happiness (GNH) → Bhutan; introduced by its 4th King Jigme Singye Wangchuck in the 1970s as an alternative to GDP. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following States was having the highest Human Development Index in the year 2001?Kerala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          India's first National Human Development Report 2001 (April 2002) → Kerala highest HDI; Kerala still top in 2019, Bihar last. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • As per latest ‘Educational Development Index’ released in February 2011, which are the four States at the top?Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Punjab, Delhi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Education Development Index 2009-10 (released February 2011) → top States: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Punjab, Delhi (UTs Puducherry, Lakshadweep led overall). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The National Rural Health Mission was launched on:April 12, 2005

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          National Rural Health Mission → launched 12 April 2005; in 2013 became a sub-mission of the National Health Mission (with National Urban Health Mission). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following is not correct about the 'National Rural Health Mission'?The programme was launched during the Eleventh Plan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          NRHM launched 2005 in the Tenth Five Year Plan (2002-07), not the Eleventh; aims at a functional village-to-district health system incl. drinking water, sanitation. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse Don't put NRHM in the Eleventh Plan; 2005 falls in the Tenth Plan (2002-07).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Under the National Rural Health Mission(NRHM)Scheme, a village level health worker is known as:ASHA

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist) → trained female village health worker under NRHM; chosen from the village, preferably aged 25 to 45; links community and health system. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following is NOT covered under Integrated Child Development Programme?Family Planning

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ICDS (2 October 1975, Ministry of Women and Child Development) → six services incl. supplementary nutrition, immunization, nutrition and health education; not family planning. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) is a flagship initiative set up by:NITI Aayog

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) → flagship initiative of NITI Aayog to promote a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship across the country. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ‘Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana’ has been launched for:promoting financial inclusion in the country

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          PM Jan-Dhan Yojana → National Mission for Financial Inclusion, launched 28 August 2014; a bank account for every family. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer by using the codes given below the lists.i iv ii iii

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Nai Roshni → minority women empowerment (2012-13); DISHA → IT training; PM Jan-Dhan Yojana → financial inclusion; Swavalamban (2010) → New Pension System. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following statements about the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana: A. The scheme provides free LPG connection to the women belonging to below poverty line (BPL) households. B. Rs. 8000 crore has been earmarked under the scheme. C. The scheme provides a financial support of Rs. 2,800 for each LPG connection to the BPL households. D. The scheme will benefit 5 crore families across the nation. Which of the above statements are correct?Only A, B and D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          PM Ujjwala Yojana (1 May 2016, Ballia, U.P.) → free LPG connections to BPL women; Rs. 8000 crore; 5 crore families. Wrong: Rs. 2,800 support per connection. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Memory aid Ujjwala tagline: 'Swachh Indhan Behtar Jeevan' (clean fuel, better life).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Swawlamban Scheme fulfills which of the following objectives?Providing skill and training to the women

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Swawlamban (1982-83, earlier NORAD-assisted Mahila Aarthik Karykram) → training and skills for women in traditional and non-traditional trades, for employment or self-employment. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse With the 2010 Swavalamban scheme for workers (pension).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Must-know questions: 39

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Hour 60 →

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Hour 60 of 72 · Revise

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Revise: Employment & Welfare Schemes to Poverty & Unemployment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            42 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Cover each line, recall it, then check. Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Two of the schemes launched by the Government of India for women’s development are Swadhar and Swayam Siddha.As regards the difference between them, consider the following statements:Neither 1 nor 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Swayam Siddha (2001) → holistic empowerment of women through SHGs; Swadhar → women in difficult circumstances. The question swaps them, so neither statement is correct. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The proposed ‘Janani Suraksha Scheme’ will replace:National Maternity Benefit Scheme

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Janani Suraksha Yojana (April 2005) → replaced National Maternity Benefit Scheme; safe motherhood under NRHM; cuts maternal and neo-natal mortality by promoting institutional delivery. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ABC index announced by the Government of India is associated with which of the following?Health

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ABC index (Achievements of Babies and Children) → child health; unweighted average of four indicators: survival, immunization, nutrition, schooling. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which of the following items of work are included in Bharat Nirman? Find your answer with the help of given codes.1, 2 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Bharat Nirman (December 2005) → irrigation, drinking water, electrification, roads, housing, rural telephony; irrigation covers AIBP, river-linking, water-body restoration. Excludes: displaced-person rehabilitation, sanitation, Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, agro-industries. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Memory aid Six parts 'I-D-E-R-H-T': Irrigation, Drinking water, Electricity, Roads, Housing, Telephony.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 10 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Bharat Nirman includes (select the correct answer from the codes given below) :1 and 3 are correct

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Bharat Nirman (2005-06 to 2008-09; Phase-II to 2012) → 1 crore (10 million) hectares more irrigation; telephones for remaining villages. Wrong: roads to all 2000-population villages. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Consider the following statements with reference to Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT) Scheme:Only 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            AMRUT (June 2015) → five hundred cities covering over 60% of India's urban population (not 400 cities); revamps urban infrastructure. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The objective of ‘Sangam Yojana’is:To ensure welfare of handicapped

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Sangam Yojana (15 August 1996) → welfare of the handicapped; rural disabled persons form a 'Sangam' group, each given Rs. 15000 for economic activities. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Don't confuse Nothing to do with Allahabad's Sangam or Ganga cleaning.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)
