                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              42 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Cover each line, recall it, then check. Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • As per the Planning Commission Report of 1999-2000 the highest percentage of people living below the poverty line was in:Odisha

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Planning Commission 1999-2000 → highest poverty share in Odisha (47.1%); 2011-12 → most poor people in Uttar Pradesh (598.19 lakh), highest ratio Chhattisgarh (39.93%). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Highest poverty ratio (percentage) with highest number of poor people (Uttar Pradesh).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following States has the least percentage of its population below the poverty line?Kerala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Least poverty among Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Kerala, Punjab → Kerala (19.6% in 2004-05; 7.05% in 2011-12, Tendulkar method). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements:Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of(A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Madhya Pradesh → 'Ethiopia of India' (India State Hunger Index 2008): excessive malnutrition and infant mortality like Ethiopia and Chad; A and R true, R explains A. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Human Poverty Index was introduced in the Human Development Report of the year:1997

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Human Poverty Index (HPI) → first published by UNDP in Human Development Report 1997; replaced by Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) from 2010. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid HPI born 1997, retired 2010 when MPI took over.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Human Development Report 1997 introduced the concept of Human Poverty Index (HPI) but Human Development Report replaced it with Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) in the year:2010

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              HPI introduced in HDR 1997; replaced by Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) in 2010; MPI captures deprivations in health, education and living standards. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements and select the correct answer using the code given below:Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Educated unemployment rises with high growth when professional or skilled education is lacking; book: A and R true, R explains A. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • As per the number of employed males per thousand in urban areas in year 1999-2000, put the name offollowing States in descending order: A. Meghalaya B. Nagaland C. Assam D. West Bengal Select the correct answer from the codes given below:D, C, B, A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Employed urban males per thousand, 1999-2000 (descending) → West Bengal, Assam, Nagaland, Meghalaya; same order in PLFS 2022-23 male LFPR. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid W-A-N-M: West Bengal > Assam > Nagaland > Meghalaya.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Disguised unemployment means:Marginal productivity of labour is zero

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Disguised (hidden) unemployment → marginal productivity of labour is zero; more persons employed in a job than needed, so removing them does not cut output. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Disguised = in disguise: looks employed, adds nothing (marginal product zero).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In India disguised unemployment is main characteristic of:Primary Sector

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Disguised unemployment in India → mainly in the primary sector (agriculture and allied), due to heavy population pressure on land. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following method is not used by N.S.S.O. for the measurement of unemployment in India?Current Monthly Status

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NSSO unemployment measures: Usual Principal Status (one year), Current Weekly Status (one week), Current Daily Status (each day of the week); no 'Current Monthly Status'. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Year, Week, Day: never Month.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The long-term vision of the Department of Commerce is to make India a major player in the world trade by:2020

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Foreign Trade Policy 2015-20 vision → make India a major player in world trade by 2020; FTP 2023 targets US$ 2 trillion exports by 2030. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In 2011-12, data of external trade of India reached at about:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India's total external merchandise trade in 2011-12 → Rs. 3811360 crore (Department of Commerce), so none of the given options is correct. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • India's total merchandise trade as a percentage of GDP has increased from 29.5% in 2004-05 to what percentage in 2012-13?40.6%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India's merchandise trade as % of GDP rose from 29.5% (2004-05) to about 40.6% (2012-13); World Bank: 31.1% in 2023. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following regions has emerged as the largest International Trade Partner (Export and Import) of India in 2008-09?Asia and ASEAN

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India's largest trade partner region → Asia and ASEAN; Asian countries supply more than 50% of India's imports (60.92% in 2023-24). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following countries is India’s largest trading partner?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India's largest trading partner: USA in 2006-07 (9.8%) and in 2021-22, 2022-23; China took the top spot in 2023-24, then USA, UAE. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following countries is India'stop trading partner in 2019-20?USA

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India's top trading partner: USA in 2019-20, 2021-22 and 2022-23 (China 2nd, UAE 3rd); China became largest in 2023-24. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse The answer depends on the year asked: USA for 2019-20 to 2022-23, China for 2023-24.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The largest part of India’s import (in value) comes from:China

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Largest source of India's imports → China (15.06% in 2023-24), then Russia and UAE. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In the year 2009-10, which of the following countries accounted for largest share in exports from India?UAE

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2009-10 → UAE accounted for the largest share of India's exports. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Don't mix years: UAE topped India's exports in 2009-10; USA tops at present.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Assertion (A): India’s trade deficit, after reaching the highest level in the year 2012-13 registered continuous decline since 2013-14.Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of(A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India's trade deficit peaked at US$ 195.66 billion in 2012-13, then fell till 2016-17 as both POL and non-POL deficits declined; A and R true, R explains A. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Term ‘Balance of Payment’ is used in relation to which of the following?Exports & Imports

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Balance of Payments → systematic record of all economic transactions (goods, services, assets) between residents and the rest of the world, usually for a year; current and capital accounts. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Given below are two statements, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).(A) is true, but (R) is false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Current Account Deficit → payments for goods, services, transfers and net income exceed receipts; occurs when a country imports (not exports) more; A true, R false. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • India spends the maximum foreign exchange on the import of which item?Petroleum products

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India spends the most foreign exchange on petroleum products (crude and products US$ 209418 million, about 29.4% of imports in 2022-23). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following has been the most important item in the total imports of India in recent years?Petroleum & Edible Oil

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Most important item in India's imports → petroleum (crude and products 26.52% of imports in 2023-24); iron and steel 3.52%, edible oils 2.20%. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Two largest items of import in India in recent years are:Capital goods and petroleum products

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Two largest import items → petroleum products (fuel) and capital goods; petroleum products alone have the maximum share. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Import procedure begins with:Indent

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Import procedure begins with the Indent (the import order), placed after foreign exchange is arranged through a Letter of Credit. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A Letter of Credit has to be produced by:An importer

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Letter of Credit → produced by the importer, through the importer's bank (Issuing Bank), promising payment to the exporter against stipulated documents. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following commodities has highest export from India in 2017?Engineering goods

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Highest export item from India (2017 and now) → engineering goods (US$ 112102 million in 2021-22), ahead of agriculture, chemicals and textiles. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following groups constitutes the largest items of export from India?Engineering Goods and Tea

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Largest export items: Readymade Garments and Gems & Jewellery in the question period (per explanation); at present Engineering goods has the highest value and share. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The largest contribution to the export earnings of India comes from the export of:Agricultural and allied products

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Largest export earner: Gems and jewellery in the question period; among the given items, agricultural and allied products lead in recent years (14.3% in 2020-21). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • India export maximum leather to:U.S.A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India's largest leather export market → USA (19.13%, April 2023 to March 2024), then Germany and UK. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Invisible Export means export of:Services

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Invisible export → export of services (tourism, banking, insurance, software, finance); no goods are involved. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Encouraging more multinational companies in India is to promote the policy of:All of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Encouraging MNCs in India → promotes privatisation, globalisation and liberalisation: all of the above. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid LPG: Liberalisation, Privatisation, Globalisation all welcome MNCs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Free Trade Zones have been established in India for the:promotion of export industries

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Free Trade Zones (SEZs/FTWZs) → set up to promote export industries; goods landed, made and re-exported generally free of customs duty. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In India, Special Economic Zone policy was announced in:April, 2000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Special Economic Zone (SEZ) policy in India → announced 1 April 2000, to boost foreign investment and give a hassle-free environment for exports. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Special Economic Zone (SEZ)Act became effective in:2006

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              SEZ Act 2005 → passed May 2005, assent 23 June 2005, in force 10 February 2006; aims: economic activity, exports of goods and services, investment, jobs, infrastructure. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Passed in 2005 but effective in 2006; it promotes exports of goods and services, not services only.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following cities does not have the Special Economic Zone:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Asia's first EPZ → Kandla (Gujarat), 1965; Chennai, Kandla, Kochi and Surat all have SEZs (converted EPZs), so no option fits. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Kandla first, and Asia's first: 1965.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In which year the Export-Import (EXIM) Bank of India was set up?1982

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              EXIM Bank of India → set up in 1982 under the Export-Import Bank of India Act, 1981; purveyor of export credit. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse The Act year (1981) with the year the bank was set up (1982).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ECGC is related to:Export Financing and Insurance

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ECGC (Export Credit Guarantee Corporation, set up 1957, Government of India) → export financing and credit risk insurance for exporters. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • One of the important goals of the economic liberalization policy is to achieve full convertibility of the Indian rupee. This is being advocated because:it will attract more foreign capital inflow in India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full rupee convertibility advocated to attract more foreign capital; LERMS from March 1992; rupee fully convertible on current account in August 1994 (IMF Article VIII). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 8 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Tarapore Committee was associated with which one of the following?Fuller capital account convertibility

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              S.S. Tarapore Committees (RBI) → capital account convertibility: first report May 1997; second on fuller CAC, report 31 July 2006. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Devaluation of a currency means:reduction in the value of a currency vis-a-vis major internationally traded currencies

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Devaluation → official lowering of a currency's value against major international currencies (fixed exchange rate); rupee devalued in 1949, 1966 and 1991. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Devalued in three years but four times: 1991 had two steps (July 1 and July 3).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Rupee was devalued by what percent in July, 1991?18

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              July 1991 rupee devaluation → about 18% in two steps (1 and 3 July); 17.38% against pound sterling, about 18.7% in US dollar terms; financial year 1991-92. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                42 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements and select the correct answer from the code given below:Both A and Rare true and R is the correct explanation of A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Devaluation → country's goods become cheaper abroad, so exports rise and imports become costly: A and R true, R explains A. Must know
