                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In the last one decade, which one among the following sectors has attracted the highest Foreign Direct Investment inflows into India?Services sector

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Highest FDI inflows: Telecommunication in the question period (per explanation); Services sector leads April 2000 to March 2024 (16.13%). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Largest inflow of foreign direct investment in India in 2007-08 took place in which sector?Services

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Largest FDI inflow in 2007-08 (and over the last decade) → services sector. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • India receives largest inflow of foreign capital in equity investment from:Singapore

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Largest FDI equity source: Mauritius in the question period and cumulative; Singapore in recent years (US$ 11,774 million in 2023-24), then Mauritius, USA. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • On October 4,2012, the Government of India has proposed to change the limits of FDI in Insurance Sector. It is proposed to:raise the FDI limit from 26% to 49%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                FDI in insurance: proposal on 4 October 2012 to raise it from 26% to 49%; Budget 2021-22 raised it from 49% to 74% (effective 19 May 2021). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • What is the name of New Single European Currency:Euro

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                New single European currency (European Monetary Union) → Euro; now official currency of 20 of the 27 EU member states. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following is not true for ‘Euro’ in 1999:It is in circulation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Euro introduced in 1999 as unit of account, means of deferred payment and mode of payment, but it was not yet in circulation then. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following statements is correct with reference to FEMA in India?Under FEMA, violation offoreign exchange rules has ceased to be a criminal offence.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                FERA 1973 replaced by FEMA 1999 on 1 June 2000; under FEMA, foreign exchange violations are civil, not criminal, offences. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 'World Development Report' is an annual publication of:International Bank for Reconstruction and Development

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                World Development Report → annual publication of the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (World Bank). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • With reference to the World Bank's Ease of Doing Business Report, which of the following statement(s) is/ are correct?Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Doing Business Report 2020 → India 63rd of 190 (up 14 places from 77th in 2019); top 3: New Zealand, Singapore, Hong Kong. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • As per World Development Report of the World Bank, 2008 arrange the following countries according to the size of their economy in descending order. State which one of the following is the correct order:USA > China > UK > India

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                World Development Report 2008 (nominal GDP) → USA > China > UK > India; India overtook the UK in 2019. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • India aims to achieve the 5 trillion dollar economy by:2024

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                5 trillion dollar economy target (PM Modi, 2019) → by 2024-25; may be delayed by COVID-19. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Loan and grants, for the improvement of infrastructure of States in India have been given by which one of the following institution?World Bank

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Loans and grants for States' infrastructure → World Bank; Aid-India Consortium (1958, World Bank-led) later became the Indian Development Forum. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The World Bank was established in:1945

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                World Bank (IBRD) → created at 1944 Bretton Woods Conference with IMF; became effective 27 December 1945; headquarters Washington, D.C. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse Created in 1944, but established (effective) in 1945.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Regarding International Monetary Fund, which one of the following statements is correct?It grants loans to only member countries

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                IMF lends only to member countries; its main function → help members solve balance of payments problems and keep the international monetary system stable. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • When did India become a member of International Monetary Fund?1945

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                India → founding member of IMF and World Bank; became a member of both on 27 December 1945. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The term 'paper gold' refers to:Special Drawing Rights (SDR) of IMF

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                'Paper gold' → Special Drawing Rights (SDR) of IMF: an international reserve asset and IMF's unit of account, added to members' foreign currency and gold reserves. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The main security guard of international trade is:WTO

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                WTO → main security guard of international trade; started 1 January 1995 under Marrakesh Agreement (signed 15 April 1994), replacing GATT, its earlier form. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The headquarters of W.T.O. is located atGeneva

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                WTO headquarters → Geneva, Switzerland. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following were the aims behind the setting up of the World Trade Organization (WTO)?1,2,3, and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                WTO aims → free trade and resource flows, protection of intellectual property rights, balanced trade, East Bloc-West trade; started 1 January 1995. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The difference of the Government Minimum Support Price (MSP) and market price, which is paid directly to the farmers under W.T.O. is called:Blue box subsidies

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Blue box → direct payments to farmers under production-limiting programmes (e.g. gap between MSP and market price); WTO subsidy boxes: green, amber, blue. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Traffic lights: green = go (permitted), amber = slow down (reduce), red = stop (no red box in AoA).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse India's MSP itself is amber box; NITI Aayog's Price Deficiency Payment (MSP minus market price) would be blue box.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • GATT stands for:General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                GATT = General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade; signed 30 October 1947 at Geneva by 23 countries; in force from 1948, office at Geneva. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The name of Arthur Dunkel is associated with:GATT

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Arthur Dunkel → Director General of GATT (1980-1993); launched the Uruguay Round in September 1986, which led to WTO. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following is not a member of ‘South Asian Association of Regional Cooperation’ (SAARC)?Thailand

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                SAARC → 8 South Asian members; founded 8 December 1985 at Dhaka by 7 countries; HQ Kathmandu; Afghanistan joined 2007; Thailand and Cambodia are not members. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid MBBS PAIN: Maldives, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Afghanistan, India, Nepal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • With reference to a grouping of countries known as BRICS, consider the following statements:2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                First BRIC summit → Yekaterinburg, Russia, 16 June 2009 (not Rio); South Africa joined last, September 2010 → BRIC became BRICS; Canada is not a member. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse Since 1 January 2024 Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and UAE have also joined, taking BRICS to 9.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which bank has been established in China by BRICS countries?New Development Bank

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                New Development Bank (BRICS bank) → agreed at 6th BRICS summit, Fortaleza, July 2014; in force July 2015; HQ Shanghai; set up by BRICS, not APEC. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in which India, was inducted as a full member was held at:Astana

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                India and Pakistan became full SCO members in 2017 at the Astana summit; SCO founded 15 June 2001, Shanghai; Shanghai Five (1996) never included Vietnam. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following is not a member of The Ganga-Mekong Swarnbhoomi Cooperation Project:Bangladesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Mekong-Ganga Cooperation (launched November 2000, Vientiane, Laos) → 6 members: India, Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia, Laos, Vietnam; Bangladesh and China are not members. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Four MGC areas: tourism, culture, education, transport.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following is not a member of ASEAN?India

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ASEAN = Association of South-East Asian Nations; founded 8 August 1967, Bangkok; 10 members; HQ Jakarta; India and South Korea are not members. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • United Nations has declared the year 2023 as:The International Year of Millets

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                UN declared 2023 → International Year of Millets (India's proposal); 2024 → International Year of Camelids; 2025 → International Year of Cooperatives. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements about New National Education Policy approved by Union Cabinet of India on 29th July, 2020:1 Only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NEP 2020 (approved 29th July 2020) → drafted by panel of Dr. K. Kasturirangan (formed June 2017); replaced the 1986 policy followed for 34 years, not 38. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the code given below the lists.3 4 2 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                M.S. Swaminathan → Green Revolution; L.K. Jha → Economic Administration Reforms; Verghese Kurien → Milk Production; Morarji Desai → Social Control on Banks. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • RESIDEX, an index of residential prices in India, was launched in the year2007

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NHB RESIDEX → India's first official housing price index, launched July 2007 by National Housing Bank; book links it to land prices. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Gandhian economy is based on the principle of:Trusteeship

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Gandhian economy → based on trusteeship (propounded by Mahatma Gandhi): the wealthy act as trustees for the welfare of the people. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 'Project Arrow' is concerned with the modernization of which of the following?Post Offices

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Project Arrow (India Post, April 2008) → modernisation of Post Offices; improves core operations and ambience, giving post offices a new identity.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ‘AGMARK’ is related with:Quality

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                AGMARK → quality seal for agricultural products; issued by Directorate of Marketing and Inspection (not FCI) under Agricultural Produce (Grading and Marking) Act, 1937. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 'Eco mark' is given to the Indian products that are:environment friendly

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Eco mark → given to environment-friendly Indian products; scheme run by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which arrangement offollowing would show sequence of demographic transition as typically associated with economic development?1, 3, 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Demographic transition (term by Frank W. Notestein) → high birth + high death → high birth + low death → low birth + low death. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • According to Malthus, which one of the following is the most effective measure of population control?Birth control

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Malthus ('An Essay on the Principle of Population', 1798) → population grows geometrically, food arithmetically; best control: birth control through moral restraint. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Population Grows Geometrically; food Adds Arithmetically.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • From which year was regular and scientific Census started in India?1881

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                First synchronous, regular and scientific Census → 1881; earlier non-synchronous census 1865-1872; since then once every ten years. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • First Census in India was conducted in the year:1872

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                First modern Census → 1872, under Lord Mayo; first regular Census → 1881, under Lord Ripon. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid M before R: Mayo 1872, then Ripon 1881.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • India's population growth during the 20th century can be classified into four distinct phases. Match List I (period) with List II (Phase) and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists:3 1 2 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Population phases → 1901-1921 stagnant; 1921-1951 steady; 1951-1981 rapid high growth; 1981-2001 high growth, slowing; lowest decadal growth 2001-2011 (17.7%, not 19.05).
