                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  42 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Cover each line, recall it, then check. Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • According to the Census of India 2011, the percentage growth of population in the country during the period of 2001-2011 was:17.70

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Census 2011 → decadal growth 2001-2011 was 17.7%; population 1028.74 million (2001) → 1210.85 million (2011). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In which of the following Census year in India was recorded the highest percentage change in population?1971

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Highest decadal growth → 1961-71 (24.80%, Census 1971); 1981 → 24.66%, 1991 → 23.87%, 2001 → 21.54%, 2011 → 17.7%. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In the context of population, which one of the following years has been termed as the year of 'Great Divide', after which population of India gradually registered accelerated growth?1921

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1921 → 'Great Divide' / 'Demographic Divide' year: the only Census with negative decadal growth (-0.31%); after it population grew at an accelerating pace. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid 1921: the one Census when India's population fell.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The population of Uttar Pradesh exceeds the total population of each country of one of the groups given below:Japan, Russia, Brazil, Nigeria; U.K., Germany, Japan, Pakistan

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  UP population (199812341, Census 2011) exceeds Japan, Russia, Brazil, Nigeria, UK, Germany, Pakistan; in 2001 only China, India, USA, Indonesia, Brazil were bigger. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following is the most populous State in India as per Census of 2011?Uttar Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Census 2011 population order → Uttar Pradesh > Maharashtra > Bihar > West Bengal > Andhra Pradesh (undivided); UP was top in 2001 too. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid U-M-B-W-A: UP, Maharashtra, Bihar, West Bengal, Andhra.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 14 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Consider the following statements:Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Chhattisgarh (135192 sq km) is larger in area than West Bengal (88752 sq km), but West Bengal has more people; both statements true. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Arrange the following States/Union Territories in descending order of their population, on the basis of Census 2001:Puducherry-Chandigarh-Mizoram-Sikkim

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Census 2001 population → Puducherry > Chandigarh > Mizoram > Sikkim (least); Census 2011 → Puducherry > Mizoram > Chandigarh > Sikkim. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Chandigarh and Mizoram swap places between 2001 and 2011; Sikkim is last both times.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The highest population growth ratio during 1991-2001 has been recorded in:Nagaland

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Highest decadal growth 1991-2001 → Nagaland (64.41%), then Sikkim, Manipur, Meghalaya; in Census 2011 Meghalaya is highest (27.9%). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • During the inter Census period 1991-2001, which of the following States of India registered the lowest growth of population?Kerala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Lowest population growth 1991-2001 → Kerala; lowest in 2001-2011 → Nagaland. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • During the period 1991-2001, the decadal growth rate of population (in percentage terms) was lowest in the State of:Kerala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Lowest decadal growth 1991-2001 → Kerala; Census 2011 lowest → Nagaland (-0.6%), then Kerala (4.9%), Goa (8.2%). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid Kerala lowest in 2001; Nagaland negative in 2011.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following States recorded a decline in its population in Census 2011?Nagaland

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Nagaland → only State whose population fell in Census 2011 (-0.6%): 1990036 in 2001 → 1978502 in 2011. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • States with the highest and lowest density of population in India are respectively:West Bengal and Arunachal Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Highest/lowest density: 2001 → West Bengal (903) / Arunachal Pradesh (13); 2011 → Bihar (1106) / Arunachal Pradesh (17). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 12 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following is arranged in correct descending order in terms of population density as per 2011 Census?Bihar, West Bengal, Kerala, Uttar Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Density descending, Census 2011: Bihar (1106) > West Bengal (1028) > Kerala (860) > Uttar Pradesh (829); UP lowest of these four. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The correct decending order of population density (2001) of prominent States of India is:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Density 2001: West Bengal (903) > Bihar (881) > Kerala (820) > Uttar Pradesh (690); 2011: Bihar (1106) > West Bengal (1028) > Kerala (860) > UP (829). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • According to the 1991 Census, the most densely populated State of the Country is:West Bengal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Census 1991: most densely populated State → West Bengal (767 persons/sq km); Census 2011 → Bihar. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • According to the 1991 Census, the correct ascending order of least densely populated States of India is:Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Sikkim and Nagaland

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Least dense States ascending (1991 → 2011): Arunachal Pradesh (10 → 17) < Mizoram (33 → 52) < Sikkim (57 → 86) < Nagaland (73 → 119). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid A-M-S-N: 'A Man Sees Nagaland' = Arunachal, Mizoram, Sikkim, Nagaland.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following Union Territories of India has the lowest population density as per the Census of 2011?Andaman and Nicobar Islands

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Lowest-density UT, Census 2011 → Andaman and Nicobar Islands (46), second lowest in India after Arunachal Pradesh (17); Lakshadweep 2149, Daman and Diu 2191. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following States of India has recorded the maximum increase in literacy rate during 2001-2011?Bihar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Biggest literacy rise 2001-2011: Bihar among given States (14.8 points: 47.0% → 61.8%); among all States/UTs → Dadra and Nagar Haveli (18.6 points). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • As per Census 2011, which among the following States recorded highest literacy?Manipur

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Literacy 2011: Manipur 79.2% > Punjab 75.8% > Assam 72.2% > MP 69.3%. Top States: Kerala 94.0%, Mizoram 91.3%, Goa 88.7%, Tripura 87.2%. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid Top four literate States: K-M-G-T (Kerala, Mizoram, Goa, Tripura).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • As per Census 2011, which of the following States is second in India in its literacy rate and the level of urbanization?Mizoram

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Mizoram → second in India in both literacy (91.3%) and urbanization (52.1%), Census 2011; first: Kerala in literacy (94.0%), Goa in urbanization (62.2%). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The State having highest literacy rate as per 2011 Census is:Mizoram

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Mizoram → highest literacy after Kerala in Census 2001 and 2011; so highest among UP, Manipur, Rajasthan, Mizoram and among North-East States. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • According to the provisional figures of Census 2011 the gap between male literacy rate and female literacy rate in India is that of:16.68 percent

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Male-female literacy gap, Census 2011: provisional 16.68 points (82.14 vs 65.46); final 16.3 (80.9 vs 64.6). Female literacy about 65.5% (provisional). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which amongst the following States has the smallest gap in percentage rates between male and female literacy as per 2011 Census?Meghalaya

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Smallest male-female literacy gap, Census 2011 → Meghalaya (3.1 points: male 76%, female 72.9%); then Mizoram, Kerala, Nagaland. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one among the following States has the highest female literacy rate as per the Census 2001?Chhattisgarh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Female literacy 2001: Chhattisgarh (51.9) > Odisha (50.5) > Madhya Pradesh (50.3) > Rajasthan (43.9); Kerala highest in India (2001 and 2011). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • As per Census 2001, which of the following States has the lowest female literacy?Bihar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Lowest female literacy 2001 → Bihar (33.1%); Jharkhand 38.9, UP 42.2, Chhattisgarh 51.9. 2011 lowest three: Bihar < Rajasthan < Jharkhand. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following States has the lowest female literacy rate, as per the Census 2011 provisional figures?Rajasthan

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Lowest female literacy, Census 2011: provisional → Rajasthan (52.66%); final → Bihar (51.5%). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • According to 2001 Census, the State having the largest rate of illiteracy is:Bihar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Highest illiteracy (2001) and lowest literacy (2011) → Bihar; lowest five in 2011: Bihar (61.8%), Arunachal, Rajasthan, Jharkhand, Andhra Pradesh (67.0%). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Out of the following during which Census decade, sex-ratio in India recorded sharpest decline?1961-71

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Sharpest fall in sex-ratio among options → 1961-71 (941 → 930). Series: 1931 950, 1951 946, 1991 927, 2001 933, 2011 943 (not 925). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • According to the 2001 Census Report, male-female ratio in India is:1000: 933

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Sex-ratio (male : female), Census 2001 → 1000 : 933; Census 2011 → 1000 : 943. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • According to the provisional figures of 2011 Census male-female ratio in India is:1000: 940

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Sex-ratio, Census 2011 → 940 provisional, 943 final (females per 1000 males); 2001 → 933. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • According to population Census 2011, which of the following States has largest number of females per thousand males?Kerala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Highest sex-ratio State, Census 2011 → Kerala (1084); Tamil Nadu 996, Manipur 992, Meghalaya 989. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Kerala → only State with more females than males (1059 in 2001; 1084 in 2011); among UTs Puducherry also above 1000 (1037).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   • The largest percentage share of the Scheduled Castes population is in:Punjab

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Largest Scheduled Caste population (number), Census 2011 → Uttar Pradesh (41357608); then West Bengal, Bihar, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   Scheduled Tribes share of India's population → 8.2% (Census 2001); 8.6% (Census 2011).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   • In Indian States, the tribal population is largest in:Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Largest tribal population among pairs → Madhya Pradesh (15316784) and Chhattisgarh (7822902); Madhya Pradesh highest single State (Census 2011).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   • As per India’s National Population Policy, 2000, by which one of the following years is it our long-term objective to achieve population stabilization?2045

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NPP 2000 → long-term goal: population stabilization by 2045 (later moved to 2070); medium-term: TFR to replacement level 2.1 by 2010. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse 2045 is the original NPP target; 2070 is the revised one. Read which the question wants.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following statements is correct according to the Census 2001?All

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Census 2001, all true then: urban population 285 million (28.6 crore, 27.78%), more than USA's total population (28.14 crore); urbanization largely self-reliant. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In India, the largest percentage of decadal growth of urbanization has been witnessed during:1971-81

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Largest decadal urban growth → 1971-81 (46.1%); 1961-71 38.2%, 1981-91 36.4%, 1991-2001 31.5%, 2001-2011 31.8%. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following criteria is not accepted to define any domicile in India as an urban center?Physical expansion

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Census urban criteria: statutory town, or population at least 5,000, 75% male workers non-agricultural, density 400/sq km. Physical expansion is not a criterion. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • As per 2011 Census, the percentage of urban population to total population in India was:31.16

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    India's urban share, Census 2011 → 31.16% (provisional); final 31.1% (377106125 of 1210854977); rural 68.9%. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 11 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • More than one-fourth of India’s urban population lives in the two States of:Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Over one-fourth of India's urban population lives in Maharashtra (50818259) and Uttar Pradesh (44495063), Census 2011 (true in 2001 too). Must know
